title: Head of Engineering
description:
About Konvu

At Konvu, we’re on a mission to make security invisible, redefining vulnerability management for the agentic world.

As AI begins to generate, test, and deploy code autonomously, legacy security approaches break down. Konvu’s AI agents reason like security engineers: automatically triaging noise, verifying exploitability with evidence, and helping teams focus on what truly matters.

Our agents plug directly into existing scanners and workflows, no rip-and-replace, no new dashboards. We deliver evidence-backed decisions where teams already work, cutting false positives and surfacing exploitable issues with confidence.

Founded by early members of Sqreen (YC W18, acquired by Datadog), we know what it takes to turn deep technical insight into tools developers and security teams actually use.

We’ve raised $5M in Seed funding and are backed by top European and US VCs, as well as leaders from companies like Datadog, GitHub, Docker, Cloudflare, Sumo Logic, and Vanta.

We're looking for a Head of Engineering to build and lead our engineering team in Paris, and set the technical foundation for everything we ship next.

What you'll do

You'll own how we build. That means the team, the technical direction, and the delivery pace that carries us through our next stage of growth. You'll still be close to the code, but your leverage is the team you grow and the standards you set.

  • Lead the engineering team. Hire, coach, and grow a small team of engineers into a high-output group. Set the bar for quality, give people ownership, and create the conditions for them to do the best work of their careers.

  • Own delivery. Turn product strategy into a roadmap the team can ship against. Balance thoughtful design with fast iteration so we keep shipping value every week, not every quarter.

  • Set technical direction. Make the architecture decisions that matter, from how our AI agents run reliably inside complex enterprise environments to how we keep builds fast and systems observable as we scale.

  • Build the team AI-forward. Put AI at the center of how we build, not just what we build. Make our engineers faster and our practices sharper by treating AI as a core competency

  • Scale the team without slowing it down. You've seen what breaks when a small team grows fast. Get ahead of it: hiring, process, on-call, technical debt, and the org design that keeps velocity high as headcount climbs.

  • Stay close to customers. Work with our users over Slack and on calls. Turn what you learn into technical priorities and make sure the team never loses the thread between what we build and why it matters.

  • Shape the culture. As an early leader, your decisions define how we build for years. You'll set our engineering practices, our standards, and the kind of place this is to be an engineer.

Who you are

Even if you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply if you're driven to create real impact.

  • You've led engineering teams and are still hands-on. You've managed and grown engineers, and you can still design a system and review a hard PR yourself. You lead by raising the team's output, not by stepping away from the work.

  • You've scaled a team through its fastest growth stage. You know what it takes to ship fast with a small team, and what breaks as it grows. You've felt the trade-offs between speed, quality, and scale, and you've made the right calls under pressure.

  • You're AI-forward. You're genuinely excited about how AI is changing engineering, you build with it daily, and you have a point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals. You care about code quality, architecture, testing, and operational excellence as much as you care about shipping.

  • Product-minded. You think about the "why" behind what the team builds and are comfortable making trade-offs between scope, quality, and speed.

  • You build teams people want to be on. You hire well, give clear feedback, and create ownership rather than dependence.

  • Excellent communication in English (our working language).

  • Eagerness to work onsite from our Paris office.

Nice-to-have (not required):

  • Experience building developer, infrastructure, or security tools

  • Exposure to agentic systems

  • You've been an early engineer or engineering leader at a startup that scaled

Our Hiring Process

  • 30-minute video call with our CEO

  • 1-hour technical and leadership deep dive with our CEO

  • Working session with the team: architecture and team-scaling scenarios

  • Onsite with the founding team

  • Reference calls


Why Work at Konvu

We’re building AI agents that redefine how security and engineering teams work. We’re assembling a world-class team of builders who want to push what’s possible in security and AI.

Here is what it's like to be working here

  • Startup principles in action: we’re shaped by YC principles, which means fast iteration, ownership from day one, and solving problems that matter. Whether you’re shipping features or closing customers, you’ll actually see your impact every week.

  • Globally minded from day one: Konvu was built from both sides of the Atlantic, combining European engineering excellence with American ambition. Our goal is simple: build a product loved by security and engineering teams, wherever they are.

  • A culture of sharing and learning: People here don’t just build or sell, they also teach and grow. From technical deep dives and sales playbook reviews to speaking at events like our Konvupéro meetups or industry events, you’ll have space to grow and contribute beyond your core role.

  • Hard, meaningful problems: You’ll work on AI agents that reason about exploitability and risk and run reliably inside complex enterprise environments, and help customers turn that into real-world outcomes. It’s the kind of work that pushes your limits and makes you proud of what you’re building.

  • Strong upside: We offer a competitive salary, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits so you can grow with the company you’re helping build.

Our commitment to diversity

At Konvu, we deeply value diversity and are dedicated to fostering an environment where everyone feels supported and can thrive. To build a product that’s loved by everyone, we need a team with all kinds of different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. This is why we are committed to hiring people from all walks of life.

title: Head of Product Marketing & Growth
description:
Our job everyday is to protect the data and critical assets of businesses world-wide by discovering hidden vulnerabilities… before the bad guys do!

At CybelAngel, we see beyond perimeters to protect businesses from the most critical cybersecurity threats. Fortune 500 Global to mid-size companies world-wide, trust CybelAngel’s global team of approximately 130 team members to protect their businesses from digital threats. With a combination of advanced machine learning, cyber analysis expertise, and a powerful suite of software solutions, CybelAngel detects and resolves our clients potential threats, long before they can fall into the hands of cyber criminals.

Our capabilities expand every day to uncover new risks, detect more threats, protect more clients, and create new possibilities for our employees.

With employees based in France and in the US, CybelAngel’s global footprint allows for a thriving hybrid, office and remote-work environment. We are looking for exceptional ‘go-getters’ who share our ambitious vision, innovative culture especially considering our GenAI DNA, high commitment to ethics, and enthusiasm for being the best possible place to work!

Our values

  • Be Bold

  • Be Curious

  • Stronger Together

We are looking for our Head of Product Marketing & Growth, based in Paris.

Why this role exists

CybelAngel serves as the perimeter guard for over 300 global enterprises, neutralizing data exposure and external digital threats. Our detection engine has established its authority within the enterprise tier, where we defined our benchmark for signal precision and forged our deepest references.

The landscape is shifting, driven by AI-native disruption and high-profile systemic leaks in the public sphere. We view this volatility as a structural opportunity to capture new market segments.

While our core value remains constant, the discovery, acquisition, and evaluation mechanics for these tiers require a complete rethink. This is why we are opening a commercial architecture mandate focused on Product Marketing excellence.

Your mission: turn volume selling into a working machine: positioning, packaging, pricing, self-serve funnel, partner enablement, and make the cross functional teams that feed it converge.

This is not a content production role. It is a commercial architecture role, with accountability for revenue.

What you will own

1. Positioning and messaging

  • Define CybelAngel's positioning for new segments: what we promise, against which alternative, to which buyer.

  • Translate technically complex detection capabilities (external attack surface, exposed secrets, document leaks, dark web, vendor exposure) into value propositions that an IT director at a 400-person company can grasp unaided, with no pre-sales support.

  • Keep the product narrative coherent across the website, the product, partners and sales teams: including how legible it is to AI answer engines, which have become a first-order discovery channel in our categories.

  • Build and maintain personas, jobs-to-be-done and use-case messaging across the portfolio.

2. Packaging and pricing

  • Design the packaging architecture for the volume segment: what is self-serve, what triggers a sales conversation, what stays enterprise, and the expansion mechanics between tiers.

  • Own pricing strategy for these segments: model, value metric, thresholds, tiers, testing. You arrive with a method, with data, and with the ability to defend a trade-off in front of an executive committee.

  • Instrument the measurement: elasticity, attach rate, average deal size, margin by channel.

3. Product Growth Capability and lifecycle

  • Take our existing growth capabilities in motion from embryonic to measured: activation, time-to-value, trial-to-paid conversion, in-product expansion.

  • Work with the funnel Product Manager to build onboarding, in-product copy and the event instrumentation that proves a user has reached value.

  • Contribute to lifecycle marketing across the whole journey driven by behavioural triggers rather than disconnected campaigns.

  • Establish a real experimentation discipline: hypothesis, metric, duration, verdict. Including the right to kill what does not work.

4. The GTM pod: your first major project

You take operational ownership of a cross-functional pod dedicated to enable sales growth, bringing together volume sales (direct and indirect), field marketing, channel and product, with shared metrics and a short cadence.

  • Define the charter: composition, scope, committed metrics, rituals, escalation rules.

  • Run the first cycle on one use case and one segment, in sprints, with a documented verdict.

  • Industrialise the feedback loop: every field objection and every lost deal feeds the playbook, the messaging or the roadmap.

5. Sales and partner enablement

  • Equip volume sales teams: playbooks, persona-level narratives, battle cards, objection handling, discovery plays.

  • Make our content directly reusable by resellers, MSPs and MSSPs: the goal is for a partner to understand, pitch and sell without starting from scratch.

  • Own launches end to end, including post-launch impact measurement.

6. Market and competitive intelligence

  • Run the market and segmentation research that underpins our decisions: segment size and accessibility, buying behaviour, channels, market pricing.

  • Maintain actionable competitive intelligence across our landscape (EASM, CTI, DRPS, TPRM) and on the AI-native entrants reshaping our categories.

  • Feed the product roadmap with market signal, held to the same evidentiary standard we expect of a Product Manager.

Your environment

  • Reporting to the CTPO, working closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing and Finance.

  • Team: you manage one Product Marketing Manager and build the function from there. Further headcount is discussed on the strength of first-half results.

  • Daily interfaces: Product Management, Sales, Channel, Field Marketing, Customer Success, Data.

  • Member of the product leadership team, and a regular contributor to executive forums.

What the first six months look like

Months 1–2 — Diagnosis. You produce an evidenced assessment: where volume deals actually die, what our packaging prevents, what our self-serve funnel fails to measure, what partners cannot sell. You establish the quantified baseline.

Months 2–3 — Framing. Segment positioning and messaging settled. Pod charter approved. First packaging and pricing proposal presented to the executive committee, with scenarios and their consequences.

Months 3–6 — Proof. First pod cycle executed and documented. Self-serve funnel instrumented end to end. Sales playbook and partner kit in production. A clear verdict on what we industrialise and what we drop.

The profile we are looking for

Required

  • You have contributed to a move into mid-market or SMB. Concretely: you worked at a company that sold enterprise and opened a volume segment, and you can tell us what worked, what failed and why. PLG is one way of doing this; channel, assisted self-serve, inside sales and cycle automation are others. We are interested in all of them.

  • Market research and analysis. You can size a segment, build a segmentation that people can act on, and defend a conclusion with the data behind it rather than with conviction alone.

  • Product and cyber messaging. You write fast and well, and you can make a technical subject legible without betraying it.

  • Pricing strategy. You have designed or rebuilt a packaging structure and a price list, and lived with the consequences of those choices.

  • Practitioner-level fluency with AI. You use AI to automate production chains, generate and industrialise content, analyse market data at scale, and write specifications a product team can act on. We will test this during the process, with your own tools.

  • Seniority and posture. You can hold a position in front of an executive committee, own a trade-off, and say what is not working before you are asked.

  • Fluent professional English; French is a strong advantage given our Paris base and French customer and partner ecosystem.

Nice to have

  • Cybersecurity experience. You have done product marketing inside a security vendor or platform. You understand what a detection product actually sells, why false positives are a commercial problem as much as a technical one, and how a security buyer builds a decision. Indirect channel experience in security: resellers, MSPs, MSSPs, distributors.

  • Hands-on practice with product analytics and experimentation tooling.

  • Experience managing a small team.

  • Familiarity with our domains: external attack surface, threat intelligence, dark web, third-party risk.

If you do not meet the requirements but you think you are a great fit, you are welcome to apply and explain why !

How we will measure success

We will jointly commit to a small number of shared pod metrics on the volume segment:

  • Trial-to-paid conversion and the associated acquisition cost

  • Time to first value for a new self-serve user

  • Volume-segment recurring revenue and partner attach rate

  • Segment CAC payback

  • Volume sales cycle velocity

We will not measure you on content volume or MQL count.

Our Benefits

Salary range: based on your level of experience and the competencies you'll demonstrate during the hiring process

10% bonus, based on company and individual performance

Lunch card with company contribution

‍️ Healthcare insurance with company contribution

️ Remote allowance

️ Monthly credits with CSE partner

️ 5 weeks of holidays and RTT

Subsidy for one sporting event per year

️ Legal Care Service

Your hiring journey

  • First call with Pierre, Talent Acquisition Manager, to make sure expectations from both ends have a good chance to match (30 min)

  • Interview with Loïc, CTPO (45 min)

  • Deep dive on your segment-shift and pricing experience with Loic/Grégoire or Romain (1 hr)

  • Live exercise: working from a real brief, you produce a positioning document, a specification and an automation in front of us, using the tools you work with every day. We care about your method, not a polished deliverable. (2 hrs)

  • Conversation with Erwan, CEO (30 min)

title: Head of Marketing
description:
About

Swan is Europe’s embedded banking specialist. We empower software companies to embed banking features like accounts, cards, and payments directly into their products, under their own brand.Swan processes over €2.5 billion in monthly transactions for more than 150 companies - like Pennylane, Indy, Agicap, Libeo, and Lucca.

Founded in 2019, the company has received growth capital from leading investors such as Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Bpifrance and Eight Roads. Swan is a principal member of Mastercard and a licensed financial institution, regulated by the French banking authority (ACPR).

Our mission

Banking belongs in business software

Many software companies already serve small businesses incredibly well: helping them send invoices, run payroll, manage inventory, and more. They’re on a mission to become the central hub for managing every aspect of business life.

But when it comes to financial workflows, there’s still a gap. Too many critical tasks like managing cash flow, tracking payments, or reconciling accounts happen outside the software, across spreadsheets, email threads, banking portals.

It’s a missed opportunity. Business software shouldn’t just record financial activity — it should run it.

To learn more about us: About Swan, Our story.


Job description


As Head of Marketing, you’ll report to our Chief Business Officer and you will shape Swan’s go-to-market strategy across product marketing, brand & content, growth, and regional marketing.
Your mission is to position Swan as the leading embedded banking platform in Europe, helping software companies understand and adopt embedded finance.
You’ll combine strong customer empathy, sharp positioning, compelling storytelling, and a data-driven mindset to build our brand, generate demand, and drive growth across Europe.

Main tasks

  • Marketing team leadership. Lead Swan’s Marketing team, bringing together central Content, Growth, Product Marketing functions and local Marketing Managers, while setting clear priorities and OKRs and allocating resources to the highest-impact opportunities.

  • Brand positioning & strategy. Strengthen Swan’s brand positioning and scale brand awareness across core European markets, including France, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Belgium.

  • Content, communications & events. Own Swan’s content and communications strategy across the website, social media, events, and PR, turning complex products and ideas into compelling stories that strengthen brand awareness.

  • Growth marketing. Build repeatable go-to-market motions that drive demand generation and pipeline growth in partnership with Sales and RevOps, using funnel data and experimentation to continuously improve performance.

  • Partner marketing. Develop strategic partner marketing initiatives that amplify Swan’s reach and accelerate growth across existing and new markets.

  • Product marketing. Own Swan’s product marketing strategy end-to-end, from customer insights and positioning to product launches, adoption, and commercial enablement.

Curious about your future team?

At Swan, you'll have the opportunity to join our dynamic Marketing team and play a central role in shaping how Swan is positioned and how we scale across Europe.

Your team currently consists of nine members across Content, Growth, Product Marketing functions and local Marketing Managers.

The Marketing team works closely with Sales, RevOps, Product, Partnerships, and the broader leadership team. In your role, you can expect strong cross-functional collaboration, with a shared focus on customer value, growth, and execution.

Preferred experience
You’re a great match if:

  • You have 8+ years of experience in a marketing function including 2 years in payments

  • Already led a team (managed 4+ people), and are comfortable with people from different cultures and locations

  • Broad marketing experience including growth marketing, brand, content, events, product marketing

  • You are structured and execution-oriented, turning priorities into action

  • You are business-driven and turn customer insights into strong positioning

  • You are a clear and influential communicator who makes complex ideas simple

  • Our ideal teammate: Empathetic. Skilled. Frank. We love to challenge each other, and we leave our egos at the door.

It’s okay if you don’t tick all the boxes - don’t let imposter syndrome prevent you from applying!

Swan is committed to providing a caring work environment for all employees, regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, or belief.

When it comes to recruitment, we’re interested in your work experience, skills, and overall personality. Because diversity makes the workplace stronger and is necessary for Swan’s success, we are intensifying efforts to incorporate concrete actions to help us improve in this area.


About Swan

Perks of being a Swanee:

  • Holidays : 25 days + RTT ️

  • Meal Vouchers: We provide a meal voucher card to cover your meals on work days.

  • Transport: Monthly mobility package for employees. In accordance with the company agreement for sustainable mobilities, you can now use your mobility package to pay for alternative commuting modes.

  • Health insurance (mutuelle): Alan. This is Swan's health and welfare insurance.

  • Sports: Thanks to our partnership with Classpass, you can enjoy advantageous discounts on subscriptions. They offer a wide range of sports activities as well as wellness activities.

  • Well-being support: access to Moka Care for mental health and wellness.

  • Hybrid remote policy: We offer the possibility of working from home for 2 days per week.

  • Offsite: Once a year we gather to reconnect, deep-dive into big topics, and relax.

  • This isn’t a perk, it should be the rule, but diversity and inclusion are important at Swan. We’re working hard to get better every day.

Our values:

Swan’s core values guide our actions daily. Individually, they may seem obvious, but together, they form a unique culture.


Simplicity: Leonardo Da Vinci said: “simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.” If something's convoluted or confusing, we work extra hard to break it down - Making complex things simple is what we do.

Long Term: We always play the long game, whether it's to support our partners in their growth journey, or make tangible commitments to climate action.

Excellence: We are a team of experts who consistently go all out to create pixel-perfect banking services and exceed our partners' expectations - whatever it takes.

Be Human: We believe in the power of kindness and the importance of acting with integrity. But embracing our humanity extends beyond interpersonal interactions, it means caring about greater issues that affect our planet.


You can find out more about our culture.


Recruitment process

  • A 45-min call with our Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

  • A 1H interview with our CEO, Camille

  • A first discussion with Lennig, our Head of Account Management followed by a 1H conversation with our Chief People Officer, Anne

  • Last step of the process consists in a 1h interview with our VP of Sales, Julio and a final discussion with our Chief Product Officer, Nicolas

title: Head of Nanofabrication
description:
Founded in 2020 and based in the heart of Paris, C12’s mission is to be at the center of one of the biggest technological breakthroughs of the century and change the course of history by building a universal quantum computer.
At C12, we believe that achieving a true breakthrough in quantum computing requires rethinking the fundamentals. That’s why our founders—deeply rooted in academic and engineering excellence—have chosen carbon nanotubes as the building blocks of our quantum processors. This ultra-pure material dramatically reduces error rates, boosts performance, and minimizes hardware overhead—key ingredients for scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing. By crafting a unique approach that scales, we aim to revolutionize quantum computing just as silicon transformed classical computing.
Since our founding, we’ve raised over €25 million in funding, published 11 scientific papers, and secured 8 patents. Today, our fast-growing team of 80+, including 25 PhDs, has over 26 nationalities represented. We have our own cutting-edge lab spaces in Paris' historic Panthéon district, where scientists, engineers, and innovators work side-by-side to tackle some of the most exciting technical challenges of our time.
If you're passionate about shaping the future of quantum technology and want to make a real impact, C12 offers a unique environment to grow, learn, and innovate.

Your role at C12 Quantum Electronics:

As Head of Nanofabrication at C12, you will own the strategy, development and execution of our nanofabrication activities, from current wafer production to the next generations of processes.

Key responsibilities:

  • You will define and drive C12’s nanofabrication strategy, balancing technology development, process maturity and production needs
  • You will drive yield improvement effort and the development of next-generation fabrication processes and ensure their successful introduction into production
  • You will build a robust and scalable nanofabrication organization, with strong standards around process control, documentation and data
  • You will lead the team through technical challenges and process deviations, ensuring fast and structured problem resolution
  • You will recruit, develop and empower a growing team of nanofabrication engineers and technicians
  • You will contribute to equipment strategy and tool procurement in close collaboration with Operations
  • You will work closely with the CTO, Operations, Chip Design and downstream production teams to align priorities and support C12’s technology roadmap
  • You will provide technical expertise for collaborations with external foundries, RTOs and fabrication partners

About you:

  • You have significant experience in nanofabrication and a strong understanding of advanced cleanroom processes.
  • You have a proven track record of leading technical teams in complex R&D or prototyping environments.
  • You are able to set direction, make trade-offs and rely effectively on domain experts.
  • You are equally comfortable driving new process development and building the discipline required for robust, reproducible production.
  • You bring a strong data-driven mindset and know how to build the right structures for process learning and continuous improvement.
  • You are pragmatic, adaptable and effective in fast-moving environments where priorities and technical challenges can evolve quickly.
  • Experience in an RTO, advanced prototyping cleanroom or similar environment is highly valued.
  • Experience in quantum technologies or quantum-device fabrication is a plus.
What we offer:
  • 92,000 euros to 108,000 euros yearly base salary
  • Stock options for every employee (BSPCE/ESOP)
  • Sponsored trip to conferences around the world
  • A highly dynamic international team
  • Swile meal vouchers
  • Mental health support with moka.care
  • Training budget/ Annual Learning & Development Allowance
  • Sabbatical leave (after 2 years in the company)
  • Vibrant office culture (two office spaces in the heart of Paris, team lunches, offsite events, Friday breakfasts..)

You should join us if...

  • You like hands-on work and technology
  • You want to contribute to achieving landmark results in quantum computing, making a difference in the emerging quantum technologies
  • You want to work within a team of 80+ people with various backgrounds in nanofabrication, quantum electronics, and carbon nanotube science to create a revolutionary quantum computing processor
  • You want to thrive in an exceptional scientific environment with several industrial and academic partners
  • You share our values (excellence, scientific integrity, diversity, curiosity, and care) and want to help us define our product-focused culture and ambition to accelerate
We still encourage even if you don’t meet all the requirements. Rest assured, we are committed to finding the right fit for our team and are open to adjusting compensations based on skills and experiences.
Applications from women are especially welcomed!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Global Head of Procurement Services
description:
Job title: Global Head of Procurement Services (BO Service Tower Head)

Location: Gentilly


  • Reporting: EVP Head of Business Operations
  • Job type: permanent, full time


About the job

Our Team:

Sanofi is a global integrated healthcare leader focused on patients’ needs with a diversified offer of medicines, vaccines, and innovative therapeutics solutions, engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of healthcare products.


Today, our footprint extends to 90 countries, with more than 91,000 employees perpetuating this legacy and united under the common purpose of chasing the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re now on course to transform the practice of medicine through breakthrough science and make a positive impact on our people and the communities we serve.


The Role:

As we continue to transform the practice of medicine, the next chapter of Sanofi’s Take the Lead strategy will require a focus on delivering transformation and simplification of our core processes, optimizing resource allocation and deployment to fuel business growth and investment in science.


To facilitate this transformation, a new Business Operations Business Unit is being established, bringing together existing business service activities, and driving further expansion of centralized services at scale into a global unit, with a focus on driving simplification, efficiency, and productivity.


This new Business Unit will enable the delivery of best-in-class business support capabilities across the organization, incorporating and engaging disparate teams from across areas such as R&D, M&S, the Corporate Functions and GBUs into new global Service Delivery Towers with initial services spanning Commercial, Finance, Procurement and People & Culture.


Reporting to the Head of Business Operations, the Global Head of Procurement Services plays a critical role in the development, execution and transformation of both Sanofi’s Business Operations and Procurement Strategies.


As Head of Procurement Services, the incumbent will partner closely with the Head of Business Operations and the Chief Procurement Officer and his leadership to lead a team of shared service and procurement professionals focused on driving the implementation of simple, standard and efficient procurement services, unlocking value and enhancing productivity through innovation, scale and delivery excellence.


Key Responsibilities:


Partner with the Chief Procurement Officer and Procurement Leadership team to: (a) develop a structured and well-defined enterprise Procurement strategy; (b) define and embed to-be agreed target operating model and governance framework, including roles, responsibilities, and ownership accountabilities; and (c) establish a standard set of functional-level performance metrics and service-line specific KPIs to measure Progress and value delivery.


  • Lead Procurement Services organization of ~600 Sanofians and oversee efforts of strategic BPO partner responsible for the delivery and execution of Sanofi’s Business Operations and Procurement strategy; grow operational footprint in-line with broader GBO and Hub operating model, leveraging existing Hub locations in Bogota, Budapest, Hyderabad and Kuala Lumpur

  • Productivity Initiatives     – develop and run formal program and process for identifying enterprise-wide savings opportunities and prospective new services leveraging advanced analytics, process mining and other innovative techniques; partner with GBO Business Partnership & Transformation lead to transition into implementation then drive and track value and benefits delivery.

  • Source to Pay     – lead the design, development, implementation, and ongoing execution of enterprise Source to Pay transformation, driving best-in-class simplification of global end-to-end process excellence in partnership with Finance and Procurement, including sourcing lifecycle management, contracting, vendor master data management, indirect purchasing, invoice reception and processing, payments, travel and expense management, tail spend management and supplier relationship management.

  • Contract and Compliance Management     – establish a simple and standard global end-to-end contract life cycle management process for 3rd party contracts; govern and oversee supplier performance through the transition and ongoing growth of supplier contract compliance and audit program.

  • Risk Management     – Partner with Head of Procurement Risk Management and Supplier Diversity to transform the delivery and execution of existing third-party risk management, sustainability, and supplier diversity operations to ensure process efficiency and compliance with corporate standards and external regulations.

  • Analytics and Insights     – Design, develop and execute advanced analytics strategy for GBO and Procurement, including spend analytics and category reporting, Procurement performance tracking and GBO performance monitoring and reporting.

  • Lead the Global Meeting & Events organization to establish standardized, compliant, and cost-efficient end-to-end meetings and events management; ensure alignment with procurement and compliance standards across all GBUs and functions.

  • Govern the Transparency organization to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant reporting in accordance with applicable regulations; strengthen data quality and audit readiness.

  • Establish and maintain strong stakeholder and customer relationships with GBU, R&D, M&S and Corporate Functions Executive Committee members, their teams and the 2nd line of defense (IC&P, E&BI) to drive simplification and standardization and strengthen the control environment across the organization.

  • Create an organization of change agents through the management and development of Global Business Operations staff and functions BPO provider – provide open, honest, and valuable feedback on the performance of team members and BPO in support of individual and functional-level goals and objectives.

  • Innovate, drive and support the continuous improvement of Business Operations and Procurement Services processes and procedures through the development and adoption of a standard global process ownership and global process lead framework.

  • Demonstrate and maintain domain expertise, as well as working knowledge of Pharma/Biotech industry, staying current on developments in Business Operations, Shared Services and Procurement.


About you

Required:

  • Degree in Business Studies, Accounting, Finance, or other business discipline
  • 15+ of experience in complex, global transformations, strategy, operations and/or consulting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; effective collaborator with strong trust-building and influencing skills
  • Ability to think strategically, innovate, and execute a plan.
  • Results-oriented with strong analytics skills; ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate information with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time.


Preferred·

  • MBA or other advanced degree.
  • Experience in healthcare and/or life-science industry.
  • Experience in establishing and developing shared service capabilities and services.
  • Leadership and management skills demonstrating integrity and professionalism.
  • Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and intellectual curiosity
  • Developed business partnering, collaboration, and interpersonal skills required.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with and influence senior level stakeholders.
  • Ability to work transversally and within a highly matrixed environment
  • Global or international experience and ability to work with a diverse team.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Who We Are

Building the AI-first frontier enterprise.

We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI-first approach-Gen-e2. It redefines how enterprises build digital products and transform their organizations with AI. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We’re proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

  • We are small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally (10 countries, 450+ experts from 50+ nationalities)

  • We are becoming an agentic organization, adopting the AI-native operating model we bring to our clients

  • We are robust and resilient (100% independent, 0 debt, founded 2009)

  • We are AI-native professionals who invest in what we believe and work as a collective intelligence

  • We are positive, courageous and deliver at the leading edge

Your Role

As Head of Engineering at PALO IT Labs, reporting directly to the CTO, you are the operational engine of our engineering organisation. You translate strategy into daily execution, lead our AI engineering community, and ensure every team-client-facing or product-side-delivers at the highest standard.

Where the CTO sets direction and makes structural architectural decisions, you make those decisions real. You own the day-to-day: team health, engineering standards, roadmap execution, and the development of our AI engineers. You are the technical authority your teams rely on to unblock, challenge and grow-while the CTO focuses on vision, key clients, and long-term positioning.

Engineering Excellence

  • Deploy the Gen-e² technology roadmap defined by the CTO: architecture governance, AI governance, and factory standards (agents, prompts, rules, pipelines) across all squads

  • Own the token economics of our delivery, balancing model cost, latency and quality across squads, so “AI-first” means production-grade, not prototype-grade

  • Operate one level above Lead Engineers: arbitrate divergences, challenge local decisions, spot systemic debt and keep the bar rising as execution becomes increasingly agentic

  • Deploy on our most complex client engagements as the senior technical authority: design AI-first architectures and see them through to production-you ship, not slide decks

  • Step in as Tech Lead on client projects when needed: if a mission requires it, you can take the technical lead role directly, ensuring continuity and quality without waiting for a resource to be available

  • Define and enforce engineering standards: CI/CD practices, code reviews, incident management, and security posture across squads

  • Own technical incidents and escalations with clear ownership and post-mortems

People & Community

  • Directly manage Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) and later AI tech leads and - their growth, performance, workload and career paths are yours

  • Own the engineering community’s rituals end to end: critiques, showcases, community days, learning circles and the shared knowledge base that keeps them visible, inclusive and connected to real delivery challenges

  • Foster cross-project collaboration by connecting engineers facing similar challenges, surfacing reusable patterns, and turning field learnings into shared standards

  • Set the community’s norms and health signals: champion psychological safety, experimentation, wellbeing and sustainable pace, and run lightweight pulse checks to catch issues early

  • Build the mentorship engine: create structures and learning pathways for Senior Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers, and grow the technical leadership bench

  • Operate the hiring process for engineering roles: sourcing strategy, interviews, technical assessments and recommendations to the CTO

  • Partner with delivery and staffing teams to maintain visibility of capacity and utilisation, support staffing decisions, and turn bench time into meaningful learning, R&D or community contribution

Gen-e2 Practice & R&D

  • Feed everything back into Gen-e²: what you learn on live engagements becomes standards, artefacts, prompts and learning paths for the whole firm, in collaboration with international teams

  • Produce and own engineering KPIs: velocity, quality, incident rate, technical debt, and team health; report regularly to the CTO

  • Represent the engineering practice in leadership forums and working groups, communicate regularly on team health and needs, escalate risks promptly, and uphold PALO IT values, confidentiality, information security and professional standards

  • Contribute to pre-sales through technical scoping, estimation, proposal input and executive-level advisory, ensuring commercial promises remain grounded in production-grade engineering reality

Who You Are

  • You bring 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of an engineering organisation or practice (VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Head of Tech, or CTO of a scale-up)

  • You have delivered production-grade AI-first systems, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration-and you think in token economics (cost, latency, quality tradeoffs) as naturally as you think in code. You master AI coding assistants as a force multiplier: you still code, by choice

  • You have led delivery in complex, client-facing environments (consulting, embedded squads, platform modernisation) with real users, real constraints and real accountability

  • You are a proven people developer and manager, with a track record of scaling engineering practices-not just individuals-through mentorship, community-building and hands-on AI adoption

  • You think in systems and write things down: architecture decisions under uncertainty, ADRs, standards that make quality reproducible

  • You are fluent at every altitude, from engineering stand-ups to leadership forums, and you switch between them in the same afternoon

  • You lead with care and exigence: high expectations held with accountability in a psychologically safe environment

  • You know how to read team signals early: engagement, workload imbalance, burnout risk, retention risk and under-utilisation, and you act with care, clarity and accountability

  • You care about Tech for Good: sustainability, accessibility and responsible AI are embedded in how you build

  • You are comfortable partnering with HR on hiring strategy, interviews, portfolio reviews, offer decisions and talent-pipeline building through community engagement and events

  • Bilingual French/English, English is mandatory for client and international collaboration

  • Nice to have: cloud architecture certifications (AWS SA, GCP/Azure Professional), public speaking or publications on AI-first delivery

More About PALO IT

Our mission is to become the most advanced consulting company when it comes to AI-First product and software engineering. 100% of our projects are focused on deploying our Gen-e2 methodology to clients to help them accelerate delivery and scale those new practices.


  • A playground matching your expertise: missions chosen for their complexity, engineering excellence, and meaningful business and societal impact.

  • Dedicated career coaching with regular development check-ins and goal support.

  • A demanding yet supportive technical community: code reviews, pair programming, mentoring to raise development craft daily.

  • Gen-e² skill ramp-up from week 1, fully integrated onboarding.

  • Funded Microsoft and GitHub certifications.

  • From idea to impact: internal R&D labs, default open source culture, tech conferences, and innovation dojos to experiment and share.


…Plus

  • Global career opportunities with cross-sector and multi-country missions, connecting 11 offices worldwide.

  • Remote-friendly arrangements depending on project needs, alternating client sites and Paris office for team collaboration.

  • Impact Academy: training on climate, digital responsibility, and accessibility embedded in everyday practices.

  • Solidarity engagements: team volunteering, skills sponsorship, and more.

  • Benefits including Swile meal vouchers and Alan health insurance.

For more on our team culture and benefits, check out our careers page.

PALO IT Labs is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions will be based on merit, qualifications and abilities. PALO IT Labs does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexuality, national origin, age, disability, marital status or any other characteristics protected by law.

Protecting your privacy and the security of your data are longstanding top priorities for PALO IT. Your data will be processed to manage PALO IT’s recruitment-related activities. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.palo-it.com/en/privacy-policy) to know more about how we collect, use, and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: Head of B2B E-commerce - France
description:
Just imagine shaping how shoppers discover and buy LEGO® products across France’s biggest digital retail channels. Then make it real.



About the role

As our Head of B2B E-commerce, you'll lead the strategic and sustainable growth of the LEGO® eCommerce business in France, with particular focus on our top strategic clients. You'll put shoppers at the center, improving online and mobile and omni-channel experiences across third-party retailers and marketplaces. You'll lead the eCommerce team and help shape the local digital agenda as part of the France Leadership Team.



Please note: Relocation support is not available for this role.



Required Qualifications

  • Delivered results in eCommerce retail environments, with proven experience growing digital commerce.
  • Led digital transformation initiatives that created meaningful change in a business or retail environment.
  • Implemented technology solutions and ecosystems supporting digital commerce and shopper experiences.
  • Managed teams and developed people and digital capabilities.
  • Negotiated successfully with commercial, retail or other business stakeholders.
  • Used data from multiple sources to inform commercial decisions and improve performance.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Worked with technology, advertising technology, algorithm or agency providers to optimise or automate business flows.
  • Built experience across eCommerce platforms and marketplaces, including exposure to social or voice commerce.


What you'll build

  • Grow the eCommerce business sustainably with our most strategic clients.
  • Improve product findability, viewability, shoppability and measurability.
  • Strengthen data-informed decision making across partners, markets and the LEGO ecosystem.
  • Develop technology and tools that support shoppers and internal teams.
  • Identify emerging retail trends and work with partners to influence change.
  • Build an inclusive, accountable eCommerce team while developing digital capability.


If you've worked in a role where you combined eCommerce retail, technology and digital transformation, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is bringing those capabilities together while developing people and making considered, data-informed decisions.



Life on the team

You'll join eCommerce in Western Europe and the France business unit. The team focuses on making digital shopping simpler and more effective wherever shoppers choose to buy LEGO products. We work with a hybrid rhythm, combining regular time together in the office with flexibility to work remotely on other days. You'll collaborate closely, take ownership and help others develop.



What success looks like

You'll strengthen sustainable eCommerce growth and deepen results with strategic clients while raising the quality of digital shopper experiences. Over the next 12–18 months, you'll help advance data-informed decisions, technology and retail innovation. You'll work closely with the eCommerce team, France Leadership Team, retail partners, technology providers, Western Europe B2B eCommerce colleagues and teams across the wider LEGO organisation.



#li-ph

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect:

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

title: Head of CSM
description:
Reporting to the CCO (chief customer officer), you lead the CSM team for our Strategic Accounts: our largest and most complex portfolio. Same NRR mandate as the other segments, a different game entirely. Here you sit across from Directors and C-level, and a single account decision moves the numbers.

The goal: build a team that holds its own at that level and turns account strategy into real expansion.

Your missions

  • Manage, coach and upskill an international team of 12 CSM across France, Spain, the UK with the support of one team lead reporting to you

  • Drive NRR on the strategic portfolio: retention, churn reduction, upsell and expansion opportunity detection.

  • Raise the team's account strategy game: account mapping, stakeholder mapping, , driving ROI and creating account plans and QBRs worthy of a Director-level audience.

  • Be the senior voice in the room. Step in with your CSMs on key accounts and complex conversations, and make sure the team knows how to hold that level of dialogue.

  • Own escalations and act as the voice of the customer internally: complex client situations, at-risk accounts, cross-team resolution.

  • Nurture high-potential GEM accounts and turn them into references.

  • Build the performance culture: KPIs (retention, churn, upsell, CSAT), forecast reviews, individual action plans and development plans.

  • Sharpen the team's commercial reflexes: co-selling with Sales, objection handling, negotiation.

  • Recruit, onboard and structure the team as the segment grows (including open Senior CSM roles).

  • Work closely with Sales, Support, Product and the other CSM segments.

This role is for you if...

  • You have at least 3 years of team management experience, ideally including managing a Team Lead or a multi-site team.

  • You come from Customer Success, Account Management or Sales, with solid SaaS experience on large or strategic accounts.

  • You're credible in front of Directors and C-level: you've owned complex accounts yourself and you know what good account strategy looks like.

  • You have a track record on NRR, expansion and churn reduction, and you can show how you got there.

  • You're comfortable leading a team spread across several countries and cultures.

  • You know Hubspot; Salesforce and Zendesk are a plus.

  • You're at ease with data and a growth-oriented approach.

  • AI applied to Customer Success is a real plus for you.

  • You're fluent in French and English; Spanish is a bonus.

  • On the mindset side: senior presence, resilient, highly structured, calm under escalation, unifying yet demanding.

This role is not for you if...

  • You want to keep a portfolio of your own and stay hands-on day to day. This role is about coaching, strategy and escalation, not running the accounts yourself.

  • You see Customer Success as a support function rather than a growth one.

  • You're not comfortable challenging, coaching and growing an already experienced and senior team.

  • Facing Directors, pushing back and holding commercial conversations isn't your comfort zone.

  • A distributed, multi-country, fast-moving environment drains you rather than energises you.

Why this role is exciting

You take the reins of Ringover's most strategic portfolio, with an experienced team already in place and an international scope from day one. The accounts are there, the talent is there: it's up to you to build the enterprise Customer Success playbook, unlock expansion where it counts, and leave your mark on how Ringover serves its biggest clients.

Joining Ringover also means enjoying benefits designed so you can work in the best possible conditions:

️ Your health is our priority

  • Premium health insurance covered 100%

  • Moka.care: coaches and psychologists available in full confidentiality

  • ClassPass: hundreds of classes and gyms funded by Ringover

Well set up, wherever you are

  • Remote work + monthly allowance and home-office budget (chair + screen) so you're just as comfortable at home as at the office

We make your commute easier

  • Sustainable mobility package up to €700/year — Navigo pass reimbursed at 50% or fuel allowance depending on your mode of transport

️ Everyday life at the office

  • Meal vouchers + on-site company restaurant

‍‍ Your family matters too

  • 5 fully paid "Sick Child" days per year up to age 12

You grow, we support you

  • Ringover Academy + internal AI training to keep growing with us

For us, compensation is not a taboo subject! We'll talk about it very early on . We'll offer you the fairest package based on your experience.

title: Head of Sales France & Belux H/F
description:
Richemont, one of the world leaders in the luxury sector, has various Houses specializing in jewelry, watches and high-end accessories. Each Maison proudly embodies a tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont strives to preserve the heritage and identity specific to each of them. At the same time, we are committed to innovating and designing new products in line with the values of our Houses, through a process of permanent creativity.

POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI RECHERCHENT L’EXCELLENCE

Rejoignez l’une des Maisons emblématiques de la haute horlogerie, où l’excellence est une exigence constante.

POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI TISSENT DES LIENS

Rejoignez une communauté où l’expertise individuelle et les expériences collectives font émerger des idées nouvelles.

POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI CULTIVENT LA TRANSMISSION

Rejoignez une Maison où la transmission du savoir-faire est en constante évolution, s’appuyant sur notre patrimoine pour ouvrir la voie à un avenir encore plus radieux.

VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON

Vacheron Constantin France est à la recherche de son futur Head of Sales. Sa mission principale consistera à élaborer et à déployer une stratégie commerciale ambitieuse, visant à dynamiser la croissance, à renforcer la présence de la marque et à atteindre les objectifs commerciaux sur l'ensemble des canaux de distribution du marché France/Belux.

Nous nous adressons à un leader stratégique, doté d'une connaissance approfondie du marché de l'horlogerie de luxe, d'un sens commercial affûté et d'une expérience confirmée dans la gestion des réseaux de distribution retail et wholesale. Si vous êtes passionné par un environnement dynamique où vision, initiative et collaboration sont les piliers du succès, nous serions ravis de vous accueillir au sein de nos équipes.

VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER

Vous serez chargé de concevoir et de déployer une stratégie commerciale ambitieuse et globale pour les marchés français et Belux. À ce titre, vous définirez et piloterez des objectifs de vente exigeants sur l’ensemble des canaux de distribution, tout en assurant un suivi précis des performances, une analyse approfondie des tendances du marché ainsi que l’élaboration de prévisions et de reportings stratégiques à destination de la direction.

Garant de l’excellence opérationnelle et d’une expérience client irréprochable, vous superviserez l’ensemble de notre réseau : boutiques en propre et partenaires, distribution wholesale ainsi que la plateforme e-commerce. Vous veillerez à optimiser l’assortiment produits et le merchandising afin de maximiser la performance commerciale et la rentabilité.

En parallèle, vous identifierez et développerez de nouvelles opportunités de croissance en entretenant des relations privilégiées avec les clients clés, les VIP et les segments de clientèle à fort potentiel. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes Marketing et Communication afin de concevoir et déployer des initiatives locales, des événements exclusifs et des activations clients à fort impact.

Enfin, vous incarnerez un leadership inspirant, humain et fédérateur, capable d’accompagner, de motiver et de faire évoluer une équipe de haut une équipe de haut niveau composée d'un directeur de boutique, de conseillers de vente et de merchandiser/business analyst. Votre management encouragera une culture d’excellence, une forte orientation client et une dynamique d’amélioration continue.

LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER

Vous justifiez de plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans des fonctions de leadership commercial au sein des univers du luxe, de la haute horlogerie ou de la joaillerie. Vous possédez une compréhension approfondie des attentes, des comportements et des leviers d’engagement d’une clientèle luxe, locale comme internationale.

Stratège doté d’une vision claire et d’un excellent sens du business, vous évoluez avec aisance dans des environnements dynamiques et collaboratifs, et faites preuve d’une forte capacité d’adaptation dans des contextes en constante évolution.

Votre leadership, à la fois humble, inspirant et porté par une grande intelligence émotionnelle, vous permet de fédérer, accompagner et faire grandir des équipes de haut niveau.

Vous bénéficiez également d’une solide expertise des réseaux retail, wholesale et partenaires, avec un parcours démontrant votre capacité à atteindre et dépasser des objectifs ambitieux dans des environnements multicanaux complexes.

Enfin, vous maîtrisez couramment le français et l’anglais et êtes disponible pour des déplacements réguliers en France et au Belux.

Vacheron Constantin célèbre 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux.

Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature.

VOTRE EXPERIENCE CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS

Postulez directement en ligne.

Si votre profil correspond à notre recherche, vous serez contacté par notre équipe Talent pour un entretien. Vous rencontrerez par la suite le Brand Manager, la Directrice Recrutement et l'équipe managériale HQ.

Dans le cas contraire, vous recevrez un courriel vous informant que votre candidature n'a pas abouti.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

title: Head of Finance
description:
Context

250+ local authorities rely on Vizzia to keep their streets cleaner and safer. Growing from there means deciding faster: which contracts to push, which products to price differently, where the next euro goes. Those calls need numbers that are current, not numbers that land three weeks after the month has closed.

That is what this role is for. We are looking for a Head of Finance to own the finance function end to end: the monthly close, the cash position, the budget and the plan, and the reporting that tells the company where margin is actually made. A good part of the job is building the plumbing before running it, so that inventory and CRM data feeds the reporting on its own and a five day close holds month after month.

Vizzia sells hardware and software to public sector clients, which means real physical flows, real working capital, and a business plan that moves with prices and sales.

What You'll Do

1. Close the month and steer the cash

  • Produce the P&L and the cash position within five working days of month end

  • Own the monthly close and keep the calendar predictable enough that the rest of the company plans around it

  • Run the cash rather than only report it: working capital, collections, payment terms

  • Keep the reporting fine enough to read margin at contract and product level, not only consolidated

2. Build the data chain behind the numbers

  • Connect the inventory and CRM data to the reporting so figures arrive automatically instead of being reconciled by hand

  • Set up the reporting and modelling foundations the company relies on to decide

3. Own the budget, the plan and the forecast

  • Build the annual budget and hold it against actuals

  • Reforecast frequently as sales come in and prices move, rather than rebuilding the plan once a year

  • Rework the plan quickly when the product trajectory shifts

4. Be the finance voice for the leadership team and the board

  • Produce a consistent board pack and the investor reporting that goes with it, and hold your own in the conversations it opens

  • Say where margin is actually made, down to individual contracts, and act on it through supplier contract reviews and longer client commitments

  • Run scenarios that give the leadership team the reading keys on strategic trade-offs, without blocking initiatives in a company that takes deliberate risks

5. Build the function

  • Manage the finance team (accounting and FP&A) and make each person autonomous on their scope

  • Keep the company fundraise ready, including the data room

Who You Are

  • You have built financial reporting yourself, close included, and can explain how the numbers are produced, not only what they say. Cash is something you steer, not only something you report.

  • You have worked in a business with real physical flows: inventory, purchasing, supply. You know what it takes to get reliable figures out of a chain that was never designed for reporting.

  • You have owned a budget and run the plan as a living model, reforecast against actual sales and moving prices rather than set once a year.

  • You take a position and hold it. You can say where margin is actually made, down to the contract, and defend that reading in front of a leadership team.

  • You know what good investor reporting looks like, and a financing conversation does not intimidate you.

  • You have been through scale-up growth, where processes change every few months, and you are hands on enough to lead that change yourself.

At Vizzia we care about precision, ownership, and getting things moving. This role is based in Paris.

Compensation & Benefits

On Target Earnings ranging from 80k€ to 120k€ + BSPCE
Hybrid work
Contrat cadre and RTT (between 8 and 12 days per year depending on public holidays)
A Mac or PC depending on your preferences
60% coverage of meal vouchers worth €9 per worked day
/ Sustainable mobility allowance
Mutuelle (Alan)
Offices located in central Paris (9th arrondissement)
Annual offsite with the whole team and plenty of company events

If you've read this far, you're probably very interested in the role and/or Vizzia. We'd like to hear from you even if you feel you don't check every box.

title: Head of Brand (Relocation to Milan)
description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Milan office.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.

  • Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.

  • Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.

  • Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.

  • Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.

  • Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who we're looking for

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

  • 10+ years of experience - Proven track record in brand management or creative direction, ideally within fast-growing tech companies or top-tier creative agencies.

  • Strong Technical & Visual Culture - Deep understanding of design systems, rebranding processes, and multi-channel campaign production (from social media to TV/OOH).

  • A "Hands-on" Leader - You love to lead by example. You're not just a "manager of resources" but someone who can get into the details of a layout or a script to ensure excellence.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.
