title: Head of Customer Insights, Europe
description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

As the Head of Customer Insights, Europe, you will be responsible for elevating both Adyen's voice and the voice of our merchants across the payments ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of deep customer research, industry influence, and executive thought leadership, ensuring that Adyen is not only delivering exceptional experiences but also shaping the future of commerce alongside its customers.

You will lead critical insight initiatives, including European Customer Advisory Boards, executive engagement programs, and merchant research communities. By translating customer feedback into market strategy and amplifying merchant perspectives externally, you will help position Adyen as a trusted strategic partner and industry leader.

A key focus of this role is converting Adyen's deep expertise into compelling market narratives, actionable insights, and influential industry participation. You will leverage Adyen's global merchant base and scale to proactively debate and influence partners, industry bodies, and regulatory stakeholders, ensuring both Adyen and its customers shape the European payment landscape.


What You'll Do

1. Thought Leadership & Brand Amplification

  • Develop and publish high-impact thought leadership content that showcases Adyen's domain expertise and merchant success.
  • Lead executive conference speaking strategy, serving as a key spokesperson at high-profile events.
  • Partner with Marketing, PR, and Communications to amplify Adyen's brand through media, analyst relations, and industry channels.
  • Drive event strategy and prioritization to maximize customer and market impact across Europe.

2. Industry & Regulatory Influence

  • Confidently debate and present on European payment trends, card network rules, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., PSD3, open banking, instant payments).
  • Represent Adyen in key industry boards, forums, and working groups, translating complex regulatory developments into actionable insights.
  • Influence external stakeholders, including card networks and partners, by representing both Adyen and merchant perspectives.
  • Proactively leverage Adyen's scale and customer base to drive meaningful ecosystem change.

3. Customer Insights & Advisory

  • Design, launch, and steward the Customer Advisory Board for strategic merchants across Europe.
  • Build and scale merchant feedback communities and executive engagement programs to capture real-time market needs.
  • Partner cross-functionally to integrate customer perspectives directly into internal product innovation lifecycles and commercial strategies.

Who You Are

  • Core Industry Knowledge: 5+ years of deep, hands-on domain experience within the payments, acquiring, or merchant fintech ecosystem.
  • Regulatory & Market Fluency: Ability to confidently debate and present on European payment trends, card network rules, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., PSD3, open banking, instant payments).
  • Proven Public Speaker: Proven track record as a keynote speaker, panelist, or executive moderator at industry conferences and client events (portfolio or speaking samples preferred).
  • Customer Research & Insights: Demonstrated ability to shape product strategy, roadmaps, and business decision-making through customer insights and market feedback.
  • Executive Presence: Proven track record building and scaling Customer Advisory Boards, engaging enterprise accounts, and influencing C-suite stakeholders.
  • Ecosystem Influence: Experience representing a company in industry forums and influencing external stakeholders (e.g., regulators, card networks, partners).
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to lead strategic initiatives in a global, matrixed organization.
  • Mindset: Strategic, entrepreneurial thinker with exceptional storytelling abilities and a passion for elevating the customer voice.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you're from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What's next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don't be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of one of our European offices. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

title: Strategic Project Manager - Paris - CDI
description:
Who are they?

Orus is a European insurtech growing fast, with a lot of ambition. The idea was born from a simple observation: professional insurance is too complex and inefficient. Professionals don't know what coverage they need, how and when it applies, and often end up powerless or poorly protected. Orus is therefore the insurance professionals have been waiting for: simple, fast, transparent, and above all human.

At the heart of our mission:

  • A simple and understandable user experience

  • Putting technology at the service of tomorrow's insurance

To make this happen, Côme, Tom and Samuel, Orus's co-founders, have raised a total of €41 million, including a Series B round in 2025, giving them the opportunity to be backed by top funds and private investors, including the CEOs of Pennylane and Hiscox Europe

Today, Orus keeps growing at a steady pace, with a rollout in France, Spain, and the Netherlands, and an accelerating pace of new insurance product launches (3 in 2025, about a dozen planned for 2026, and around twenty for 2027).

Why join us?

  • You'll work in a fast-growing startup, within the Strategy team

  • A senior team from top-tier consulting firms (BCG) or top scale-ups (PayFit, Qonto, Alan, Doctolib)

  • And we're already the French people's favorite insurtech, with 4.9 stars on TrustPilot :)

The role

Orus is growing fast, and we're launching more and more strategic projects. Each project is becoming more complex and requires more analysis, preparation, and depth. To support this momentum, we need a cross-functional profile able to drive and follow these initiatives across the whole company.

You'll join the Strategic Project Manager team and report to Axel Compain, Director of Strategy, Finance & Data. You'll be able to lead a wide range of topics: launching new insurance products, developing cross-sell strategy, internationalization, reducing churn... What these projects have in common: they're cross-functional and will put you in constant contact with all of Orus's teams, who are eagerly awaiting your arrival.

Missions

You'll lead cross-functional strategic projects within the Strategy team. Among the major ongoing or upcoming projects:

Example of strategic projects

  • Contribute to defining Orus's strategy for the coming years

  • Collaborate with the acquisition teams to monitor performance and define a roadmap to improve economic profitability & results

  • Develop cross-sell (customer base segmentation, competitive analysis, pricing, Ops model redesign, targeted communications)

  • Lead the in-housing of claims handling (currently outsourced)

  • Support Orus's international expansion: which markets to prioritize next, and how to enter them

  • Control and reduce churn

  • Launch new insurance products in France and internationally

Candidate profile

  • You hold a Master's degree from a top-tier business or engineering school.

  • You have 3-5 years of prior experience in consulting, strategy, or as a Strategic Project Manager at a startup/scale-up

  • You know how to break down complex problems into simple sub-problems to bring teams on board

  • You have strong analytical and pragmatic skills: no need for ultra-complex analysis, you know how to pull out the 2-3 key insights and talk numbers simply

  • You use AI daily to move faster

  • You're efficient: you meet your deadlines, juggle several topics in parallel, and communicate well when there's a delay

  • You know how to ramp up quickly

  • You know how to drive projects end-to-end and are accountable for results, even in ambiguity

  • You speak fluent English & French

Interview process

  • Screening with our Talent Acquisition team (20 min)

  • Manager interview with Axel, Head of Strategy, Finance & Data (45min)

  • Business case with Axel and Hugo, Strategic Project Manager (1h30)

  • Fit interview with 3 team members, including the CEO & COO (3x30min)

We're able to make you a hiring offer within 10 days of our first contact!

title: Head of Programmatic Trading Europe
description:
Role Summary

The Head of Trading owns the performance, standards, and people leadership of the European trading team, ensuring campaigns are executed to the highest standard across markets while acting as the internal authority on programmatic and platform best practice. The role blends hands-on trading (60% of time), team management, resource allocation, and cross-functional partnership with Client Services and other departments to drive results for Tier 1 clients.

Core Duties

Team & delivery leadership

  • Oversee the day-to-day delivery of the European trading team, providing priorities, guidance, and mentorship to ensure delivery and performance targets are met

  • Own team development end-to-end: hiring, coaching, performance management, and career-pathing for traders

  • Allocate trading resources according to business priorities and workload across countries

  • Responsible for the outputs of the trading department across all business units (countries)

Trading & platform execution

  • Execute campaign setup across platforms, monitor performance, and optimize strategies (~60% of time)

  • Establish and deploy best practices across campaign setup, QA/troubleshooting, and reporting, acting as the internal authority on programmatic buying

  • Drive structured testing and experimentation across DSPs and partner platforms, evaluating results rigorously to inform trading strategy

  • Contribute to improving the internal monitoring and reporting suite

Partnerships & stakeholder management

  • Manage the relationship with external partners supplementing the team when business requires it

  • Collaborate with the Head of CS/Account Managers to develop media trading strategies aligned with the campaign goals and objectives of Tier 1 clients

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with creative, account management, and product teams to align strategy and execution

  • Feed trading insights and advertiser feedback back into product and platform roadmap discussions

Market awareness

  • Stay current on industry trends, advertising technologies, platform updates, and new tools to keep the agency competitive

What You Need to Succeed

Experience

  • At least 8 years of professional experience on a trading desk (agency or sales house)

  • 3+ years of successful experience as a team leader/manager in programmatic digital advertising

  • International experience is a plus

  • Track record of establishing and scaling trading best practices, playbooks, and QA processes across multiple markets

Technical & domain knowledge

  • Hands-on experience with the main DSPs available in the market (DV360, Xandr,TTD)

  • Solid understanding of the mobile ecosystem (mandatory)

  • Understanding of the digital out-of-home (DOOH) ecosystem; hands-on experience is a plus

  • Familiarity with a leading brand safety, fraud prevention, or attention measurement platform

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, comfortable working with large datasets; coding/scripting experience is a plus

Soft skills & languages

  • Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, both internally and with external partners

  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed environment

  • English and French proficiency (mandatory)

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Our Mission

Money sitting idle is money lost. We're fixing that.

Founded in 2023 by Antoine and Paul-Adrien, Spiko gives businesses, non-profits, financial advisers, and fintechs access to institutional-grade cash management, via app or API. We are building the full infrastructure: issuing, operating, and distributing the products ourselves.

Two years after launch, we serve thousands of organizations across Europe and process hundreds of millions of euros in flows every month.

Our ambition: become the world's leading treasury management infrastructure in a market worth trillions.

We are backed by Index Ventures, the CEO of Revolut, the founder of Kyriba, and the CTO of Wise.

Spiko runs on excellence, transparency, and straight talk.

The role: Head of Engineering

Spiko's engineering team is 8 top-tier engineers today. It will triple over the coming year. Your job is to make that scaling succeed while maintaining a very high bar on talent, velocity, and quality.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a strategist seat. You'll organize the work of Spiko’s tech team, review architecture, and go deep on the hardest technical problems. You’ll own hiring, org design, processes, and delivery.

Two things make engineering at Spiko different:

  • We're building an AI-native org. AI is central to how we design, build, test, and operate, not a tool we bolt on. You'll define what a 30-person engineering team looks like when every engineer is fully leveraged by AI, and keep pushing that frontier.

  • Engineers are owning the product. There is no thick product layer between the team and users. We think that engineers need to talk to clients, shape the roadmap, and own product decisions end to end. You'll work side by side with the Product team. You'll need product judgment as sharp as your technical judgment.

You'll report directly to Antoine, co-founder, and be based in Paris or London, office first.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own engineering delivery end to end: architecture, quality, velocity, and reliability of systems processing hundreds of millions of euros monthly

  • Triple the team within a year: source, close, and onboard top-tier engineers while keeping an uncompromising talent bar

  • In collaboration with the Product team, design the organization for that scale: team structure, ownership model, incident management, and security and compliance by design

  • Make AI a structural advantage: set the tooling, workflows, and standards that multiply every engineer's output

  • Stay hands-on: code, review, make architecture calls, and unblock the team on the hardest problems

  • Work directly with the founders on technical strategy, build vs. buy, and infrastructure and regulatory choices

Who we’re looking for

An engineering leader who has already done this once: scaled a top-tier team through hypergrowth at an exceptional company, and never stopped being a builder. You measure yourself by what ships, by the caliber of the people you hire, and by how fast the team learns. You want to own product outcomes, not just delivery. And you see AI as the defining shift in how software gets built, with strong opinions and receipts to match.

Requirements (must-haves):

  • A proven track record leading a team of 20+ top-tier engineers

  • Experience at an A+ startup or scale-up, through a phase of rapid growth

  • AI-first by conviction and in practice: AI shapes how you run process, delivery, and vision for an engineering org, and you can show it

  • Hands-on for real: you still write code, review PRs, and go deep on architecture

  • A product-oriented mindset: comfortable leading a team that owns product decisions, with strong opinions on what to build, not just how

  • Exceptional hiring ability with a demonstrated high talent bar

Nice to have:

  • Fintech background, or experience in another regulated, high-stakes domain (payments, banking infrastructure, trading)

  • Experience building and operating financial infrastructure at scale (payments, ledgers, market connectivity)

  • Familiarity with the Paris and/or London engineering talent markets

What we offer

  • Compensation: Competitive package depending on experience + Stock Options

  • Offices: in central Paris & London

  • Remote work: up to 2 days per week and one full remote week per month

  • The best tech for your job: latest-generation laptops and industry-leading software

  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Spiko

  • Monthly Budget to cover different perks of choice

  • Transport: 50% of public transport pass covered or the Forfait Mobilités Durables (FMD)

  • Referral Bonus

  • Social life: regular afterworks and biannual offsites

Our hiring process

  • A screening call with Antoine, co-founder

  • An afternoon of deep-dive:

    • A technical problem session with Nicolas, Tech Lead, and another senior engineer from the team

    • An interview with Nicolas, Tech Lead, and another senior engineer from the team

    • A deep-dive with Antoine on the org of the team, product vision and AI in the tech team

    • A product discussion with one senior member of our product team

  • A culture fit interview with Paul-Adrien, CEO & co-founder

  • Reference Check: we'll reach out to your references to gather further insights

  • Offer

If something here doesn't match your résumé perfectly but you believe you'd thrive in this role, apply anyway. Tell us why.

title: Global Head of Performance Marketing
description:
At Pluxee, we shape the world of employee benefits and engagement by bringing to life a personalized and sustainable employee experience, at work and beyond.

Contractor - Standard


Job Description:

This role drives digital brand visibility, customer engagement, demand generation, and performance optimization through a hub-and-spoke model. It leads the global digital marketing team and collaborates closely with local marketing, product, sales, brand, and IT teams to ensure consistent execution and innovation at scale. This role is essential to advancing Pluxee’s ambition to be a SMART LEADER in employee benefits and engagement by driving digital excellence, data-driven performance, and customer-centric personalization.

YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE Responsibilities: 1. title: Partner Manager - German speaking
description:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.

As the Partner Manager for DACH, you will execute Algolia's partner strategy across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with Germany as the primary focus market. You'll work with consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners to embed Algolia into the multi-technology — increasingly agentic — solutions they build and sell.

This is not a solutions engineering role — you won't be architecting or implementing client solutions. But it is a solutions-focused role: you need real technical fluency, and the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia. In practice, that means identifying and shaping three kinds of agentic solutions: those that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners; those built by our consulting partners and brought to market by them; and those built jointly with technology partners around a shared value proposition that delivers real value to customers and end users. Pipeline development, opportunity progression and customer wins all matter — but they all start with getting the innovation right, with Algolia at the center of it.

Reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships, and working in close collaboration with the General Manager of DACH, you will develop and execute the regional partner strategy — deciding which consulting, systems integration, technology and cloud partners to prioritize, and building the technical and commercial motions that turn those relationships into pipeline and revenue.

Algolia's partner motion in DACH is mature — we've been building relationships in the region for seven years. This role is an opportunity to build on that foundation: taking well-established partnerships to the next level, while also designing and standing up a partner-led growth strategy for the region.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

  • Developing and executing Algolia's partner strategy across DACH, with Germany as the primary focus market alongside Austria and Switzerland
  • Building on seven years of established partner relationships in the region, while designing and executing a new partner-led growth strategy for DACH
  • Building and managing a portfolio of consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) across the region
  • Identifying, recruiting and onboarding new partners into the Algolia Partner Program, with particular attention to partners building agentic and AI-driven solutions
  • Shaping and championing agentic solutions that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners
  • Working with consulting partners to help them build their own agentic solutions on Algolia and bring those solutions to market
  • Developing joint value propositions with technology partners for agentic solutions that deliver real value to customers and end users
  • Acting as a solutions-focused innovator who can inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia
  • Developing a working technical understanding of partner architectures and solutions deep enough to guide partners on where and how Algolia fits — without owning implementation
  • Enabling partners on Algolia's product and technical capabilities so they can position, sell and deliver successfully
  • Owning deal registration, pursuit prioritization and account mapping across the partner portfolio
  • Coordinating go-to-market strategy with partners, including joint marketing, co-selling and technical enablement content
  • Coordinating across partners, internal sales and solutions engineering teams on strategic client pursuits
  • Collaborating closely with the DACH General Manager and regional sales leadership to align partner strategy with revenue goals
  • Collaborating with Algolia Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product and Enablement teams to ensure partner and end client success
  • Owning pipeline creation and data accuracy for the DACH partner portfolio, with reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships — recognizing that strong pipeline, opportunity progression and customer wins all start with the right solution innovation involving Algolia

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:

  • 7-10+ years of experience in a senior Alliance, Channel or Partner role, ideally with technology, cloud or systems integration partners, in a recurring revenue business model
  • Strong technical fluency — comfortable discussing APIs, search/AI architecture, cloud infrastructure and how multiple technologies combine into a single solution, without being a hands-on engineer
  • Familiarity with the emerging landscape of agentic AI and the accelerator programs being built by systems integrators and technology partners
  • Experience working with cloud partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and/or major systems integrators active in the German market (e.g., Accenture, Cognizant, Publicis Groupe, Valtech, Diconium)
  • Business-side understanding of SaaS software, search/AI, headless commerce and API-first architectures
  • A track record of developing and executing regional partner strategy, ideally with strength in the German market and familiarity with Austria and Switzerland
  • Fluency in German (spoken and written) is required, given the primary focus on the German market; fluency in English is also required
  • Salesforce.com experience creating and managing opportunities through the sales cycle, with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Excellent communicator, writer and storyteller, with a strong ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders
  • A history of developing and nurturing long-term industry and partner relationships
  • A history of becoming a trusted advisor to partners, clients and internal stakeholders, including senior leadership
  • A solutions-oriented mindset — genuinely creative and innovative, with the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy across a multi-country region
  • A track record of driving joint co-selling and co-marketing activities
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, both internally and externally

#LI-Hybrid

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia's flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual's impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

  • GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.
  • TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.
  • CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.
  • CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.
  • HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We're looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world's best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice

We've recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

  • Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page.
  • All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an @algolia.com email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an @algolia.com email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.
  • We'll never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details during the hiring process.

READY TO APPLY?

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world's best search & discovery technology, we'd love to review your application!

title: VP Programmatic
description:
Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure.


Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers.
But we don't stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences, across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions.


Our Solutions:

  • Actirise: the display tech designed for performance
  • FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes
  • Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks
  • Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution
  • Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology

Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising.

Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe:


  • FT1000 ranking – Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025

  • The Europas – Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups

  • Pixalate Ranking – #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange

These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act.


  • We are Drivers, not passengers:     We take the wheel and own our results.

  • We are data-obsessed: Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos.

  • We think as one: Collective goals come before personal wins.

  • We trade off: We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results.

  • We solve problems: We own challenges and turn ideas into action.

  • We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding


Discover our journey, products, and culture on our website


Bootstrapped, profitable, and answering only to our own P&L

One thing matters more than the rest for this particular role: Sparteo has taken zero external capital. There is no board pushing pivots, and decisions argued on merit and ROI actually stick. The whole chain is built in-house — Flashbid for header bidding, Meetscale as the SSP, Viously for video, FastCMP for consent, plus the analytics behind them. Nothing you own here is somebody else's black box.

The numbers, instead of adjectives

  • An ad stack built entirely in-house, live on about 4,000 publisher websites.

  • Around 37 billion client-side bidding events processed per day.

  • More than 50 billion bid requests sent to demand partners every day across our platforms.

  • About 45 billion analytics events ingested into our big data storage every day.

  • Prebid Server in production in both official implementations, PBS-Go and the Vert.x-based PBS-Java, plus in-house Go OpenRTB 2.5/2.6 gateways.

  • Multi-cluster Kubernetes on-premise. Our own IAB TCF v2.2 CMP. An ad-integrity stack covering IVT, creative scanning and ads.txt / sellers.json / schain validation.

  • p99 latency and availability SLOs on the bid path, with the dashboards in front of you in week one.

The Mission

Our CTO runs web programmatic engineering himself today. You take it over fully. This is a succession, not a support role: he moves to group-level topics, and you own the domain end to end — architecture, roadmap, build-or-kill calls — as his direct strategic partner. The decision-rights split is written down in your first 30 days, and escalations reroute to you from day one, incidents included.

Your domain is the adtech engineering behind our products: Actirise with Flashbid, our header-bidding ad stack; Viously for video; Meetscale, our SSP; and FastCMP for consent. You lead it through two team leads — one for Client-Side Auction & Rendering (wrapper and rendering), one for Server-Side Auction & Rendering (auction, OpenRTB gateways, bidder integrations) — and the FastCMP engineering team reports to you directly. You own the domain's hiring plan and budget within group envelopes. Your escalation and representation role covers the whole company.

That is the real span: a compact domain of roughly ten engineers. A player-coach role, where authority comes from expertise rather than headcount. If your next step is building a large organization, this is not your role. If you miss being the person people bring the hard problems to, it is.

Your key responsibilities

1. Cross-stack arbitration

  • The interesting problems live at the seam between stacks: client wrapper versus Prebid Server (page weight versus cookie sync and bid-rate loss), where models sit in the bid path, what the Go gateways absorb versus PBS-Java.

  • You make these calls and keep the stacks coherent across Flashbid, Viously, Meetscale and FastCMP.

2. The programmatic roadmap

  • You make the technical and build-or-kill calls across the domain's roadmaps. Product owns commercial priority.

  • Genuine ties escalate to the CTO — which should stay rare by design.

3. Performance and scale

  • Latency and availability SLOs on the bid path, and wrapper Core Web Vitals across about 4,000 sites.

  • Dynamic floors and traffic shaping already run in production, built inside the Server-Side team. Their placement in the path is your call, with clearing-price, win-rate and viewability modelling as the next step.

4. Being the escalation point of last resort

  • You are the adtech expert of the company: client technical crises and the hard monetization questions from Product land on your desk.

  • You are also Sparteo's technical face outside — Prebid, IAB, industry events.

5. Quality and trust

  • TCF/GPP purpose enforcement and consent quality, with FastCMP (our own CMP) in your scope.

  • DSA transparency signalling, supply-chain integrity (schain, sellers.json) and MFA/IVT rigor.

  • Buyers delist MFA inventory and data-protection authorities enforce TCF, so publisher-side quality is a commercial weapon — and here it belongs to engineering.

6. AI-native engineering

  • Claude Code, agents and workflows are how engineering works here, company-wide.

  • You practice agentic development daily and you know where AI accelerates and where it misleads.

Your first 12 months, and how we'll both know it worked

  • The CTO is fully out of web programmatic. You are the recognized decision-maker, internally and with clients.

  • A unified client and server technical roadmap exists, is yours, and is shipping.

  • The bid-path p99 latency and availability SLOs (exact targets are on the dashboards you get in week one) held through traffic growth.

  • Your teams practice AI-native engineering by default, with you as the reference practitioner.


Your profile for this job

  • Must-have

    • 10+ years in engineering, with senior technical leadership in sell-side adtech: ex-CTO, VP Engineering or Head of Programmatic Engineering at a wrapper vendor, an SSP or exchange, or a Prebid-ecosystem player. A buy-side-only background will not fit, because the job is the supply seam.

    • Prebid (client and server) and OpenRTB 2.6, deep and hands-on — current enough to read a live auction trace and to know why plcmt and source.schain exist.

    • Google Ad Manager where it meets header bidding: line items, price granularity, Open Bidding interplay.

    • A current sell-side agenda: client versus s2s trade-offs, TCF/GPP enforcement, DSA transparency, curation and SPO, deal plumbing (PMP, PG), dynamic floors, traffic shaping under DSP QPS caps, MFA and IVT.

    • Wrapper performance under Core Web Vitals: INP and LCP budgets, deferred and chunked auction init, ad-slot CLS, third-party script isolation.

    • The ability to read, review and arbitrate a polyglot estate (Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Java, PHP, Python) on Kubernetes.

    • Daily AI-assisted engineering practice (Claude Code or equivalent agentic tooling) and the will to champion it. This one is non-negotiable.

    • A player-coach temperament, energized rather than frustrated by a compact team.

    • Fluent English.

    Nice-to-have

    • French speaker.

    • Large-scale OLAP analytics experience. ML shipped into a latency-bound bid path.

    • A visible Prebid open-source or IAB working-group track record.

    • Publisher-side privacy depth: consent-string quality, Safari and Firefox signal loss.

    • Video (VAST, CTV) or audio monetization.

Your mind set to share our adventure

  • You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists.

  • You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • ‍️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.

  • Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Benefits & Work Environment

  • Mostly remote, from France: You work mostly remotely. You come to our Lille HQ for the kickoff and for key strategic meetings, more often during your first months.

  • Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment.

  • Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.

  • Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond.

  • Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role.

  • Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for.

  • Ecosystem budget: Conferences and working groups (Prebid Summit and similar) are part of the job, not a favour.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Ready to join Team Sparteo? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process!

Here are the stages in our recruitment process

  • Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset will be held with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

  • Analytical and business logic tests

  • Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including your future manager

  • Taking up references

Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
The Company

Resilience Care is a leading medical remote monitoring player and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is simple: improve patient care.
We build remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, powered by ePRO collection and AI techniques. Our platform helps care teams detect side effects early for continuous and proactive care, while our patient app helps people track and manage symptoms with tailored resources.
Our solutions optimize care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and detailed analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies.
We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

Your Role

In a nutshell

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own initiatives end to end across our three therapeutic areas: Oncology, Gastroenterology and Psychiatry. You will work at the intersection of field needs, clinical expertise, technology and business, with a clear objective: turn a real problem into a delivered and measurable product response.

You will join a fully remote, distributed Product team and report directly to the VP Product. Your mandate will evolve with team priorities: you will not be permanently attached to one business unit or a fixed backlog.

Your impact

  • Deliver a first initiative end to end within three months of joining.

  • Connect every initiative to a measurable outcome such as adoption, field impact, efficiency or business contribution.

  • Build effective collaboration with Medical, Tech, Revenue, KAM, Patient Care and QARA.

  • Use AI to accelerate discovery, prototyping and execution without lowering quality standards.

  • Create at least one AI tool or skill reused by another person or team within your first six months.

Your day-to-day work

  • Lead field discovery and turn needs into clear product problems.

  • Prototype with AI, specify solutions and work with Tech through production release.

  • Collaborate with Medical on clinical validation and with QARA on quality and compliance.

  • Measure adoption and impact after delivery.

  • Keep Product documentation, the semantic library and required QMS evidence current.

Your Team

You will join a Product team with complementary backgrounds, working closely with Medical and Tech as one R&D organisation. The team operates across therapeutic areas: mandates evolve with priorities, and each Product Manager remains accountable for the outcome of their initiatives.

The role is fully remote, like the rest of the team, with an opportunity to meet in person during the annual company offsite.


Candidate Profile

You are the right person if you know how to

  • Turn clinical, field or business needs into clear and measurable product problems.

  • Lead discovery, prototyping, specification, delivery and impact measurement.

  • Use AI in practical ways to accelerate Product work.

  • Align Medical, Tech, commercial, operations and quality teams.

  • Manage by outcomes, connecting adoption, user impact and business priorities.

You are the right person if you have

  • Strong end-to-end ownership.

  • Clear and concise communication across different audiences.

  • A collaborative mindset and the habit of seeking and sharing expertise.

  • The ability to make trade-offs and their consequences visible.

  • High standards for quality, documentation and measurement.

You are the right person if you have already

  • Built at least seven years of Product Management experience.

  • Shipped an AI-enabled product, tool or skill used in real conditions beyond a prototype or proof of concept.

  • Owned complex initiatives from discovery through impact measurement.

  • Worked with multidisciplinary teams in healthcare or across healthcare systems.

  • Used English fluently in a professional setting.

It is a plus if you have experience with regulated products, a quality management system or hospital information systems.

Why join us?

  • Work on products connecting care-team needs, patient experience and technology.

  • Own initiatives end to end rather than only managing a backlog.

  • Embed AI into everyday Product practice and share what you build.

  • Join a distributed team where decisions and learning are documented.

Recruitment Process

  • Screening with Talent Acquisition Elena — 20 minutes.

  • Managerial interview with the VP Product — 30 minutes.

  • Business case with the VP Product and Lauren, Head of Engineering — four working days of preparation, followed by a 45-minute presentation.

  • Final panel — four 30-minute interviews with the CMO, a Product Manager, a General Manager and a Head of Business Unit. The panel also assesses culture fit and professional English.

GDPR : Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. They will be available only for people involved in the process and erased after 2 years of inactivity.

Under GDPR and as Resilience attach great importance to privacy, please note that you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased. The Data Protection Officer can be contacted at privacy@resilience.care

For more information, please check our privacy policy.

title: Head of GTM Systems & AI
description:
Introduction to the Team & Role

What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
  • Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
  • Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
  • Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
  • Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
  • Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

What You'll Do

Within 1 month, you will:
  • Know the team, the stack, and the cross-functional leaders and teams you’ll partner with
  • Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
  • Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.

Within 3 months, you will:
  • Have taken one major cross-functional change from plan to done
  • Own the full vendor-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.

Within 6 months, you will:
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
  • Have shipped at least one AI agent that watches business data and reaches people on its own, with a named business owner and outcome measures agreed before launch.
  • Have a 12-18 month roadmap, setting the high-level vision across our systems infrastructure, ways of working, and AI portfolio

Within 12 months, you will:
  • Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.
  • Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
  • Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI-native operations

The Skill Set

  • 5+ years across GTM systems, agentic/AI workflow products, revenue technology, enterprise SaaS — or an adjacent path like technical product management or consulting where you designed and shipped real systems with a strong AI mandate.
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable tooling — you read a process, tell whether it's any good, spot where AI creates value, and judge when to automate (and when not to), across the full revenue engine.
  • Have fluency in modern GTM systems: Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, routing, attribution, lead-to-quote, billing or customer lifecycle tools. Deep Salesforce fluency is a strong plus.
  • Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good.
  • You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue.
  • You drive strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.
  • Run vendor evaluations end to end
  • Set and hold standards for documentation, testing and deployment without slowing the team down, and coach senior ICs with care.
  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR).
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity
  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC ‍

Interview Process

  • Call with the Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Interview with the Hiring Coach (VP of Operations)
  • Case Study with the Hiring Coach and future Team
  • Clarification Interview with Future Direct Reports
  • Convexity Culture Interview
  • Offer!
Get ready using our Knowledge Base: https://bit.ly/42H1ggC
Who We Are
360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.
In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Head of Delivery Operations
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Where you'll fit in

Why this role matters

Kraken's Delivery organisation lands migrations that move energy companies off legacy platforms and transform how they operate, this support continues after the migration is finished and forms the client-facing interactions into the Client Success phase. We hold a 100% migration track record, and we're scaling into multiple new markets at once. With near 500 people working in delivery, we focus incessantly on building repeatable, scalable structures that allow us to win. This role exists to build and lead the operating model that lets Delivery move at pace: how the function is organised, how it plans and resources its people, how it reports on itself, and how it stays human while it scales.

This is a senior leadership role. You will operate as a peer to our delivery directors, setting direction on how the whole Delivery function works as a system rather than administering a single sliver of it.

You will lead by mobilising people across the org, not through building a team.

What you'll own

Talent, onboarding & capability

  • As a leader in Delivery, you will shape and further our culture of high performance and joy.

  • Own the strategy for how Delivery recruits, onboards, trains, and develops its people.

  • Act as leader for our global onboarding programme and partner with Learning on capability building.

  • Make sure the talent pipeline aligns to evolving roles and responsibilities with org.

Systems, tooling & resourcing

  • Own the tooling roadmap across the Delivery stack (project management, resourcing, HR, and engagement platforms) and drive real adoption.

  • Run resource management across the portfolio, matching capacity to the pipeline and flagging over- and under-allocation early.

  • Make the systems serve delivery, rather than the other way around.

  • Own commercial relationship with solution providers and vendors

  • This requires close partnership with finance and people functions to shape the tooling and significant mobilisation skills to drive adoption within delivery.

Data, reporting & forecasting

  • Own the operational source of truth: delivery metrics, migration status reporting, and the dashboards senior leadership relies on.

  • Own the forecasting engine for migration velocity and capacity, keeping the model honest and decision-ready.

  • Turn operational data into the insight that drives strategic decisions.

Operating model & strategic programmes

You own the cross-cutting programmes that make Delivery predictable and scalable, taking them from a loosely-defined problem to an optimal outcome.

  • Lead strategic programmes such as building systems and operating structures, lead the transformation of our tooling and reporting.

  • Find the structural gaps in how Delivery operates and build the structures to close them.

  • Turn ambiguity into accountability across people, processes and products. .

What you bring to the party

  • Senior operational leadership: Significant experience leading operations in a fast-scaling technology, professional services or transformation environment.

  • Systems & data fluency: Comfortable working with systems, data and capacity models to inform decisions and improve how teams operate.

  • Building & scaling: A strong track record of building systems and processes from scratch, implementing new tools and driving adoption.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Comfortable working across People, Finance, Tech and other functions, navigating interdependencies and building strong relationships to deliver the outcomes the business needs.

  • People & culture: Strong people-first mindset and sound cultural judgment, with the trust and credibility to positively shape how teams work, grow and collaborate.

  • Leading through influence: The ability to bring people with you, create alignment and drive outcomes through influence rather than authority.

  • Emotional intelligence & care: High emotional intelligence and genuine care for people, with the empathy to understand different perspectives, build trust and support others through change and challenge.

️ Bonus points

  • Background in migration or transformation delivery.

  • Experience enabling teams to work faster with AI tooling.

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms

Please note that, in line with our current recruitment policy, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position; applicants must have the right to work in the country that they're applying to, at the time of application.*

title: Head of Continental Europe + MEA Sales, FTSE Russell
description:
ABOUT US:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 26,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

OUR PEOPLE:

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

ABOUT FTSE Russell, a division of LSEG

FTSE Russell is a global index leader that provides innovative benchmarking, analytics and data solutions for investors worldwide. FTSE Russell calculates thousands of indexes that measure and benchmark markets and asset classes in more than 70 countries, covering 98% of the investable market globally.

FTSE Russell index expertise and products are used extensively by institutional and retail investors globally. Approximately $17.9 trillion is currently benchmarked to FTSE Russell indexes. For over 30 years, leading asset owners, asset managers, ETF providers and investment banks have chosen FTSE Russell indexes to benchmark their investment performance and create ETFs, structured products and index-based derivatives.

ROLE PROFILE

The Head of Continental Europe + MEA Sales (Sales Division), will lead a team focusing on the development of various regions within Continental Europe & MEA. This is an area which has not been traditionally a strong focus for FTSE Russell and where we see significant upside both from the Data & Subscription side as well as Asset-Based side.

The role implies working alongside various teams like product, marketing, SI, PR and to develop the existing book of business, understanding where to prioritize (from a country and client segment perspective) with the solutions we have or may need to design. The role involves:

  • The identification of the territories & client segments with the most amount of potential / Devising a proper strategy to address these opportunities.
  • The recruitment of the necessary headcounts / the management of the existing team / the monitoring of the results
  • The development of the FTSE Russell Data & Subscription side as well as the Asset-Based side where relevant, accelerating revenue growth.
  • The running of campaigns / events (either in-house or 3rd party events) / partnering with the broader LSEG colleagues to support our clients & strategy
  • Developing the Index ecosystem on the Continent, liaising with various associations and companies where relevant
  • Developing our brand in Continental Europe & MEA to ensure better awareness and traction

ROLE SUMMARY

Reporting directly to the Head of EMEA Sales (FTSE Russell), the Head of Continental Europe & MEA Sales will play a key leadership role within the regional team, having responsibility for driving data / Index adoption & awareness within Continental Europe and MEA across various client segments (Asset Owners, Asset Managers, Wealth, Distributors and Platforms, Banks and Hedge Funds…).

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

The role will involve all aspects of business management & development, strategy formulation, team leadership, client engagement and relationship management and internal coordination across the regional team and working closely with the other regions to ensure global consistency.

The role is a player-coach role, directly leading client relationships, strategy and business development with top clients and also leading a team of individuals covering various client segments to help guide, coach and develop individuals with development plans to drive the objective on both Data/ Subscription and Asset-based businesses.

The individual will be responsible for a broad range of activities:

  • Set the strategic priorities in terms of territories, client segments, leveraging the existing book of business and growing it further.
  • Set team objectives and KPIs, training requirements, development plans, performance reviews
  • Develop and lead on execution of the strategic growth plans to increase FTSE Russell Data & Subscription + Asset-Based businesses in the various territories.

  • Work closely with product, research and marketing to deliver campaigns to raise awareness of our franchise and solutions.
  • Bring awareness of client requirements back to the business to shape go-to-market plans and collaborate with key internal stakeholders on new product development to drive growth.
  • Work closely with product, research, SI and marketing to ensure market intelligence, competitor analysis and market trends are gathered and monitored.

  • Ensure strong focus on Sales hygiene, pipeline management, forecast management.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Demonstrable team leading, relationship management skills, with the ability to build productive relationships with internal and external clients and stakeholders across all levels.
  • Knowledge of, and experience in, the financial markets, particularly on the Index Data & Subscription side, ETFs & other passive Products, Investment Banking products
  • 15+ years of Experience in Financial services
  • Strong knowledge of data and subscription business / Indexing and indexed financial products
  • Proven ability to work with clients in various regions in Continental Europe and MEA and influence at a senior level
  • Strategic mindset alongside the ability to lead and drive on execution / Ability to instil strong sales discipline and to help develop more of a hunter mindset.
  • Client centric with strong commercial acumen and ability to manage consultative engagements to solve client problems.
  • Excellent verbal, written and communications skills in English + French, German or Italian

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

This role is at the heart of our future ways of working, with the opportunity to work across all parts of the enterprise. We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take hybrid approach to workplace, this role is blended between office and remote working.

Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. Underpinning our purpose, our values of Integrity, Partnership , Excellence and Change set the standard for everything we do, every day. They guide the way we interact with each other, the partners we work with and our customers. Delivering on our purpose and living up to our values is a responsibility that we all share.
