title: Product Designer
description:
Who are we ?

Welcome to the #1 home exchange community in the world

At HomeExchange, we envision a new mode of travel: through home exchanges.

Our company runs today the world’s largest home exchange community, with 310k members in 177 countries. Thanks to an innovative system, the platform offers a flexible and secure service, so that the members live an authentic experience based on trust and hospitality. Our way of life is shared by the worldwide HomeExchange community. It is in keeping this vision that we take on new initiatives every day to design unforgettable experiences for our members.

We find that respect, freedom, and kindness go hand-in-hand with ambition, innovation, and confidence. If you see yourself also manifesting these notions, searching for authentic experiences and exhibiting a concern about the preservation of our planet we invite you to join us. Let's build the future of travel together!


Job description

At HomeExchange, our mission is to make home swapping the go-to way of travelling worldwide. Our Product Design team plays a key role in shaping this experience, turning complex journeys into simple, delightful moments for millions of travelers across the globe.

As a Product Designer, you’ll be involved in every stage of the product development process, from discovery to launch, crafting solutions that are intuitive, accessible and impactful for our international community. You’ll help us design features that inspire trust, foster connections and make home exchanging effortless.

You’ll join a collaborative team of designers, product managers and engineers who all share the same goal: building a high-quality product that delivers value to our members while pushing the boundaries of what design can do.

If you believe great product design blends empathy, creativity, problem-solving and care for craft, we’d love to hear from you, even if your path doesn’t tick every box.

What you’ll do

  • Stay close to our members and dig into usage data to understand their needs.

  • Shape product strategy with PMs, engineers, data scientists and other teams, focusing on what matters most.

  • Design end-to-end experiences across the member journey, from search to hosting, travelling and beyond.

  • Evolve and scale Panorama, our design system, across HomeExchange and HomeExchange Collection.

  • Make AI part of your daily work to explore, synthesise, prototype and create, with strong design judgement.

  • Raise the quality bar through systems thinking and strong craft, and help grow our design culture.

What are we looking for

  • 5+ years' experience designing and shipping digital products.

  • Strong expertise in UX, visual design and systems thinking, with real care for quality and craft.

  • Experience working with design systems and contributing to scalable, consistent patterns.

  • Ability to simplify complex problems and turn ambiguity into clear, actionable solutions.

  • Clear communication and storytelling skills to align teams, share knowledge and seek feedback early.

  • Hands-on experience with Figma and AI tools like Claude (we also use Notion and Slack every day).

  • Professional proficiency in French and English.

  • Based in Paris, with remote work options.


What we offer:

  • Full time position

  • Meal vouchers

  • Subscription to our platform

  • Alan health insurance (75% reimbursement)

  • 2 days of Responsible Travel Time (RTT) if you choose low-carbon transportation for trips longer than 6 hours

  • Afterworks, breakfasts, and other team gatherings

  • Pleasant office space located within Paris

  • A friendly and close-knit team!

  • Vacation bonuses

  • Bonuses (international) / Profit-sharing (France) – Employee savings plan

Our Commitment to Inclusion

HomeExchange and its team stand firmly against all forms of discrimination. We are committed to promoting Diversity and Inclusion by fostering a respectful and welcoming work environment where everyone can find their place, express their talents, and build their professional career. Every application will be carefully reviewed — don’t hesitate, apply now!

title: Head of Client Solutions, Luxury - Global Business Solutions - Paris
description:
Advertising & Sales

Head of Client Solutions, Luxury - Global Business Solutions - Paris

Location :
Paris

Employment Type :
Regular

Job Code :
A160913

Responsibilities

This role sits within our TikTok FRITES (France, Italy & Spain) Global Business Solutions team, which is responsible for hitting revenue goals, building relationships with key enterprise accounts and helping clients drive business results on TikTok through product consultation, business development and support. The Head of Client Solutions will be responsible for leading a team of individual contributors (Client Solutions Managers) to ensure flawless campaign execution and deliver and upsell against revenue goals. The role will also build and manage strategic client relationships to grow our partnerships with Luxury clients across France, Italy and Spain. This role will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including other sales leaders, product, measurement, marketing science, creative and solutions engineering, to advocate for client needs, influence product development and contribute to building a world-class team and culture. The ideal candidate is someone who can operate autonomously, is customer-obsessed and able to influence clients while coordinating and collaborating with internal stakeholders. Success in this position requires strong people-management skills, deep fluency in performance and app advertising, strong problem-solving and analytical skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, measurement-driven environment. Responsibilities 1. Team Leadership & Development Lead, coach, and mentor a team of Client Solutions Managers across the FRITES markets, fostering a high-performance culture. Co-lead the Luxury vertical together with your Brand Partnerships Lead counterpart. Develop team capabilities in consultative, data-driven campaign strategy, performance analysis, and scaled user acquisition best practices. Provide ongoing guidance, feedback, and professional development opportunities to support career growth. Build scalable processes to enable the team to operate efficiently across three markets in a fast-growing environment. 2. Product Expertise & Client Consultation Develop deep expertise in TikTok's full funnel solutions — and clearly articulate their value to Luxury clients. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of TikTok's measurement and attribution capabilities for apps, including MMP integrations, SKAdNetwork/AEM frameworks, incrementality and lift solutions. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of competitors' products, measurement capabilities and attribution models. Consult with clients on full-funnel user acquisition, re-engagement and monetization strategies that drive ROAS, retention and LTV goals. Leverage data to identify gaming and app consumer trends, and develop actionable best practices, playbooks and case studies for client success. 3. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with product, engineering, measurement, marketing science and creative operations teams to troubleshoot wider client issues, improve advertising offerings and support product innovation. Share vertical insights with internal teams and global Luxury counterparts to help shape advertising strategy, offering and product roadmaps. Support the team to conduct business reviews, strengthen client relationships and ensure successful campaign execution. 4. Strategic Impact & Innovation Serve as a thought partner to FRITES leadership, identifying strategic priorities, growth opportunities and operational efficiencies for the Luxury vertical. Influence product and strategic company decision-making with data-driven insights and industry expertise. Proactively develop and deliver resources such as best practice guides, product implementation playbooks and creative strategies. 5. Ownership & Initiative Take initiative and operate with a high degree of autonomy in managing priorities and driving results across a multi-market region.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications - Experience in digital marketing, with a strong focus on Luxury advertising. - Deep knowledge of the Luxury vertical - Ability to analyse data and extract actionable insights to assess and optimise campaign performance. - Experience building relationships with decision-makers. - Ability to proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues through proper escalation processes. - Proven experience managing or mentoring high-performing teams in account management, client solutions or sales roles, ideally across multiple markets. - Professional proficiency in French to communicate with clients. Preferred Qualifications - Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams to diagnose and solve technical problems. - Skilled at translating technical measurement concepts into clear, actionable guidance for non-technical stakeholders. - Familiarity with campaign performance analysis on TikTok and other performance media channels (Google App Campaigns, Meta AAA, DSPs, ad networks).

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. ​

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​

​

Diversity & Inclusion ​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: Data Platform Lead
description:
Company Description


Rexel. Electrifying solutions that make a sustainable future possible.

Rexel, worldwide expert in the professional multichannel distribution of electrical products and services for the energy world, addresses three main markets - residential, commercial, and industrial. Passionate, dedicated and highly knowledgeable, our people are instrumental in bringing innovative electrification solutions to the field and making energy transition happen. We believe in bringing positive energy to everything we do.

This Company operates through a network of over 1,900 branches in 17 countries, with more than 27,000 employees. The Group’s sales were €19.4 billion in 2025.

Join Rexel’s IT & Digital Team – Driving Innovation with Axelerate 28 :

With over 100 professionals across our Paris and Dallas offices, supported by a strong offshore and neashore teams, Rexel’s IT & Digital organization is a key enabler of our new strategic plan, Axelerate 28.

Whether you’re passionate about delivering world-class digital experiences for our customers, employees, or suppliers, or eager to tackle advanced Data and AI use cases that help Rexel stand out as a market leader, we’re looking for technology experts to fuel our transformation.

We are actively innovating across critical domains: Digital Platforms and Microservices, Hybrid Cloud, Container-as-a-Service, Advanced Data and AI Cloud Technologies, Cybersecurity, Agile & DevSecOps, and Program & Project Management.

Joining Rexel’s IT & Digital teams means becoming part of a dynamic and forward-thinking environment where your contributions make a real difference. You’ll collaborate with diverse and skilled teams, work on high-impact projects, and grow both professionally and personally.

At Rexel, innovation is not just encouraged — it’s expected. We empower our teams to think creatively, challenge conventions, and help shape the future of energy solutions.


Job Description


Your Impact :

At Rexel Group, reporting to the Head of Data Engineering and part of the Platform Engineering team, we are looking for a Data Platform Lead to ensure the reliability, operational excellence, and continuous evolution of the Group Data Platform.

You will own the day-to-day operations of the platform across Snowflake and its associated Azure ecosystem, while supporting countries throughout their migration and onboarding journey. You will act as a key technical coordination point between Group teams, country teams, architects, infrastructure, cloud and security teams, and external partners.

You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of the platform by driving technical evolutions, Proofs of Concept, automation opportunities, and the pragmatic adoption of GenAI and Agentic practices.


Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities:

1) Ensure platform reliability and operational excellence:

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations, availability, performance, and stability of the Data Platform

  • Lead Snowflake administration, including roles, permissions, access management, monitoring, and operational support

  • Ensure the operational maintenance of the Azure services supporting and integrating with the Data Platform

  • Identify and mitigate operational, security, performance, resilience, and cost risks

  • Drive incident resolution and continuous improvement of operational processes, standards, and documentation

  • Work closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, network, and data teams on cross-functional topics

2) Drive technical evolution and innovation:

  • Manage and prioritize the technical evolution backlog in collaboration with architects and Tech Leads

  • Lead the qualification, impact assessment, and execution of technical initiatives and Proofs of Concept

  • Translate POC outcomes and technical analysis into clear recommendations and decisions

  • Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency across the platform

  • Promote the pragmatic adoption of GenAI and Agentic practices to improve support, operations, documentation, incident analysis, and technical delivery

  • Ensure new practices and solutions comply with Group security, governance, and quality standards

3) Support countries and secure successful migrations:

  • Act as the technical lead and point of contact for countries migrating to the Group Data Platform

  • Coordinate Group, country, and partner teams throughout the migration journey

  • Qualify, prioritize, and track technical requests, incidents, dependencies, and blockers

  • Support countries with technical prerequisites, onboarding, operating models, and platform best practices

  • Ensure a smooth transition from migration to stable run operations

4) Coordinate stakeholders and drive visibility:

  • Act as the operational reference for platform administration, support, and technical topics

  • Coordinate closely with the platform technical owner, architects, Tech Leads, Group data teams, country teams, and technology functions

  • Provide clear visibility on platform health, risks, priorities, trade-offs, and ongoing actions

  • Contribute to the definition and enforcement of platform standards covering operations, monitoring, security, access, and documentation


Qualifications


  • Engineering degree (or equivalent) with significant experience in Data Platform, Cloud, or IT operations

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Snowflake administration and operations

  • Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services, infrastructure, connectivity, and integration

  • Good understanding of modern data architectures and cloud-based data platforms

  • Strong understanding of security, access management, monitoring, resilience, performance, and cost optimization

  • Experience working in complex, international, and multi-stakeholder environments

  • Ability to combine operational ownership, technical expertise, and cross-functional coordination

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset

  • Interest in GenAI, Agentic approaches, and automation applied to IT operations and technical delivery

  • Fluent English; international and multicultural experience is a plus


Additional Information


Rexel offers an attractive compensation package with a 13-month base salary and an individual performance-based bonus. The company also provides a profit-sharing plan and additional benefits (health insurance, retirement plans, transport and meal allowances, etc.).

Feel free to contact us to learn more!

At Rexel, we believe our success depends on you. We help you develop your skills and explore new areas within the company as part of your career growth. We are committed to social responsibility, equality, and diversity in our workplace. Together, we can create a better future. Apply now and take advantage of this opportunity for growth and development.

Chez Rexel, nous pensons que notre succès dépend de vous. Nous vous aidons à développer vos connaissances et à explorer de nouveaux domaines au sein de l'entreprise et dans le cadre de votre développement de carrière.

Nous sommes conscients de notre responsabilité sociale et nous nous engageons en faveur de l'égalité et de la diversité dans notre environnement de travail. Ensemble, nous pouvons créer un avenir meilleur. Postulez maintenant et profitez de cette opportunité de croissance et de développement.

title: Head of Technical Sales M/W
description:
About Pasqal

We are building a European team of quantum enthusiasts dedicated to promoting PASQAL technology and educating the market on the power of neutral atom quantum computing.

As Head of Technical Sales EMEA, you will lead and develop the EMEA Technical Business team, ensuring that PASQAL’s technical value proposition is clearly translated into customer impact across key industry verticals. You will manage, coach, and coordinate Technical Business professionals across Europe, supporting them in educating customers, qualifying opportunities, shaping use cases, and accelerating commercial adoption of PASQAL’s products and services

In this management role, you will act as a senior technical-commercial leader, working closely with Sales, Product, R&D, Marketing, and global commercial leadership to grow PASQAL’s presence in the European market, build new revenue streams, and contribute to PASQAL’s mission of unlocking the potential of quantum computing for end-users.

Tasks:

  • Lead, manage, and develop the EMEA Technical Business team, ensuring alignment with PASQAL’s commercial priorities and regional growth objectives.

  • Define and drive the technical business development strategy for EMEA in close collaboration with Sales, Product, R&D, Marketing, and global commercial leadership.

  • Support the team in communicating PASQAL’s unique value proposition to both technical and non-technical audiences, creating awareness and interest in PASQAL’s technology, products, and services.

  • Coach team members in customer discovery, technical qualification, use-case framing, solution positioning, and opportunity development.

  • Analyze the European market, identify priority industry verticals, and guide the team in prospecting and developing new potential customers.

  • Build and maintain senior-level relationships with strategic customers, partners, research organizations, and ecosystem stakeholders.

  • Support complex and strategic opportunities by acting as a senior technical-commercial translator between customers and PASQAL internal teams.

  • Ensure high-quality customer engagement from first contact through opportunity development, deal support, and after-sales coordination.

  • Collaborate closely with the global commercial team to convert market interest into qualified leads, commercial opportunities, and long-term customers.

  • Represent PASQAL at relevant conferences, industry events, workshops, and customer meetings across Europe.

  • Work with Product and R&D teams to ensure the Technical Business team has a deep and up-to-date understanding of PASQAL’s roadmap, products, services, and technical differentiators.

  • Collaborate with Marketing to create and update technical-commercial materials tailored to European markets and priority verticals.

  • Report regularly on EMEA technical business activity, pipeline support, customer insights, team performance, and market feedback.

  • Stay up to date with new products, services, pricing models, market trends, and competitive positioning in quantum computing.

This list of tasks is non exhaustive.

About you
Masters or PhD in quantum or a related field (physics, engineering, computer science, machine learning, etc.)

10+ years of work experience (private sector) in technical sales/business development

  • Proven experience in a customer-facing technical business, technical sales, solution consulting, or business development role, ideally in quantum computing, deep tech, HPC, or advanced scientific technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience managing, coaching, and developing technical business, pre-sales, solution consulting, or technical sales teams.
  • Strong ability to engage with external customers at all levels, including executive stakeholders and C-Suite decision-makers.
  • Ability to creatively explain, present, and translate complex scientific and technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Solid understanding of the basic principles of quantum physics and quantum computing; knowledge of neutral atom quantum computing is a strong plus.
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles, from early customer discovery and qualification through solution positioning, proposal support, and deal closure.
  • Strong understanding of sales performance metrics, pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting in a commercial environment.
  • Experience working closely with Sales, Product, R&D, Marketing, and executive leadership to align technical capabilities with customer needs and market opportunities.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers, partners, research organizations, and ecosystem stakeholders.
  • Tech sales experience in quantum technologies, deep tech, HPC, AI, cloud, or scientific computing environments.
  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment, with the flexibility and resilience required in a fast-paced and constantly changing organization.
  • Strong team spirit and leadership mindset, with the ability to inspire, align, and support a distributed EMEA team.
  • Ambitious, organized, proactive, creative, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a management role.
  • Able and willing to wear many hats while balancing strategic leadership, team management, customer engagement, and hands-on commercial support.
  • Excellent professional command of English, both written and oral; additional European languages are a plus.

What we offer

  • Type of contract: Permanent contract

  • A dynamic and close-knit international team

  • A key role in a public company

  • Free time to train and go to conferences/meetups

Recruitment process

  • An interview with our Talent Acquisition team of 45'

  • A meeting with Christophe, our Senior VP Sales EMEA

  • An exchange with Mark, our CCO

  • An offer!

PASQAL is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, as inclusion and diversity are essential to achieving our mission. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, religion or sexual orientation.

title: Director of Technology
description:
Description

Payplug est la solution de paiement française pensée pour les commerçants, e-commerçants de toutes tailles et fintechs.

Avec notre plateforme technologique de pointe, nos outils dédiés à la conversion et notre maîtrise unique de la chaîne de paiement, nous vous invitons à viser le meilleur, et plus encore.

Payplug, c’est une équipe de 300 passionnés dédiés à la réalisation de vos plus grandes ambitions.   • Rencontre avec Antoine, notre CEO (30’) ;

Une prise de références sera faite en fin de process

Benefits

  • Organisation de travail hybride + participation à hauteur de 350€ sur les équipements en télétravail ;

  • 25 CP / an & 10 RTT / an ;

  • Café, thé, snacks, petits déj du lundi, apéros du vendredi et autres events pour une vie d’équipe riche !

Avantages financiers :

Autres :

  • Qualicare pour le soutien à la santé mentale de chacun·e ;

  • Windoo : activités de sport, bien-être et développement personnel ;

title: Head of Process Development
description:
Nūmi is a bioproduction platform harnessing human mammary cells to produce key ingredients with proven health benefits across all stages of life. More specifically, it is the first European cultivated breast milk company aiming to produce human milk constituents to better match the ideal nutrition for babies. We are an early-stage, VC-backed biotech based in the heart of Paris (Hôpital Cochin, Paris 14th) and supported by world-class investors and scientific partners.

  • ️ Nūmi's Values
  • ️ Positivity: At Nūmi, we cultivate positivity every day. Our mission drives us to communicate with passion and energy, always keeping the bigger impact in sight. We celebrate quick wins, but never lose track of our ultimate goal.

Excellence: At Nūmi, excellence starts with dedication and a commitment to constant improvement. We embrace challenges as opportunities to learn and push ourselves to deliver high-quality results. Through effort, attention to detail, and integrity, we grow both individually and collectively as a team.

Team-Work and Pedagogy: At Nūmi, we believe that teamwork makes us stronger. We encourage knowledge-sharing, open feedback, and mutual respect. Each Nūmiz is here to lift others up, ensuring that the collective succeeds.

Ambition: At Nūmi, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to think big. Nūmi is driven by bold ideas and relentless determination, always aiming for the stars to create real impact.

Why this role matters

As we move from proof-of-concept to first industrial batches and prepare for scale-up beyond pilot, we are seeking a senior leader to own Nūmi's industrialisation strategy end-to-end. This role is mission-critical for Nūmi's development and path to market. You will be the technical spine of our Bioprocess organisation, translating our science into a robust, scalable and cost-effective platform , from cell line management through upstream, downstream and formulation, all the way to first commercial supply.

Reporting to our CTO Eugénie, you will build and lead a talented technical team (Senior DSP Engineer, Lead of Upstream Bioprocess), define the scale-up roadmap, own capital expenditure decisions on facility and equipment, and act as the internal voice for what needs to happen technically to bring Nūmi to first commercial launch. You will interface daily with our CMC Lead, our Reg & QC Implementation Lead and our Preclinical & Bioactivity Lead to ensure that every industrial decision is defensible in the regulatory dossier and consistent with the functional profile of our ingredients.

Key Responsibilities

Industrialisation Strategy & Roadmap Ownership

  • Define, own and continuously refine Nūmi's industrialisation roadmap, from current pilot scale to first commercial supply.
  • Make the critical strategic decisions on the scale-up trajectory : bioreactor sizing, single-use vs stainless, in-house facility vs CDMO tech transfer, etc...
  • Track and report on industrialisation milestones, risks, dependencies and timelines to company leadership and to the board.

Process Development Leadership (USP + DSP + Analytics + Automation)

  • Lead the Bioprocess organisation across upstream (cell culture, media and feed development, bioreactor operations), downstream (purification, filtration, chromatography, formulation), automation and process analytics.
  • Ensure end-to-end process robustness, reproducibility and characterisation, using DoE, QbD and PAT tools where appropriate.
  • Own the technical narrative of Nūmi's process for internal, board and regulatory audiences.

Team Building & Talent Development

  • Attract, develop and retain top technical talent. You will recruit and mentor Senior DSP Engineer, Mid DSP Engineer, and grow the Upstream and Downstream teams over time.
  • Set ambitious individual objectives, calibrate performance, and build a culture of ownership, rigour and cross-functional collaboration.

Capital Expenditure & Unit Economics

  • Own capex and opex planning for the industrialisation function : facility investments, equipment procurement, single-use consumables strategy.
  • Drive the technoeconomic analysis of Nūmi's process : cost of goods, yield, throughput, sensitivity to scale.
  • Optimise for cost, timing and risk in every scale-up decision.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with CMC Lead and Reg & QC Implementation Lead to ensure every process decision is captured in the regulatory dossier and every specification is defensible.
  • Partner with our R&D team and our Preclinical & Bioactivity Lead to ensure functional properties are maintained across scale-up.
  • Serve as the internal ambassador for what industrialisation demands from every function of the company.

Tech Transfer & External Partnerships

  • Manage tech transfer activities to CDMOs or external manufacturing partners when relevant, including scoping, requests for proposals, technical transfer dossiers and on-site oversight.
  • Build and maintain relationships with equipment vendors, engineering consultancies and facility partners.

Innovation & Digital Tools

  • Evaluate, pilot and integrate novel bioprocess technologies and digital tools that accelerate development cycle times and improve process robustness.
  • Partner with our Data Engineer Lead to ensure that every batch of data feeds a coherent industrialisation dataset.

Requirements


Experience & Knowledge

  • MSc, PhD or engineering degree in bioprocess engineering, chemical engineering, biotechnology or a related discipline, with 10+ years of professional experience in industrial bioprocess or biomanufacturing.
  • Proven leadership role in at least one greater than 10M€ capex manufacturing scale-up project, from concept to commissioning.
  • Already experienced in building and leading a technical team
  • Deep expertise in mammalian cell culture bioprocessing preferred, but broader profiles are welcome : precision fermentation, cultivated meat scale-up, biologics manufacturing, or industrial food fermentation.
  • Track record of scaling processes across at least two step-changes (e.g. 50 L 500 L 2000 L).
  • Strong understanding of quality frameworks (QMS, HACCP, GMP-adjacent) and regulatory expectations for novel food or biologics products.

Leadership & Judgement

  • Demonstrated ability to make critical strategic decisions under uncertainty and to align operational choices with commercial and regulatory objectives.
  • Experience steering cross-functional teams and coordinating with Quality, Regulatory and Commercial functions.
  • Experience negotiating with equipment vendors, engineering firms and CDMOs.
  • Results-oriented, strong work ethic, thrives in fast-moving entrepreneurial environments.

Communication

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Ability to translate deep technical detail into strategic narrative for board, investors and regulators.

Bonus
Ideally, you have experience in some, but not necessarily all, of the following areas :

  • Mammalian culture systems, precision fermentation, HMOs, milk ingredients purification, plant biomass fermentation.
  • Novel food dossier support (Regulation (EU) 2015/2283, Novel Food) or biologics filing support.
  • Facility design and commissioning at pilot or commercial scale.
  • Startup or scale-up environment (Series A to C).

Benefits


Unique opportunity to be one of the first employees at an early stage biotech company, shaping the future of infant nutrition

Scale a foundational team: as one of the first senior hires, you will grow your team as the company scales

Access to top-quality facilities, research services and infrastructure

Competitive salary, part coverage of health insurance, lunch and transportation costs

  • Employee first mentality, we prioritize the well-being of our team members, both in terms of their mental and physical health

Recruitment process
  • We first check that your skills match the expectations
  • First interview with our cofounder and CTO Eugénie
  • A technical case study in English to give you a taste of what we are working on at Nūmi
  • A reference check
  • A last interview on site (when possible) to meet cofounder and CEO Eden, part of the team and visit the labs & office

Nūmi is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people from all walks of life

title: Head of Third-Party Oversight
description:
Company Description



Ranked among the world’s largest asset managers with over €1,300 billion in assets under management, Natixis Investment Managers (Natixis IM) delivers a range of solutions across various types of asset classes, management styles, and vehicles, including innovative strategies and products that meet environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria dedicated to the development of sustainable finance.

The teams at Natixis IM work in partnership with their clients—institutional investors, investment funds, corporations, and individuals—to understand their specific needs and provide them with tailored investment insights and solutions aligned with their long-term objectives.

Thanks to Natixis IM's multi-boutique approach, clients can benefit from the expertise and insights of around twenty active management companies.

Natixis Investment Managers International (Natixis IMI) is the main management company for Natixis IM in Europe. It encompasses two activities:

  • The distribution activities in Europe and in other geographic areas such as APAC, the Middle East, and Latin America for Natixis IM's asset management offering;
  • A platform of centers of expertise (support functions) serving the distribution activities and affiliates.

Natixis IMI continues to develop and strengthen its presence in France and internationally, leveraging the expertise of its teams and the multi-affiliate model of Natixis IM.




Job Description



As part of the incumbent’s retirement, you will join the Compliance Department at Natixis IM International and report to the Chief Compliance Officer based in London.
You manage a team of two employees (Paris & Singapore).


You manage the TPO system of Natixis IM International Distribution (NIMID), ensuring control of risks related to third parties, delegations, outsourcing and service providers.


In an evolving and non-harmonized international environment, you are able to combine global vision with local expertise in order to align the Group’s standards with the specific requirements of each jurisdiction and ensure a consistent and compliant third-party monitoring strategy.


The team is composed of one employee located in Paris and another in Singapore, both under the direct responsibility of the Head of TPO.

You will play a pivotal role in the management and mitigation of risks associated with third-party relationships throughout NIMID’s perimeter. Recent regulatory developments in all regions, impacting delegations, outsourcing or vendor management, have reaffirmed the need for effective coverage and responsiveness. The successful candidate will possess a thorough knowledge of the regulatory requirements within the EU and in the countries where NIMID operates, as well as a mastery of global NIMID platform standards and a good understanding of intra-group relationships.

On a day-to-day basis, your tasks will be as follows

  • Overall responsibility the creation, implementation and maintenance of NIMID’s Third Party Monitoring Framework (TPO) and programmes.
  • Development of monitoring processes: Lead the design and deployment of onboarding and third-party tracking activities to ensure that third-party risks are managed effectively and in accordance with regional regulatory standards. Each of our offices is subject to distinct regulatory regimes and has developed in recent years its own regulations on outsourcing and supervision of providers, which are not always harmonized (as may be the case in other parts of the world) ; this trend is expected to continue in the future.
  • Management of surveillance programs: act as a leader in the deployment of internal global monitoring and tracking programs under the TPO function. Take all necessary measures to train colleagues from all relevant operational functions on the nature of each program and on how to approach the TPO team at the start of the contracting process with a new third party.
  • Regulatory compliance: keep abreast of developments in outsourcing regulations and the monitoring of contractors in all regions where NIMID operates or to which it is exposed (e.g. through delegations). Anticipate upcoming changes and act (directly or through the team members) as a business expert ('Subject Matter Expert' or 'SME') to navigate the various regulatory requirements for outsourcing NIMID entities, providing compliance guidance and assisting in the development of regulatory strategies.
  • Relationship Management: in collaboration with the TPO team, establish and maintain strong working relationships with other key functions such as Legal, Finance, Risk and Compliance teams within NIMID or NIM, fostering effective collaboration and communication to ensure that all processes align with local and global requirements. Also establish and maintain strong working relationships with key contractors.
  • Operational resilience compliance: Address operational resilience issues as they relate to the oversight of contractors, working closely with NIMID’s 'Technology Risk Management' or 'TRM' team.
  • Training: Design and deliver training to other departments on all aspects of TPO programs, in order to maximize the coverage and integration of all critical third parties into relevant TPO programs.
  • Governance:
    • Organize and chair the NIMID Outsourcing Oversight Committee ("OOC - Outsourcing Oversight Committee") (including local variations of this committee in some locations).
      • Report on TPO and OOC topics to local governance bodies (boards of directors, fund boards, NIM governance bodies and/or executive committees), as required.

#TransformatveFinance

This position is based in Paris with the possibility to work from home.

We place our employees at the center of our attention. Internal mobility, career development and training programs allow you to grow and flourish throughout your journey.

You work in a hybrid, inclusive and collaborative working environment.

About the recruitment process

You will be contacted by one of our recruiters before meeting our business experts (manager, team member or business sector).



Required Skills/Qualifications/Experience



About you: If you recognize yourself in the following description, you are made to work with us!
With a higher education, you have at least 10 years of experience in asset management or financial services.

You master:
  • monitoring third parties, outsourcing and managing service providers.
  • European regulatory environment (international experience is an asset)

You have excellent interpersonal skills, a very good ability to listen; you are:
  • capable of working in a global and local context, reconciling group standards and local regulatory requirements.
  • Able to influence and collaborate across the different functions of Natixis IM and the Group.
  • with a strategic mind and able to contribute to regulatory guidelines and governance bodies.

You master English with a C2 level

title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
ParisPermanentSales & Business DevelopmentPosted 22/09/2026

Senior Sales Manager – France & Belgium


About the Company

Our client is a growing financial services company providing solutions that simplify international money management for businesses. Its offering combines international payments, multi-currency accounts, expense and card management, foreign exchange, and embedded finance solutions.


With an international presence and a strong focus on supporting businesses operating across borders, the company is entering an exciting phase of growth and is looking to strengthen its commercial presence in the French market.


About the Role

As part of its continued growth, our client is looking for a Senior Sales Manager based in Paris to drive new business across France and the French-speaking parts of Belgium.

This is a pure hunting role focused on identifying, developing and winning new business within the SME and corporate market. You will be responsible for selling a range of financial solutions, including multi-currency accounts, expense and card management, foreign exchange and related payment solutions.


You will take ownership of larger and more complex opportunities within your territory and act as a senior commercial representative in the market.


Reporting to the Head of Sales, you will manage the full sales cycle, from initial prospecting and relationship building through negotiation, compliance and onboarding. You will remain involved during the initial onboarding and early client relationship before handing the account over to the Account Management team.


As a senior member of the sales organisation, you will also contribute to the development of the go-to-market strategy for the region and share best practices with the wider sales team.

This is a hybrid role based in Paris, with regular travel across France and French-speaking Belgium for client meetings, networking and industry events.


Responsibilities

  • Generate new business revenue across France and French-speaking Belgium, carrying a significant individual sales target.
  • Identify, prospect and develop new business opportunities within the SME and corporate market.
  • Lead larger and more complex opportunities, including multi-product deals and negotiations involving multiple senior stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business leaders, financial decision-makers and other key stakeholders in the market.
  • Actively develop your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and industry events, alongside qualified inbound opportunities.
  • Manage the complete sales cycle from initial contact through negotiation, compliance and successful client onboarding.
  • Present and negotiate at C-level, clearly communicating the value proposition and tailoring solutions to the client's business needs.
  • Understand each prospect's business model, payment flows and regulatory context to ensure proposed solutions are commercially and operationally appropriate.
  • Work closely with senior sales leadership to identify attractive market segments, target industries and new business opportunities.
  • Stay close to newly won clients during onboarding and their initial trading period, ensuring a smooth transition to Account Management.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline management and sales forecasts.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to identify opportunities for cross-selling and broader client development.
  • Share market knowledge, successful sales approaches and best practices with other members of the sales team.

Key Accountabilities

  • New business revenue against an individual sales target.
  • Conversion and progression of larger and more complex opportunities.
  • Pipeline generation, coverage and forecast accuracy across the territory.
  • Successful onboarding and handover of newly acquired clients.
  • Development of the company's commercial presence and network across France and French-speaking Belgium.

Your Profile

Skills & Experience

  • A strong and demonstrable track record in new business B2B sales, consistently achieving ambitious commercial targets.
  • Extensive experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including presenting and negotiating with C-level executives.
  • Proven ability to build a pipeline from scratch through proactive outbound prospecting, networking and relationship development.
  • Strong hunter mentality, with a track record of converting cold or self-generated opportunities into meetings and revenue.
  • Experience managing the full sales cycle end-to-end, including compliance-led onboarding and commercial qualification.
  • Strong understanding of the French B2B market, with experience selling to SME and/or corporate clients.
  • Existing network across the French business and/or financial services ecosystem is highly desirable.
  • Experience working across France and/or French-speaking Belgium.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and networking skills.
  • Strong commercial and analytical capabilities, with a disciplined approach to pipeline and forecast management.
  • Fluent in French and English.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, FX, banking or related sectors is highly desirable.
  • Experience selling to regulated or higher-risk businesses is an advantage.
  • Previous experience mentoring or supporting other salespeople is a plus.

title: Head of Enterprise Sales / Business Development Management - France
description:
As Head of Enterprise Sales for France , you will spearhead the growth of SCOR and SCOR Digital Solutions by engaging with leading insurers and reinsurance partners to address their most critical transformation challenges.

Combining deep industry insight with a consultative sales approach, you will develop strategic client relationships, drive complex sales cycles, and deliver measurable business outcomes through AI-powered underwriting, claims and risk management solutions.


This job has a broad remit encompassing – but not limited to – the work areas below:


  • Drive sustainable revenue growth by identifying, developing and converting new business opportunities across strategic insurance and financial services clients.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to C-level executives, helping clients define and execute their underwriting, claims and operational transformation strategies.
  • Position SCOR’s AI-powered solutions as strategic enablers of underwriting excellence, operational efficiency and customer experience transformation.
  • Understand customer underwriting and claims operating models, operational transformations, and growth objectives and propose SCOR solutions based on business value, not only features and benefits.
  • Provide input into pricing strategies and commercial models adapted to local market conditions.
  • Collaborate with product, underwriting and claims operations teams to tailor digital solutions to local market needs
  • Lead client engagements, including pitches, proposal development, deep-dive sessions, and contract negotiations demonstrating subject-matter expertise and the ability to understand complex client environments
  • Monitor market dynamics, competitive landscape and regulatory changes to inform strategic decisions
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline management and performance tracking.


Education and required skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least 8 years of experience in enterprise sales, business development or strategic consulting roles, ideally within insurance, Fintech, SaaS, AI or digital transformation environments.
  • Enterprise Sales
  • Complex Sales Cycles
  • Solution Selling,
  • Account Planning
  • Executive Stakeholder Management
  • Commercial negotiation
  • Contracting
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills

  • Fluent in French and English is essential (written and oral)

  • The position is based in Paris. Some travels will be required


Preferred qualifications

  • Some understanding of the insurance ecosystem, including underwriting, claims, distribution and digital transformation challenges.
  • Experience driving digital transformation, cloud adoption, or AI-related business initiatives.


As a leading global reinsurer, SCOR offers its clients a diversified and innovative range of reinsurance and insurance solutions and services to control and manage risk. Applying “The Art & Science of Risk,” SCOR uses its industry-recognized expertise and cutting-edge financial solutions to serve its clients and contribute to the welfare and resilience of society in around 160 countries worldwide.

Working at SCOR means engaging with some of the best minds in the industry – actuaries, data scientists, underwriters, risk modelers, engineers, and many others – as we work together to find solutions to pressing challenges facing societies.

As an international company, our common culture is defined by “The SCOR Way.” Serving both to build momentum that drives the Group forward and as a compass to guide our actions and choices, The SCOR Way is anchored by five core values, reflecting the input of employees at all levels of the Group. We care about clients, people, and societies. We perform with integrity. We act with courage. We encourage open minds. And we thrive through collaboration.

SCOR supports inclusion and the diversity of talents, and all positions are open to people with disabilities.

title: Head of Business
description:
About Freedom

Freedom Digital Bank France will form part of Freedom Holding Corp., a diversified international financial services group publicly listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker FRHC. The Group operates across Europe, the United States and Central Asia, with activities spanning banking, brokerage, investment services, insurance, payments and digital consumer services.

About the role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and commercially driven Head of Business to establish and lead the commercial development of Freedom Digital Bank France.

The role will be responsible for developing the French market strategy, building the bank’s customer base, creating strategic partnerships and identifying sustainable revenue opportunities. The Head of Business will work closely with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology to develop relevant and compliant digital banking propositions for the French market.

As a member of the founding executive team, the role will contribute to the bank’s regulatory authorisation, establishment and launch in France. The successful candidate will ensure that the commercial strategy, customer-acquisition channels and product propositions meet applicable French and EU conduct and consumer-protection requirements.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the commercial and market-entry strategy for Freedom Digital Bank France.
  • Own business growth, revenue, customer acquisition and commercial KPIs.
  • Develop the bank’s customer proposition and commercial positioning in the French market.
  • Identify priority customer segments, market opportunities and revenue streams.
  • Develop strategic partnerships, distribution arrangements and digital acquisition channels.
  • Contribute to the design and launch of digital banking products and services.
  • Work closely with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology.
  • Ensure commercial initiatives are aligned with the bank’s risk appetite and regulatory obligations.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with key financial-services, technology and distribution partners.
  • Analyse market trends, customer needs and competitive positioning.
  • Establish product-governance and commercial-performance processes in collaboration with relevant control functions.
  • Ensure that customer communications, campaigns and distribution arrangements comply with applicable financial-promotion and consumer-protection requirements.
  • Represent Freedom Digital Bank France at industry events and in meetings with strategic partners.
  • Build and lead the local business-development organisation.
  • Support the commercial, product and customer-acquisition sections of the regulatory authorisation application.

Requirements
  • 10+ years of commercial leadership, business development or general management experience within digital banking, banking, fintech, payments or another regulated financial-services business.
  • Strong track record of customer acquisition, partnership development and revenue growth.
  • Experience launching or scaling digital financial products in France.
  • Established network within the French banking, fintech, payments or broader financial-services ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of French conduct-of-business, consumer-protection and financial-promotion requirements.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements applicable to digital distribution, partnerships, remote customer acquisition and the launch of banking products in France.
  • Familiarity with relevant ACPR and AMF expectations, GDPR, distance-selling requirements, product-governance rules and consumer-protection frameworks.
  • Experience developing compliant customer propositions, marketing campaigns and distribution models with Compliance and Legal teams.
  • Experience supporting a regulatory authorisation, market entry or launch of a regulated financial institution in France or another EU jurisdiction is strongly preferred.
  • Strong commercial judgement, strategic thinking and execution skills.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Full professional fluency in French and English is mandatory.

Benefits
  • Employment contract in accordance with French labor law;
  • Relocation package for the employee and family members;
  • 50% coverage of the annual health insurance cost for the employee and eligible family members;
  • 25 days of annual leave, public holidays, and all statutory leave entitlements.
  • On-site work in a modern, well-located office.

title: Director, Customer Insight & Experience – Europe
description:

Director, Customer Insight & Experience – Europe

Every great business decision starts with understanding customers!
At Sage, we're building the next generation of customer-centric, AI-powered business solutions. As our new Director, Customer Insight & Experience, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how customer, market and experience insights influence strategic decisions across Europe.

title: MDM Solution Lead
description:
Job Title: MDM Solution Lead

Division / Function: Global Digital Information Technology (GDIT) – Global Data & AI Division

Manager’s Job Title: Head of Data & AI Governance and Data Management

Ipsen Job Profile: Data Management

Location: FR (Paris) or GB (London)

WHAT - Summary & Purpose of the Position

Ipsen is a dynamic and growing global specialty-driven biopharmaceutical company focused on innovation and specialty care.

We aim to make a sustainable difference by significantly improving patients’ health and quality of life and providing them with effective therapeutic solutions for unmet medical needs through differentiated and innovative medicines in oncology, neurosciences and rare diseases.

Ipsen also benefits from a rich heritage in primary care and a healthy portfolio in its growing Consumer Healthcare global business unit with outstanding products in gastroenterology and neurodegenerative diseases.

The patient is at the heart of everything we do, and we also care for our employees because they are the ambassadors who truly make the difference. We attract and develop bold, agile, entrepreneurial individuals who take full ownership of their decisions; leaders drawn by a purpose to make a direct impact through their work in people’s lives.

We offer employees a wealth of fulfilling challenges & growth opportunities, and the chance to contribute within a fast-moving organisation, an organisation that is genuinely game-changing.

The Global Digital IT (GDIT) division is dedicated to being the business partner of choice for digital, data, and technologies, delivering outstanding value at speed and scale for patients and Ipsen. In this transformative context, GDIT plays a crucial role in driving innovation and efficiency across the organization.

Within GDIT, the Global Data & AI Division was established with the mission to act as a business enabler. This department is responsible for driving the strategic use of Data and AI across Ipsen and enhance business interoperability.

The Master Data Management (MDM) Solution Lead is responsible for defining, delivering, operating, and continuously improving Ipsen's Enterprise Master Data Management capabilities and associated technology platforms.

The role ensures that business-critical master data domains are governed, maintained, and leveraged effectively across the enterprise to support business operations, digital transformation initiatives, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision-making.

The position combines strategic leadership, platform ownership, operational excellence, and transformation delivery, while working closely with Data Governance, Enterprise Architecture, Business Functions, and Delivery Partners to drive adoption, quality, and business value realization.

The role has direct accountability for the Enterprise MDM operating model, platform roadmap, service delivery, data quality improvement, vendor management, and continuous evolution of Ipsen's MDM ecosystem.


WHAT - Main Responsibilities & Technical Competencies

Enterprise MDM Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute the Enterprise MDM strategy and roadmap aligned with business priorities.
  • Lead the evolution of Ipsen's MDM capabilities across all data domains.
  • Ensure MDM capabilities support business growth, compliance requirements, and operational efficiency.
  • Drive adoption of enterprise master data processes, standards, and best practices.
    • Act as the primary business and IT focal point for Enterprise MDM initiatives.

Enterprise MDM Platform Ownership

  • Own the vision, roadmap, lifecycle, and value realization of the Enterprise MDM Platform.
  • Lead the solution design of MDM projects and associated services.
  • Ensure platform scalability, performance, resilience, and operational stability.
  • Drive continuous platform modernization and capability expansion.
    • Govern platform investments, priorities, and technology decisions related to MDM capabilities.

MDM Operating Model & Service Delivery

  • Define and continuously improve the Enterprise MDM operating model.
  • Ensure effective execution of support, maintenance, enhancement, and operational activities.
  • Lead incident management, problem management, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor and improve service performance through KPIs and SLAs.
    • Drive operational excellence across all MDM services and processes.

Data Quality & Stewardship Enablement

Partner with Data Manager Lead and/or Business Data Owners and/or Local Data Stewards to:

  • Improve data quality across master data domains.
  • Define data quality objectives, monitoring processes, and remediation plans.
  • Support stewardship activities through appropriate tools, workflows, and operational processes.
  • Co-lead specific initiatives to improve completeness, consistency, accuracy, and reliability of master data.
    • Ensure master data supports business processes and downstream systems effectively.

Architecture & Integration Leadership (in close collaboration with the Data Architect)

  • Define target-state architectures for master data management and distribution.
  • Ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture, Platform, Integration, Security, Privacy, and Compliance requirements.
  • Lead MDM-related design reviews and architecture decisions.
  • Promote standard integration patterns and reusable services for master data consumption.
    • Support the integration of master data across enterprise platforms and business applications.

Business Transformation & Continuous Improvement (in collaboration with the Data Manager Lead)

  • Assess current-state business processes, data flows, and MDM capabilities.
  • Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, risks, and technical debt.
  • Define and execute remediation and improvement roadmaps.
  • Support harmonization of master data processes across regions and business functions.
    • Drive simplification, automation, and standardization initiatives.

Product Ownership & Demand Management

  • Own and prioritize the Enterprise MDM backlog.
  • Govern demand intake and prioritization processes.
  • Balance business demand, operational sustainability, compliance requirements, and strategic objectives.
  • Ensure successful delivery of releases, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
    • Drive adoption and business value realization.

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Manage strategic relationships with support partners, software vendors, and managed service providers.
  • Govern delivery quality, service performance, vendor and support contractual commitments, and financial performance.
  • Lead regular operational and strategic vendor reviews.
    • Optimize delivery models and resource utilization.

Data, Analytics & AI Enablement

  • Ensure Enterprise MDM provides trusted master data foundations for Analytics and AI initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Data & AI teams to maximize business value from mastered data assets.
  • Support the development of business capabilities enabled by trusted enterprise master data.
    • Promote reuse of MDM assets across digital transformation programs.

Financial Management

  • Manage the Enterprise MDM Platform and support budget and associated investments.
  • Build business cases supporting platform evolution and strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure effective allocation of resources and optimization of operating costs.
    • Track and communicate value realization from MDM investments.

Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as trusted advisor to Business and IT stakeholders for Enterprise MDM matters.
  • Active contribution to steering Committees, Design Authorities, Change Boards, and executive reviews related to MDM.
  • Communicate MDM Maturity level, risks, service performance, and business value outcomes.
    • Facilitate alignment and decision-making across cross-functional teams.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Define the team setup, roles, and responsibilities needed to run the MDM platform.
  • Organize regular reviews for backlog, incidents, service performance, roadmap, and delivery.
  • Make sure each activity has a clear owner, including support, data quality, releases, vendors, and business requests.
    • Follow support and platform performance using simple KPIs such as incidents, backlog progress, SLA, release quality, data quality, and user satisfaction.

HOW - Knowledge & Experience


Knowledge & Experience (required):

  • 15+ years of experience in Master Data Management, Data Platforms, Data Operations, or Digital Transformation.
  • Proven experience leading enterprise-scale MDM platforms, operating models, service delivery, and transformation initiatives.
  • Strong expertise in MDM platform ownership, roadmap management, lifecycle governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience managing global teams, vendors, managed service providers, and strategic partners in a matrix and international environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management, senior-level facilitation, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience in financial planning, budget management, business case development, and cost optimization.
    • Strong knowledge of Data Quality, MDM operations, stewardship processes, master data domains, reference data, and issue remediation practices.

Knowledge & Experience (preferred):

  • Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, or other highly regulated industry experience.
  • Knowledge of GxP / CSV expectations, GDPR constraints, data integrity, privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with Reltio or equivalent Enterprise MDM platforms.
  • Experience with cloud-based integration patterns, enterprise data ecosystems, and downstream data consumption models.
    • Experience enabling Analytics and AI initiatives through trusted, governed, and high-quality master data foundations.

Key Success Measures:

  • Improvement of master data quality, reduction of data and process issues, and increased efficiency of MDM operations.
  • Platform availability, operational stability, vendor performance, and cost optimization.
  • Successful delivery of MDM roadmap commitments, rollout of new domains and capabilities, and adoption by business stakeholders.
    • Contribution to enterprise data governance objectives and measurable business value realization from MDM investments.

Education / Certifications:

  • Master’s degree in information management, data management, business administration, engineering, computer science, life sciences, or a related field.
    • Certification or formal training in data governance, data management, data quality, MDM, privacy, or related frameworks is a plus.

Language(s):

  • English and French fluent.
    • Another major business language is a plus.

title: Marketing Operations Lead
description:
The Marketing Operations Lead is responsible for establishing and operating SCOR’s marketing operations function across business units: Property & Casualty (P&C) and Life & Health (L&H). The role owns the marketing automation ecosystem ensuring data quality, lead management, campaign execution, and performance measurement while implementing robust governance and GDPR-compliant processes.

Acting as the central point of contact between Marketing, IT, Compliance, Data Governance, and business stakeholders, the role develops standards, processes, and reporting frameworks that enable scalable, efficient, and compliant marketing activities while driving continuous improvement and business impact.


Key duties and responsibilities:

1. Marketing Automation Platform & Data

  • Lead a benchmark of our marketing technology stack (current: Pardot / Account Engagement + Salesforce) and recommend the path forward before further investment

  • Own the marketing automation platform as Product Owner: configuration, campaign builds, workflows and integrations

  • Ensure reliable, real-time synchronization between Salesforce and the automation platform

  • Own data quality end-to-end: deduplication, bounce and unsubscribe processing, consent records and suppression list management

  • Maintain a clear data model for contacts and campaigns (fields, attributes, consent status) so the same information means the same thing across P&C and L&H.

2. Governance & Compliance

  • Define and enforce clear governance: roles, responsibilities and a standard campaign validation process across P&C, L&H, IT and Compliance

  • Centralize all campaign sends through the authorized platform

  • Ensure GDPR-compliant practices across campaigns: legal basis, consent, tracking configuration and opt-out management

  • Monitor send volume and frequency per contact to avoid over-solicitation of brokers, cedents and clients, and manage complaint and unsubscribe signals

  • Partner with Legal/Compliance and IT/Data Governance to remediate deliverability issues and protect domain

3. Performance, KPIs & Reporting

  • Define marketing KPIs in collaboration with the Global Head of Marketing and build and maintain the Group performance dashboard

  • Track and report on campaign performance, deliverability health and funnel metrics

  • Provide regular, structured reporting to the Global Head of Marketing and leadership

4. Lead Management

  • Own lead scoring, segmentation and nurture workflow design

  • Ensure clean, timely handoff of qualified leads to business teams

  • Track lead-to-opportunity performance in partnership with business teams

5. Enablement, Documentation & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as the day-to-day interface with IT, Compliance/DPO, Data Governance and business teams across P&C and L&H

  • Build and maintain a campaign governance playbook: standards, templates and approval process.

  • Train and onboard the L&H and P&C contributors on tools, process and best practiceRepresent Marketing Operations in relevant cross-functional forums (e.g. data governance, IT security) as the function's single point of contact reputation.


Required experience & competencies

  • 8 years minimum of experience in marketing operations, CRM/marketing automation or related roles.

  • Experience in B2B, financial services or (re)insurance is a strong plus

  • Hands-on expertise with Salesforce and a marketing automation platform (Pardot/Account Engagement, Marketo, HubSpot or similar)

  • Solid understanding of data governance and GDPR / consent management requirements

  • Equally comfortable operating strategically (governance, KPIs) and hands-on (tool configuration, data hygiene)

  • Comfortable building process, documentation and structure from scratch in an environment where marketing operations doesn't yet exist as a formal function

  • Rigorous, autonomous and able to bring clarity to an ambiguous, fast-evolving environmentProven track record influencing and aligning cross-functional stakeholders: IT, Compliance, Data, and business teams.

Required Education

title: Responsable de Marché assurances professionnelles / Head of Product PSC (gn)
description:
Job Type:

Permanent

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox


Poste: Responsable de Marché assurances professionnelles / Head of Product PSC

Reporte à : Technical Underwriting Director

Lieu: Paris / Bordeaux / Lyon

Description de la compagnie :

Hiscox, assureur spécialisé depuis 1901, est implanté en France depuis 30 ans où il assure près de 200 000 particuliers et professionnels. Assureur historique d'Art et de biens d'exception pour les clients privés, Hiscox a ensuite su développer son expertise dans le domaine de l'assurance professionnelle avec une gamme spécialisée couvrant désormais près de 1000 professions de services.

L'entreprise est aujourd'hui leader dans l'assurance des PME et TPE et a développé une offre complète et compétitive sur le marché.

Hiscox a été pionnier de l'assurance en ligne et via des conseillers pour les entrepreneurs et les travailleurs indépendants.

C'est la connaissance et la compréhension des activités et des risques de ses clients, la mobilisation des meilleurs experts avant, pendant et après les sinistres qui permettent à Hiscox de construire des couvertures adaptées à leurs besoins.

Hiscox vise à changer l'expérience de l'assurance pour ses clients et s'engage à protéger ce qui compte pour eux.

Description du poste :

Gestion et développement de portefeuille dans la rentabilité.

Responsabilité inititale de 4 lignes d’assurance / marchés :

RC réglementée (RC métiers de la sécurité, du tourisme, scheme promoteurs) – Trad PI Responsabilité du Dirigeant – D&0 Proposition organisateurs d’événements (RC organisateur d’événement + annulation + dommages) – Event proposition Individuelle accident – Personal accident

Au sein de la Direction Technique vous êtes rattaché au Directeur Technique dans une équipe de 8 personnes dont 5 responsables de Marché.

Votre mission sera :

  • d’analyser et diagnostiquer des comportements des portefeuilles sous responsabilité pour valider leur développement profitable et la conformité de leur développement par rapport à la stratégie de l’entreprise ;
  • d’optimiser l’adéquation de l’offre au marché de façon à soutenir un développement profitable en agissant sur les variables prix, garanties, souscription et en innovant quand c’est nécessaire sur l’offre ;
  • de mener les actions nécessaires au maintien de la profitabilité dans le temps en réagissant suffisamment tôt aux signaux précurseurs. En cas de dérive de la profitabilité, proposer et faire valider les actions correctrices nécessaires.

Développer l’expertise technique

  • Maintenir et développer sa propre expertise technique et sa parfaite maitrise du guide de souscription et de la souscription en général (en intégrant les aspects techniques et commerciaux, les besoins client).
  • En collaboration avec la Direction Technique Europe et ses homologues sur les lignes d’assurance confiées, participer aux évolutions du guide de souscription et à ses adaptations au marché local.
  • En collaboration avec les actuaires (Europe), faire évoluer les algorithmes de tarification et / ou savoir mener des actions plus tactiques sur les tarifs pour optimiser le développement profitable.
  • Clarifier les intentions de souscription et les traduire dans les clauses et wordings en collaborant notamment avec le « wording comittees » comités de validation des wordings et des clauses.
  • Revoir la sinistralité des portefeuilles afin de piloter et projeter la rentabilité.
  • Répondre aux demandes de referrals des équipes de souscription au quotidien et accompagner les souscripteurs dans leur compréhension des contraintes techniques.
  • Former et développer les compétences de souscription de la communauté de souscripteurs, être référent, et en dialogue régulier avec les équipes sinistres.
  • Accompagner les équipes commerciales et souscripteurs auprès des partenaires pour promouvoir l’expertise, les offres, et être support de la concrétisation commerciale.

Mener des projets

  • Savoir organiser son temps pour mener des projets de développement, d’amélioration des produits ou de souscription, et participer à des projets d’animation produit.
  • Participer, le cas échéant, aux projets de développement de schemes (délégations spécifiques avec offre spécifique) qui seraient confiés, de A à Z sur la partie technique.
  • Travailler pour cela en transverse avec les souscripteurs et les équipes Marketing et Communication, la Direction du Change et de l’IT quand c’est nécessaire.
  • Être ambassadeur de l’expertise Hiscox, sur les réseaux sociaux et porte-parole presse de l’expertise Hiscox sur ce marché.

Votre profil:

Compétences et savoir être

  • Souscripteur ou doté d’une expérience de souscription vous êtes doté(e) de solides savoir-faire analytique (notamment à partir de données – excel – ou d’indicateurs clés), vous êtes capable de diagnostiquer une problématique à partir notamment de données ou de faits.
  • Vous disposez de connaissance de tout ou partie des 4 lignes sous responsabilité (voir plus haut) ou démontrez la capacité à les apprendre et les maitriser
  • Organisé(e), vous êtes capables de conjuguer une activité opérationnelle (réponse aux referrals, contrôles de souscription) – réactive, et une activité de développement de projet – pro active.
  • Diplomate et pédagogue, vous savez expliquer simplement des phénomènes complexes et convaincre, embarquer dans la direction que vous souhaitez donner à vos lignes de produit.
  • Français, Anglais courant ou très bonne aisance requise.

Diversité, Equité, Inclusion chez HISCOX

« Chez Hiscox, nous sommes convaincus de notre richesse humaine parce que nos valeurs encouragent la diversité. Avec plus de 3000 collaborateur.trice.s dans le monde, c’est autant d’identités qui représentent l’essence de notre culture.

Chaque candidature est considérée sans tenir compte de l’origine, de la nationalité, de la religion, du genre, de l’âge, du handicap, ou de l’orientation sexuelle, afin de promouvoir l’égalité des chances pour tous.

Aussi, nous favorisons un environnement de travail agréable, bienveillant et inclusif, pour développer le plein potentiel de chacun ».

Le reflet de nos pratiques actuelles

  • L’index sur l’égalité hommes femmes 2022 est à 92%.
  • L’accord de télétravail mis en place depuis 2021 permet aux collaborateurs de bénéficier jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine pour un bon équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle.
  • Notre partenariat auprès de la plateforme spécialisée JobinLive pour le recrutement des populations seniors (Senior Job) et des populations en situation de handicap (Cap Emploi).

Great Place To Work

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer que notre filiale française a obtenu la certification Great Place To Work et « Best Place to Work », avec un taux de participation exceptionnel de 82% et un taux de réponses positives de 87%. Chez Hiscox, nous sommes déterminés à créer un environnement de travail exceptionnel où chaque voix compte. Rejoignez-nous aujourd’hui pour faire partie de cette aventure enrichissante, dans un environnement où votre talent est célébré et le bien-être au cœur de notre réussite.
