title: Securitised Derivatives Analyst
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of capital markets? We are looking for a Securitised Derivatives Analyst to join the Indices, ETFs and Securitised Derivatives team. The position will be based in Paris, and start as soon as possible. You will report to the Head of Securitised Derivatives.

You will support the development and growth of Euronext's Warrants & Certificates franchise. Working closely with senior team members, the role covers business development, market analysis, client support, regulatory monitoring, and operational projects. The successful candidate will gain exposure to the full value chain of Structured Products, interacting with issuers, liquidity providers, regulators, and internal stakeholders.

Key Accountabilities

Business Analysis & Commercial Support

  • Support business initiatives aimed at growing the W&C franchise across Euronext markets.

  • Analyse market trends, competitor activity, and pricing models to support commercial decisions.

  • Contribute to business cases, presentations, internal reporting, and the monthly invoicing process.

Client Support

  • Support relationships with issuers, distributors, liquidity providers, and other market participants.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve client requests and gather market intelligence to identify business opportunities.

Regulatory & Market Research

  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting the Structured Products industry.

  • Support the preparation of analyses and responses related to regulatory consultations and market trends.

Market Infrastructure & Projects

  • Support projects to improve listing, trading, and post-trade processes.

  • Assist in gathering business requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, and contributing to testing and process documentation.

Market Intelligence & Marketing

  • Collect and analyse market statistics; prepare regular reports and dashboards on market activity and KPIs.

  • Contribute to marketing materials, newsletters, client communications, and digital content.

  • Support the organisation of industry events, webinars, and client engagement activities.

Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field.

  • 1–2 years of experience in financial markets, consulting, or banking (internships included).

  • Project Management skills: structured, organised approach and an experience with project management is a plus.

  • Strong analytical skills; excellent command of Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, or Python is a plus.

  • Interest in financial markets, derivatives, and Structured Products.

  • Strong communication and organisational skills; ability to work in an international environment.

  • Fluent in French and English; additional European languages are a plus.

Join a company where market infrastructure is built on innovation – and where every innovation starts with a bold mind asking, “What’s next?”. At Euronext, we believe change is a starting point, not an obstacle. We look for people who see growth opportunities, think long term and want to help shape capital markets for future generations. Working with us means:

  • Learning as you grow – Develop your skills through continuous learning, real responsibilities and flexible career paths that evolve with you.

  • Driving sustainability – Play an active role in building transparent, responsible and sustainable capital markets for the long term. Together, we do not just support markets – we help shape their future.

Apply by submitting a CV in English

Accountability

title: Field Marketing Specialist
description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

The French market is one of Dust’s most important growth levers, and the Marketing team plays a central role in supporting pipeline generation through events, content and account-based activations.

As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation.

The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion.

You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme

  • Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery.

  • Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content.

  • Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity.

Own French social media and content activation

  • Own social media execution for Dust around events, campaigns and key French-market topics.

  • Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity.

  • Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences.

  • Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets.

Support partner marketing and Growth programmes

  • Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns.

  • Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials.

  • Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation.

Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B Marketing, ideally across Field Marketing, Event Marketing, Content Marketing or Product Marketing, preferably in SaaS or technology.

  • End-to-end event ownership with the ability to plan and deliver conferences, executive events and Dust-owned events, from preparation through execution and post-event follow-up.

  • Strong content and social media skills with experience creating or repurposing content for enterprise audiences across social media, landing pages, customer stories, YouTube, Sales enablement and executive LinkedIn profiles.

  • Commercial and pipeline mindset with a clear understanding of how events, content and account-based activities support Sales, BDRs, direct pipeline and partner-led growth.

  • Excellent communication skills in French and English, both written and spoken. You can write clearly and accurately, adapt your tone to different audiences and communicate credibly with enterprise executives.

  • Generalist and hands-on approach. You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. You anticipate needs, manage deadlines reliably and ensure that projects, events and content are properly prepared before launch.

  • Self-starter mentality. You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You know how to find and coordinate the right people across Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Customer Success, Partnerships and external partners.

  • Nice to have: Experience marketing to French enterprise or CAC 40 audiences, working with agencies or media partners, supporting paid campaigns, producing webinars or video content, and working with tools such as HubSpot, Google Workspace and Figma.

  • Location and travel: Based in Paris, comfortable working on-site and willing to travel occasionally for events in France.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct pipeline impact: Your work will directly support Sales and BDRs through events, content and ABM activations.

  • Execution ownership in France: You will turn the priorities defined by the France Marketing Lead into high-quality events, content, social media and partner marketing activations in France.

  • AI-native Marketing: You will use Dust to automate research, preparation, content production, reporting and follow-up.

  • Generalist scope: The role combines events, content, social media, webinars, Sales enablement and ABM.

  • Market-shaping opportunity: Help establish Dust as a leading voice in the French enterprise and agentic AI market.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Agents at work - Latent Space, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024

  • LLMs reasoning and agentic capabilities over time - dotAI, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024

Compensation Range: €50K - €65K

title: Account Manager
description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.


How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.


As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
his is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

Qualifications:

  • Fluency in French and English are mandatory.
  • Fluency in Italian is a plus.
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
  • Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.

Why join us?

Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

‍
  • ️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

Competitive salary package & benefits


DE&I Statement:

At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.

We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.

We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Head of Engineering GPU
description:
OUR STORY:
Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow !
Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies.
Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector.
With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.
Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.
Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.


WHY WE NEED YOU ?

As our GPU Cloud business continues to scale, we are strengthening our engineering leadership to support the deployment and operation of increasingly large and complex GPU clusters.

Your mission will be to lead our Support Engineering, HPC, and SRE teams, own key technology and architecture decisions, and ensure that our most strategic GPU infrastructure projects are successfully designed, delivered, and operated.

You will also play a critical role in validating the technical feasibility of commercial proposals and ensuring that the commitments we make to customers can be delivered reliably on our sovereign cloud infrastructure.


YOUR FUTURE TEAM

We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a strong culture of knowledge sharing, helps us bring ambitious projects to life.

You will lead an organization of 14 engineers across two squads, each managed by an Engineering Manager reporting directly to you.

As part of the broader GPU Cloud organization, reporting to the SVP GPU Cloud, you will work closely with GTM, Operations, Service Management, Product, and other engineering teams to build and operate large-scale AI and HPC infrastructure.


YOUR DAILY ROUTINE

Tasks

  • Lead the Support Engineering, HPC, and SRE organizations, directly managing two Engineering Managers responsible for 14 engineers
  • Own the technical strategy, architecture, and key technology choices for GPU Cloud infrastructure
  • Review and validate the technical and service dimensions of strategic commercial proposals, ensuring commitments are realistic and deliverable
  • Oversee the design, deployment, and operational readiness of new GPU clusters
  • Drive the evolution of our cluster management, capacity management, automation, and operational capabilities
  • Ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and maintainability of our GPU infrastructure
  • Provide technical leadership on complex AI and HPC infrastructure projects
  • Build strong alignment between Engineering, GTM, Product, and Operations
  • Develop the engineering organization through clear direction, effective delegation, coaching, and long-term team development
  • Establish and maintain high standards of engineering rigor, operational excellence, and technical decision-making

ABOUT YOU

HARDSKILLS:

  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, including significant experience leading senior technical teams and managers
  • Proven experience designing, deploying, or operating large-scale infrastructure and compute clusters
  • Familiarity in GPU and/or HPC environments, ideally involving NVIDIA and AMD technologies
  • Strong understanding of distributed infrastructure, cluster architecture, reliability, and production operations
  • Experience with orchestration, provisioning, and observability technologies such as Kubernetes, Proxmox, Warewulf, Prometheus, and Grafana
  • Experience with high-performance and distributed storage technologies such as Lustre, DDN, and VAST Data
  • Ability to assess architectural trade-offs and translate complex technical constraints into clear engineering and business decisions

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead experienced engineers and Engineering Managers
  • Ability to navigate complex technical, organizational, and business situations
  • High level of rigor and a strong sense of ownership
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and planning skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management abilities
  • Ability to synthesize complex engineering topics and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable making decisions in fast-moving environments with high technical and operational stakes

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY

  • Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.

  • Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.

  • Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.

  • Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.

  • International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.

  • Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers.


Why join the Scaleway adventure?

✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.

✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.

✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.


THE NEXT STEPS …

  • HR discovery call (30 min)

  • Interview with to understand your technical skills and approach to the role (45 min)

  • Technical interview with CTO to validate your expertise (1h)

  • Interview with Management to deepen discussions and assess your fit with the team (45 min)

  • HR interview to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues

Scaleway is a company certified under SecNumCloud. A background check is mandatory in order to join the company.
At Scaleway, we are committed to building an inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone has a fair opportunity to thrive.
All applications are considered with care, regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, or any other characteristic.
We believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone which is why you should definitely apply.

title: Head of Compliance/ RSCI
description:
About Freedom

Freedom Digital Bank France will form part of Freedom Holding Corp., a diversified international financial services group publicly listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker FRHC. The Group operates across Europe, the United States and Central Asia, with activities spanning banking, brokerage, investment services, insurance, payments and digital consumer services.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Head of Compliance to establish and lead the compliance function of Freedom Digital Bank France.

The final regulated designation and scope of the position, including a potential RCSI designation, will be determined by the entity’s licensing perimeter, products and regulated activities.

The Head of Compliance will develop the local compliance framework, advise senior management and the Board, oversee financial-crime compliance and maintain effective relationships with the relevant French and European authorities.

As a member of the founding executive team, the role will lead the compliance workstream for the regulatory authorisation process and ensure continuing adherence to the conditions, commitments and supervisory expectations associated with the bank’s licence.

Key responsibilities:
  • Establish and lead the compliance function of Freedom Digital Bank France.
  • Develop and maintain the local compliance framework, compliance monitoring programme and governance arrangements.
  • Lead the compliance workstream for the bank’s French regulatory authorisation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable ACPR, AMF, EBA and EU regulatory requirements, according to the bank’s final licensing and product scope.
  • Oversee AML/CFT, KYC, sanctions, transaction monitoring and financial crime frameworks.
  • Establish processes for suspicious activity reporting and engagement with TRACFIN.
  • Ensure that digital onboarding, customer journeys, marketing communications and financial products meet applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Advise senior management and the Board on compliance risks and regulatory obligations.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and coordinate the implementation of required changes.
  • Establish and maintain compliance policies, procedures and controls.
  • Conduct compliance risk assessments and thematic reviews.
  • Manage regulatory reporting, information requests, regulatory inspections and remediation programmes.
  • Act as a key point of contact with French regulators and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Review new products, partnerships, outsourcing arrangements and distribution models from a compliance perspective.
  • Work closely with Risk, Legal, Product, Technology, Operations and Business teams.
    • Promote a strong compliance culture and conduct culture across the bank.


Requirements
  • 10+ years of compliance experience within digital banking, banking, payments, investment services, brokerage or fintech.
  • Previous experience as a Head of Compliance, Chief Compliance Officer, RCSI or in an equivalent senior regulated position.
  • In-depth knowledge of French and EU banking and financial-services regulation.
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable ACPR and AMF requirements, AML/CFT, KYC, sanctions, consumer protection, GDPR, PSD2 and MiFID II, according to the bank’s product scope.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging with the ACPR, AMF, TRACFIN or other French and European regulatory authorities.
  • Experience preparing or supporting regulatory authorisation applications, supervisory inspections and remediation programmes.
  • Strong knowledge of French AML/CFT reporting, regulatory recordkeeping and financial crime controls.
  • Experience advising on digital financial products, remote onboarding and technology-enabled customer journeys.
  • Eligibility and professional standing to hold the applicable regulated compliance position in France, subject to the entity’s final governance and licensing structure.
  • Excellent communication, judgement and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Full professional fluency in French and English is mandatory, including the ability to engage with regulators and prepare regulatory documentation in French.

Benefits
  • Employment contract in accordance with French labor law;
  • Relocation package for the employee and family members;
  • 50% coverage of the annual health insurance cost for the employee and eligible family members;
  • 25 days of annual leave, public holidays, and all statutory leave entitlements.
  • On-site work in a modern, well-located office.

description:

Courbevoie, FR

Global Director of Media Relations & Corporate Content

CEVA Logistics provides global supply chain solutions to connect people, products, and providers all around the world. Present in 170+ countries and with more than 110,000 employees spread over 1,500 sites, we are proud to be a Top 5 global 3PL.

We believe that our employees are the key to our success. We want to engage and empower our diverse, global team to co-create value with our customers through our solutions in contract logistics and air, ocean, ground, and finished vehicle transport. That is why CEVA Logistics offers a dynamic and exceptional work environment that fosters personal growth, innovation, and continuous improvement.

At CEVA Logistics, we Rise in Motion. Your career is always on the move, growing as fast and as far as your ambition takes you. Join a global team of nearly 200 nationalities, shaping the future of global trade, moving essential goods, forging new paths, and pushing boundaries to serve an ever-changing world. The pace is fast, the challenges are real, but the rewards are greater: growth, purpose, and the chance to make a meaningful impact. This is more than a job. It’s a journey on which you rise.

YOUR ROLE

Reporting to the Chief Communications Officer, the Global Head of Media Relations and Corporate Content is responsible for developing and implementing the communication strategy for all media relations activities and critical internal and external communications programs, including executive communications. The position is also responsible for strategic communication activities and corporate content, including the company’s overall corporate messaging and content consistency in support of the CEVA brand visual identity, as managed by the Brand and Digital Communications team

WHAT ARE YOU GOING TO DO?

Manages the media relations, strategic communications and corporate content policies, planning and budget, in coordination with overall corporate communications goals.
Direct, develop or maintain all corporate-level content and messaging, ensuring consistent positioning and messaging across all communications channels—internal and external.
Extend written brand voice and maintain written brand integrity across all platforms in close connection with the brand manager in the marketing communications team.
Support Chief Communications Officer in building CEO and Executive Board communications to key internal and external stakeholders (Group, Management, Employees, Media, Industry Events, etc.).
Support all M&A activities with strategy, messaging and content services.
Support thought activities with strategy, messaging and content services.
Coordinating cross-functional projects with digital, social media and internal communications teams where needed.
Manages applicable awards and rankings process, identifying strategic awards to boost CEVA’s credibility and awareness in key markets or geographies (e.g. Gartner, Top 3PL lists).
Performing research into audience demographics and devising strategies accordingly for press opportunities at the GHO and Regional levels.
Designating and training spokespeople for the organization; serving as the GHO spokesperson when needed.
Manage crisis response by coming up with a rapid response plan and ensuring that official communications go to the proper media channels.
Provide advice to leadership on strategic communication strategies and any ongoing or planned campaigns.
Monitoring coverage across different media types.
Writing and approving press releases and other PR collateral at the GHO or regional level. Coordinating with local CEVA or PR agency resources as needed.
Coordinating press conferences and media availability.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree in public relations, communications or journalism
12-15 years of progressive communications experience (agency, corporate, etc.)
Outstanding written and oral English communication skills; working-level French is a plus, but not required
Extensive global communications experience
Perform as a leader with minimal supervision, taking full ownership of projects and either functioning autonomously or working in coordination with matrixed team structures on specific projects.
Ability to interact with C-suite executives naturally and effectively
Teamwork and the ability to lead and motivate coworkers or direct reports to produce high-level, brand-driven content
Analytical skills to solve problems and find the best way to convey a message
Organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and prioritize projects while working on a deadline or in a fast-paced environment
Flexible approach to working hours in order to support a 24/7 global organization

As a global organization, and as part of the CMA CGM Group, diversity is critical to our business success; only when we can reflect the cultures, languages, behaviors and local knowledge of our customers, we can succeed. By employing people with different experiences and abilities, we expand our knowledge and increase our creativity and innovation.

Please note: Legitimate CEVA Logistics recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn or via an official company email address: firstname.lastname@cevalogistics.com. We recommend that you do not respond to unsolicited business propositions and/or offers from people with whom you are unfamiliar.

title: Head of Customer Operations
description:
Our Mission

Money sitting idle is money lost. We're fixing that.

Founded in 2023 by Antoine and Paul-Adrien, Spiko gives businesses, non-profits, financial advisers, and fintechs access to institutional-grade cash management, via app or API. We are building the full infrastructure: issuing, operating, and distributing the products ourselves.

Two years after launch, we serve thousands of organizations across Europe and process hundreds of millions of euros in flows every month.

Our ambition: become the world's leading treasury management infrastructure in a market worth trillions.

We are backed by Index Ventures, the CEO of Revolut, the founder of Kyriba, and the CTO of Wise.

Spiko runs on excellence, transparency, and straight talk.

The role: Head of Customer Operations

We are looking for the next leader of our Customer Ops team, reporting to our co-founder Antoine.

The team is accountable for the customer experience from a customer's first onboarding step through to their day-to-day questions, and its goal is to make that experience as smooth as possible.

It has two main workstreams:

  • Owning account approval (KYC) for new customers: applying our internal rules and handling the back-and-forth that regulatory constraints sometimes require during onboarding.

  • Owning customer care across all our support channels, for every customer segment from high-touch, high-value accounts to the smallest ones.

Your missions

As our Head of Customer Ops, you will:

  • Build & Scale the Team: You will shape our customer ops team from day one: recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing ops team as we scale our user base from 3,000 to 100,000+.

  • Define Success Metrics: Establish, track, and own the KPIs that define customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

  • Pioneer AI-Driven Operations: Design and deploy best-in-class automation and LLM-powered workflows to scale support capacity without linear headcount growth.

  • Curate Strategic Knowledge: Own our internal and external knowledge bases, ensuring partners and team members have real-time access to accurate product insights.

  • Collaborate with Product and Compliance: Partner closely with Product and Compliance teams, acting as the "Voice of the Customer" to directly influence our product roadmap.

Requirements (must-haves):

  • Must-Haves:

    • Experience: 5+ years in Operations or Customer Service, with a proven track record of leading teams in fast-paced B2B environments.

    • Systems Thinker: You are obsessed with efficiency. You would rather build a permanent automated solution than perform a manual task twice.

    • Customer-Obsessed: You are a relentless advocate for a "Tier-1" experience. You are equally comfortable navigating high-stakes meetings with CFOs as you are optimizing low-touch flows for high-volume segments.

    • Communication: You are fluent in French and English, with the ability to simplify complex financial concepts for any audience.

    Nice-to-Haves:

    • Fintech Expertise: Prior experience in financial services or a high-growth fintech environment.

    • Technical Literacy: Comfort working with API documentation and technical integration workflows.What we offer

What we offer

  • Compensation: Competitive package depending on experience + Stock Options

  • Offices: in central Paris & London

  • Remote work: up to 2 days per week and one full remote week per month

  • The best tech for your job: latest-generation laptops and industry-leading software

  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Spiko

  • Monthly Budget to cover different perks of choice

  • Transport: 50% of public transport pass covered or the Forfait Mobilités Durables (FMD)

  • Referral Bonus

  • Social life: regular afterworks and biannual offsites

Our hiring process

  • 45-minute interview by video call or in person with Antoine, co-founder

  • Take-home case study to prepare and present at our offices

  • Final interview in person with the founders and key team members. This is about making sure your profile and aspirations align with our culture, mission, and goals

  • Reference check: we’ll contact two people you’ve worked with, ideally former managers

  • Offer

If something here doesn't match your résumé perfectly but you believe you'd thrive in this role, apply anyway. Tell us why.

title: Business Development Director (Paris)
description:
Mangopay is a wallet-based payment infrastructure built specifically for organisations with complex, multi-party fund flows. A pioneer in multi-party payments.

Our solution optimises fund flows on behalf of the organisations we work with using wallets as programmable, composable building blocks.

Mangopay’s regulated platform collects payments, secures transactions and holds funds, splits money between the various parties in the funds flow, and ultimately manages the payout to service providers, sellers, and consumers.

Platforms and fintechs using Mangopay regain control and transparency over multi-party payment flows, generate additional revenue, and improve operational efficiency. They can stay compliant while innovating and scaling.

Job Description

Reporting to the VP Sales, you will be responsible for driving the commercial growth of our strategic client portfolio while leading a high-performing sales organization.

As Business Development Director, you will define and execute the regional sales strategy, and personally engage in the acquisition of strategic enterprise accounts. You will play a critical role in accelerating revenue growth, optimizing sales execution, and contributing to Mangopay's ambition to become the leading payment infrastructure for marketplaces and platforms across Europe.

Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Partnerships and Operations, you will help shape our go-to-market strategy and ensure exceptional customer outcomes throughout the sales journey.

Responsibilities

Revenue Growth & Commercial Leadership

  • Own and deliver regional revenue targets through a combination of direct enterprise sales and team performance.

  • Develop and execute the regional sales strategy aligned with company growth objectives.

  • Lead the full sales cycle for strategic enterprise opportunities, from prospecting through contract signature and go-live.

  • Build, maintain and accurately forecast a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities.

  • Identify new market opportunities, verticals and strategic accounts to accelerate growth.

  • Engage C-level executives and senior stakeholders to understand complex business challenges and position Mangopay as a strategic payments partner.

  • Drive predictable pipeline generation in collaboration with Marketing and Business Development.

  • Establish clear performance objectives, KPIs and development plans.

  • Conduct regular pipeline reviews, deal coaching and forecast sessions.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Sales Excellence & Operational Execution

  • Ensure consistent execution of the sales methodology across the team.

  • Maintain forecast accuracy and provide regular business updates to the VP Sales.

  • Drive CRM excellence and ensure Salesforce reflects accurate pipeline and opportunity management.

  • Analyze sales performance, conversion metrics and operational KPIs to identify improvement opportunities.

  • Partner with Customer Success to ensure smooth customer onboarding and long-term account growth.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Partnerships and Operations to refine go-to-market initiatives.

  • Provide market feedback to influence product roadmap and commercial positioning.

  • Support strategic initiatives including pricing, packaging and competitive positioning.

  • Act as a senior commercial ambassador for Mangopay at industry events and customer engagements.

Market Intelligence

  • Monitor industry trends, competitive landscape, emerging payment technologies and regulatory developments.

title: Head of Underwriting & Claims, CE (Open to all RGA EMEA Locations)
description:
You desire impactful work.


You’re RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

A Brief Overview

Reporting to the Regional Head of Underwriting, Claims, Medical and Biometric Risk, EMEA, the Head of Underwriting & Claims for CE is responsible for leading RGA's underwriting and claims activities within a sub-region. The role provides strategic leadership across client engagement, business development support, operational delivery, quality management and people leadership, ensuring RGA remains a trusted partner and market leader. Working closely with local market leadership, Business Development, Pricing and other key stakeholders, the role is accountable for strengthening client relationships, delivering strategic initiatives, and ensuring operational capabilities evolve to meet changing market needs. The role leverages regional expertise, biometric insights, technology and innovation to create sustainable value for clients while supporting RGA's growth ambitions in the assigned area.

What you will do

  • Serve as the senior underwriting and claims representative for the assigned area, developing strong relationships with clients, industry bodies and strategic partners to strengthen RGA’s market position.
  • Partner with the Managing Director, Business Development and Pricing teams to identify opportunities for profitable growth, enhanced client value, and retention or expansion of strategic accounts.
  • Provide underwriting and claims thought leadership to clients through presentations, workshops, audits, market forums and strategic discussions, acting as executive sponsor for key client relationships where appropriate.
  • Develop and execute the underwriting and claims strategy for the sub-region in alignment with regional and enterprise objectives, including delivery of strategic initiatives that improve client outcomes, operational effectiveness and market competitiveness.
  • Identify emerging market trends, regulatory developments and client needs, ensuring RGA remains at the forefront of industry developments while supporting the implementation of regional underwriting, claims and biometric initiatives within the assigned area.
  • Collaborate with the regional Underwriting, Claims, Medical & Biometric Risk leadership team and SMEs to deliver the regional strategy and share best practices across markets.
  • Lead the underwriting and claims teams within the sub-region to deliver high-quality services to clients, ensuring operational performance meets agreed service standards, client expectations and business objectives.
  • Oversee capacity planning, resource allocation and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, consistency and service delivery.
  • Lead client quality assurance programmes, oversee remediation of identified issues, and ensure appropriate governance, risk management and control frameworks are maintained across underwriting and claims activities.
  • Champion the adoption of market-leading biometric, underwriting and claims solutions, leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights, and lead, coach and develop a high-performing underwriting and claims team that supports collaboration, learning and talent development.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) Professional qualification in underwriting, claims, insurance or a related discipline required
  • Significant life and health insurance or reinsurance experience, with substantial exposure to underwriting and/or claims leadership required
  • Proven experience leading technical, operational or client-facing teams and developing high-performing people required
  • Demonstrated success managing strategic client relationships and supporting business growth initiatives required
  • Experience delivering operational improvement and transformation initiatives required
  • Experience within a multinational or reinsurance environment preferred
  • Experience working across multiple product lines and distribution channels preferred
  • Strong understanding of underwriting philosophy, claims management, risk assessment and governance frameworks required
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders both internally and externally. required
  • Strategic leadership, commercial acumen and execution across underwriting and claims activities within the assigned area. required
  • Underwriting, claims, risk assessment and governance expertise within the life and health insurance or reinsurance market. required
  • Excellent leadership, coaching and people development skills, with the ability to build high-performing teams. required
  • Exceptional relationship-building, stakeholder management and client engagement capabilities. required
  • Ability to influence and communicate effectively at executive level, including strong presentation skills. required
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance client needs, business objectives and risk management considerations. required
  • Operational leadership, quality management and continuous improvement capability, with a strong focus on client outcomes and operational excellence. required
  • Ability to thrive within a matrixed and evolving organisational structure. required
  • Advanced professional qualification in underwriting, claims, insurance or a related discipline preferred


What you can expect from RGA:

  • Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

  • Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

  • Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

We’re excited to get to know you and connect your unique skills with our global opportunities. To create a modern and seamless experience, we use artificial intelligence (AI) in parts of our preliminary screening process. This technology helps us personalize job recommendations, automate interview scheduling, evaluate candidates based solely on experience—without considering name, gender, or other personal details—and provide real-time answers through our chatbot. AI is used only during early screening and never makes hiring decisions. Your RGA recruiter will work closely with you every step of the way to ensure the process feels personal, thoughtful, and focused on you.

title: Head of Engineering - Renewables
description:
Job title : HEAD OF ENGINEERING
Location : Paris, France
Job reference # : 33958
Contract type : Permanent
Language requirements : French (native or C2) and English (B2). Italian would be an advantage.

At Eni , we are looking for a Head of Engineering to join Eni Plenitude Renewables France . Reporting to the Head of Projects and Construction, the Head of Engineering will lead the Engineering team and be responsible for the technical governance of the French renewable energy portfolio.

About Plenitude

Plenitude is an energy company that integrates the retail business and renewable generation with self-consumption and electric mobility solutions, providing energy and gas to more than 10 million homes and businesses across Europe, which offers a range of great professional opportunities for the whole team. This partnership represents a major European project integrating the renewable energy business with the retail business, which will enable us to progressively increase our offering of services, infrastructure, and green energy for our customers, providing our team with greater visibility and professional growth.

Main responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the Engineering team, setting priorities, allocating resources, and ensuring the quality and timely delivery of engineering activities across the project portfolio.
  • Provide technical leadership and governance across the development, construction, commissioning, and operational phases of PV, wind, and BESS projects.
  • Review, challenge, and arbitrate technical solutions and project assumptions, ensuring projects are technically robust, optimised, cost-effective, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Coordinate and oversee external engineering consultants, technical advisers, and contractors, ensuring compliance with project requirements, schedules, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Define and maintain technical standards, procedures, and best practices for the French organisation, ensuring compliance with French regulations, grid requirements, and Group standards.
  • Ensure alignment with Group/HQ Engineering while adapting technical approaches and standards to French market and regulatory requirements.
  • Support key project milestones, including RTB, tendering, FID, construction, and commissioning, by providing technical recommendations and ensuring major technical decisions are properly assessed and documented.
  • Drive continuous improvement and standardisation across the project portfolio, leveraging lessons learned and promoting efficient, consistent, and high-quality engineering practices.

Skills and experience required

  • Engineering degree with extensive experience in renewable energy, including significant experience in utility-scale solar PV, wind and BESS projects.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills.
  • Proven experience leading engineering teams.
  • Strong technical understanding of PV, BESS and wind projects, including electrical systems, grid connections, civil works, permitting and construction.
  • Strong ability to challenge technical proposals, arbitrate between alternatives, and make pragmatic, business-oriented decisions.
  • Experience managing engineering consultants, technical advisers, EPC contractors and equipment suppliers.
  • Good knowledge of French technical regulations and applicable international standards.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a multicultural and international environment.
  • Fluency in French and English is mandatory. Italian would be an advantage.

How to apply

  • Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
  • Please upload your CV in English .

About Eni

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.

Working at Eni

At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.

Energy for action takers

title: Senior Account Manager – Milan
description:
About us

Simundia is a leading digital coaching platform dedicated to making high-quality coaching accessible to everyone within organizations.

Through our Situational Coaching approach, we help employees turn real workplace challenges into opportunities for growth. Our platform connects employees with professional coaches through personalized video coaching sessions, supported by practical resources and digital tools designed to reinforce learning and encourage lasting behavioral change.

We work with large international organizations across industries and geographies, delivering scalable coaching programs in multiple languages and adapting our approach to each client’s specific business and people-development needs.

Our mission is simple: to democratize coaching in the workplace and make professional development concrete, accessible and impactful.

From leadership development and management skills to communication, collaboration and individual performance, Simundia helps organizations develop the skills their people need to thrive in an evolving world of work.

Your role


Your goal will be to contribute to Simundia’s growth by managing and developing our key client accounts in the Italian market. You will build strong, long-term relationships with clients, understand their business and people-development needs, identify opportunities to expand our collaboration, and ensure they get maximum value from Simundia’s coaching solutions. You will work closely with the Italian Team and the wider International Team, collaborating across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Product to deliver an excellent client experience and drive account growth. This role will be both strategic and hands-on, giving you the opportunity to have a tangible impact on client satisfaction, retention and revenue growth, while working in an international, fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

Your responsibilities

  • Manage and develop a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, building trusted relationships with HR leaders, executives and other key stakeholders.

  • Own the client relationship throughout the account lifecycle, from onboarding and program launch to renewal, expansion and long-term partnership.

  • Understand client needs and business challenges and translate them into relevant coaching solutions and account strategies.

  • Conduct regular business reviews and client meetings, presenting results, gathering feedback and identifying opportunities for further collaboration.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of client projects and a high-quality customer experience.

Who you are ?

Application process

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About us

Implicity is a digital MedTech, that brings outstanding innovations to cardiologists, thanks to Big Data and Artificial Intelligence.

Thanks to our leading cardiac remote monitoring platform, it’s way easier to manage data and predict patient issues, so that cardiologists can bring the best care at the best time.

To put it simply, when you join Implicity, you’ll contribute to save lives with us

Dr Arnaud Rosier (cardiologist and AI researcher) & David Perlmutter (engineer and entrepreneur), co-founded Implicity in 2016.

  • 10+ years later, a French Start-Up / Scale-Up is a real game changer in the healthcare market, literally shaping the future of cardiology.

  • 250+ hospitals / medical centers are already using our solutions, covering 100 000+ patients.

At Implicity, you will find the greatest experts in data science, engineering, clinical, regulatory, IT, sales, customers success, etc. working together.

This amazing team already managed to make Implicity a clear European leader, and we will very soon do the same in the US market.

In a nutshell, thanks to Implicity:

Patients get a far better care

Doctors’ life is far easier, they can have a far better focus on prevention/treatment, and not admin/data burden

Healthcare payers (Social Security in France) eventually pays a far lower price (preventing/monitoring instead of treating/hospitalizing)

It can start as soon as you can!

Want more infos?!

  • Our website: https://www.implicity.com/about-us/

  • Our team: https://www.welcometothejungle.com/fr/companies/implicity/team-1

  • Our other opening jobs: https://www.implicity.com/careers/

  • Our cool grade on Glassdoor: https://www.glassdoor.fr/Présentation/Travailler-chez-Implicity-EI_IE4010545.16,25.htm

  • Our $40M Series B https://techfundingnews.com/implicity-raises-35m-growth-funding-iris-five-arrows-cardiac-ai/

  • A cool article by La Tribune: https://www.latribune.fr/technos-medias/innovation-et-start-up/la-startup-de-la-semaine-implicity-previent-les-crises-cardiaques-grace-aux-donnees-829691.html

  • And finally, 2 interviews of our CEO Arnaud Rosier: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ofIQQMWqZohttps://www.bsmart.fr/video/1727,37-ecosysteme-implicity

Job and recruitment context

️ Opening line ️

Design at Implicity is undergoing transformative changes, expanding in scope and ambition and we’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help drive the next chapter of design at Implicity.

You'll report to the Head of Product and work alongside our existing Product Designer. Together you'll set the quality bar for design across the product and help shape the craft, the system and the way design works with the rest of the team.

This is a hands-on role first. You'll own design on our most complex features, get close to clinical users, and help our Figma and Claude design systems mature as the product grows.

We're looking for someone proactive, generous with ideas and who enjoys shaping how a product team thinks about design at the age of AI.

Reporting Structure

Direct Report: CPO

Collaboration: You will work alongside our existing Designer as a peer, in close partnership with PMs and engineering squads. Design at Implicity is growing in scope and ambition, and this role sits at the centre of that.

Your missions

As Senior Product Designer, your core mission will be to design the experiences that make a clinically complex product feel effortless to the cardiologists and care teams who use it every day.

You will:

  • Lead design on product features: Work end to end on medium-to-high complexity features, from problem framing with PMs through to detailed UI and handoff with engineering. Get close to users. Build enough understanding of clinical workflows to make design decisions with confidence. The work you ship sets the reference for where the product is going.

  • Grow the design system and design principles: Contribute to our existing Figma and Claude design systems, our design principles and platform architecture, and help them evolve in step with the company's needs. Plenty of room here to elevate the platform’s UI and UX and make structural decisions, not just styling ones.

  • Integrate AI into the design workflow
    Test, set up and use AI tools (Claude design, Figma Make and others) as a natural part of how you work, to accelerate production, generate and test ideas, and spend more time problem solving and less on execution. Support the PMs with their prototypes and small features. Test, iterate and make success into established ways of working.

Our Design Environment

Design: Figma, Claude Design

AI & Agents: Claude (Anthropic), Claude Cowork, MCP protocol

Collaboration: Notion, Slack, Jira, Google Drive

At Implicity, you will have a weekly meeting with your manager, to help you succeed in your mission, and continuously improve your skills.

Each team works with quarterly OKR, to be crystal clear, fair and honest with your targets.

The annual appraisal is a shared exchange moment, focused on your development.

Your Profile and Mindset

Experience Profile

  • Seniority & Experience: 6–8+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio that shows depth of craft on complex, data-dense products.

  • Sector Experience (Bonus): HealthTech, MedTech, or another regulated or high-stakes domain. Experience with expert-user or professional tools is a strong plus.

  • Product Maturity: You have experience redesigning or evolving existing products, not only building from scratch

  • Design Systems: You've contributed hands-on to building or significantly maturing a design system.

  • Languages & Location: French & English fluency required. Based in Paris or Ile de France.


Mindset and Soft Skills

  • Craft-Led: Your feature-level design work is excellent, end to end, and holds up in a complex product.

  • Systems Thinker: You think in components, tokens, and architecture, and you're comfortable treating a design system as a product.

  • User Proximity:You are comfortable interacting with (clinical) users, ask sharp questions and translate complex domain knowledge into design decisions.

  • Comfortable Building as You Go: You're happy working in a space where design practices are still forming, and you enjoy establishing them.

  • AI-Native Curiosity: AI is part of your daily workflow as a genuine productivity multiplier. You can also design AI-powered features and have a view on what that changes about the craft.

A Note on Applying: We know the perfect candidate doesn't exist. If you believe you possess the core required experience and strongly align with this mindset, we highly encourage you to apply.
Portfolio submission is a must for you application to be reviewed.

Recruitment process

  • ️ Portfolio review - Chiara (Interim Head of Product) & David (Product Designer)

  • 1st HR Contact with Margot (HR) – 30 min

  • Craft deep dive with Chiara & David - 45 min

  • Live case with Chiara, David and a Product Manager - 3 hours - On-site

  • Final interview with Arnaud (CEO) and Lucie (COO) - 1 hour - On-site + Coffee with the Product Team - post final interview

  • Reference Check & Offer (usually follows within 72 hours )

Depending on your availability, the recruitment process should last less than 4-5 weeks.

General information

Salary

  • For this job (type of contract), you have a base salary depending on your experience

  • Eligible for stock option (BSPCEs) according to the company's existing rules

Benefits
