  • Transport: 50% of your pass OR sustainable mobility pass

Remote work & Location

  • 3 days per week (progressively)

  • Location: 2 rue du Colonel Driant, 75001, PARIS

Why us?

Simply because you will get all Scale-Up advantages without the usual drawbacks!

  • Activity: we are a “purpose company” - that really drives everyone’s daily motivation and commitment

  • Solution: we built a best-in-class solution, that has no direct competitor

  • Growth stage: we are not small - we are not big - +100 people => our boom is to come

  • International: we operate at a global level, and our working language is English

  • Values: we do have values, and these are not just for posters!

    • Integrity: we act with honesty and fairness

    • Ambition: we strive for excellence in a healthcare demanding environment

    • Cooperation: we care, we support, we seek collective success

  • Autonomy: you’ll definitely get real responsibilities, and have the chance to have impact

  • Employee care:

    • Our beautiful office is right across the Bourse du Commerce

    • Regular team events, especially every Thursday evenings

  • Tools: we used Slack, Notion and Drive, and it is pretty cool

  • Worklife balance: we are definitely respectful & remote friendly

  • Shareholder: you will be incentivized with company equity

title: Analytics Product Manager
description:
Dolead is a global leader in Lead Generation: we help 200+ clients across 15 countries in Europe and North America turn paid media into measurable business outcomes.

Behind that performance sits a growing Data & Science team working on some of the most strategic topics at Dolead: business intelligence, scoring, optimization, internal data products and decision-making tools used across the company.
We’re looking for a Analytics Product Manager to join the team in Paris.
This is not a traditional Product Manager role.

We’re looking for someone with a strong Data Analytics background who wants to progressively expand their scope towards Product: someone comfortable going deep into an analysis in Looker or SQL, defining the right KPIs, challenging how a business question is framed, while also helping the team turn business needs into clear priorities and impactful data products.

You’ll join a Data & Science team composed of 2 Data Engineers, 1 Data Scientist, 1 Analytics Product Manager and our Head of Data, to whom you’ll report directly.

Your role
Your scope will sit primarily at the intersection of Analytics and Product, with Analytics remaining an important part of your day-to-day work.

Own Analytics & Business Insights
You’ll progressively become one of the go-to people at Dolead when teams need to understand what the data is really telling them.

You will:

  • Conduct deep-dive and ad-hoc analyses to help teams make better business decisions.

  • Work autonomously with SQL and Looker to investigate questions, test hypotheses and identify opportunities.

  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and KPIs for operational teams and executive leadership.

  • Partner with business teams to define the right metrics and ensure they are interpreted correctly.

  • Challenge analyses and assumptions when needed: not only producing numbers, but helping teams understand what conclusions can (and cannot) reasonably be drawn from them.

  • Help improve data accessibility and enable teams to become increasingly autonomous in their use of Looker.

  • Contribute to data quality, metric consistency and governance across the company.


Help shape our Data Product roadmap
Together with the Head of Data, you’ll help translate business priorities into a clear roadmap for the Data & Science team.

You will:

  • Gather and structure needs from teams such as Sales, Customer Success and Performance Marketing.

  • Help frame problems, assess opportunities and prioritize initiatives based on business impact and effort.

  • Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories and actionable specifications for the Data & Science team.

  • Contribute to the quarterly roadmap and prepare its presentation to our leadership team.

  • Follow objectives throughout the quarter and help keep the team focused on the initiatives that matter most.

  • Track the adoption and business impact of the products and features delivered, and recommend iterations when needed.

You won’t own the roadmap in isolation: you’ll build it closely with the Head of Data, particularly on the most strategic initiatives.

Drive adoption of Data products
Shipping a dashboard, model or feature is only useful if people actually use it.

You will:

  • Coordinate the rollout of new Data & Science products and features.

  • Define and monitor adoption and impact metrics.

  • Create documentation and training when needed.

  • Work with internal users to understand friction points and improve the products after launch.

  • Help teams adopt better habits around data-driven decision making.


Keep the squad moving
You’ll also help the Data & Science team maintain clear priorities and effective working routines.

You will:

  • Facilitate daily stand-ups and team rituals.

  • Help define sprint goals and organize the team's backlog.

  • Track milestones, dependencies and blockers.

  • Facilitate retrospectives and follow up on improvement actions.

  • Protect the team from unnecessary ad-hoc requests when they threaten agreed priorities.


This represents a smaller part of the role: we’re not looking for a Scrum Master, but for someone capable of bringing structure and momentum to the team.

Your profile
We think you'll thrive in this role if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Data Science or a closely related field.

  • You have a strong analytical foundation and enjoy getting hands-on with data.

  • You are highly comfortable with SQL and BI tools such as Looker.

  • You understand core statistical concepts such as distributions, probability and confidence intervals, and know when they matter in a business analysis.

  • You can independently define KPIs and build dashboards from initial business question through to final output.

  • You are comfortable challenging stakeholders on the way a question is framed or an analysis is interpreted.

  • You want to move beyond pure analytics and take increasing responsibility for Product thinking, prioritization and delivery.

  • You can translate ambiguous business needs into structured problems and actionable requirements.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You are comfortable working in French and English.


You don't need to be a Data Engineer or Machine Learning expert. Understanding those environments is useful, but we’re primarily looking for someone excellent at analytics, business reasoning and turning data into decisions.
Experience with Product Management or Data Products is a plus, but we’re equally interested in strong Data Analysts or Data Scientists who are ready to make that transition.

What success looks like
After 6–12 months, we’d expect you to have become:

  • A trusted analytics partner across Dolead: when someone needs a meaningful analysis in Looker, you’re naturally one of the people they turn to, and you can independently answer most of those questions.

  • A key contributor to the Data & Science team's quarterly roadmap, from preparation through presentation to our leadership team.

  • The person helping the squad maintain clear rituals, objectives and priorities throughout each quarter.

  • Someone who consistently helps move conversations from “what does the data say?” to “what should we do about it?”


Practical details

  • Permanent contract

  • Based in Paris

  • During your first six months, we expect you to work from our Paris office around 2 days per week, particularly to build strong relationships with the Data, Tech and business teams. We can revisit the setup once you're fully onboarded.

  • French and English are both required.


Benefits:

Health Insurance: individual & family coverage through SideCare — 100% covered by Dolead
Meal Vouchers: Swile card — 50% covered by Dolead
Time Off: 25 days of paid leave + 8 RTT days
Remote Work: 2 to 4 days per week, depending on team organization
Multicultural Environment: 13+ nationalities represented across the company
Strong Company Culture: regular team events and fun activities
Office: located in the heart of Paris, near Opéra

Recruitment Process:

  • First interview with Florian, Talent Acquisition Manager

  • Interview with Thibault, Head of Data and Hiring Manager, including a deeper assessment of your technical and analytical skills

  • Team meeting with members of the Data & Science team

  • Final interview with Guillaume, CEO, focused on business understanding, strategic thinking, and overall fit with Dolead

Dolead is committed to providing equal opportunities to all candidates. All applications are considered regardless of race or ethnic origin, opinions or beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, health status, or disability.

title: Legal Product Operations & Coordination Manager (F/H) - NIMI
description:
Description de l’entreprise


Classée parmi les principaux gestionnaires d'actifs au monde avec plus de 1 300 milliards d’euros d'actifs sous gestion, Natixis Investment Managers (Natixis IM) propose une gamme de solutions diversifiées couvrant différents types de classes d'actifs, de styles de gestion et de véhicules, y compris des stratégies et des produits innovants répondant aux critères environnementaux, sociaux et de gouvernance (ESG) dédiés au développement de la finance durable.

Les équipes de Natixis IM travaillent en partenariat avec leurs clients - investisseurs institutionnels, fonds d’investissement, entreprises et particuliers - afin de comprendre leurs besoins spécifiques et de leur fournir des informations et des solutions d'investissement adaptées à leurs objectifs à long terme.

Grâce à l’approche multi-boutique de Natixis IM, les clients peuvent ainsi bénéficier de la réflexion et de l’expertise d’une vingtaine de sociétés de gestion active.

Natixis Investment Managers International (Natixis IMI) est la principale société de gestion de Natixis IM en Europe. Elle réunit 2 activités :

  • Les activités de distribution en Europe et dans d'autres zones géographiques comme l'APAC, le Moyen Orient, et l'Amérique latine, de l’offre en gestion d’actifs de Natixis IM ;
  • Une plateforme de centres d’expertises (fonctions support) au service des activités de distribution et des affiliés.

Natixis IMI poursuit son développement et renforce sa présence en France et à l’international, en s’appuyant sur l’expertise de ses équipes et sur le modèle multi-affiliés de Natixis IM.




Poste et missions


Vous rejoignez la Direction juridique de NIMI en tant que Legal Product Operations & coordination manager.

La Direction Juridique de Natixis Investment Managers International, composée de 26 collaborateurs, assure la sécurité juridique des structures et des opérations en matière de gestion et de commercialisation (produits, services, expertises).

Elle assure un rôle de conseil et intervient en coordination avec les différentes fonctions opérationnelles et support pour le compte de l’entreprise et d’autres sociétés du groupe.

En tant que Legal Product Operations & coordination manager vous accompagnez le Head of Legal NIMI dans la gestion des activités juridiques liées au développement, au lancement, à la commercialisation et à la vie juridique des produits de NIMI.

Vous contribuez à sécuriser l’activité de la Direction Juridique et a notamment assurer : le pilotage de la performance du service, l’accompagnement des transformations, l’amélioration de l’efficacité opérationnelle ainsi que la gestion des relations avec les affiliés et les autres clients internes.

Vous serez le point d’entrée des clients internes de la Direction juridique, notamment les affiliés, et aidez à renforcer la culture de centricité client au sein de la Direction.

Vous travaillez dans un environnement international, au sein d’une communauté d’experts qui place l’excellence, l’impact et l’action collective au cœur de tout ce qu’elle entreprend.

#TransformativeFinance

Ce poste est basé à Paris avec la possibilité de télétravailler.

Nous plaçons nos collaborateurs au centre de nos attentions. Des dispositifs de mobilité interne, développement de carrière et de formation vous permettent de grandir et de vous épanouir tout au long de votre parcours.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail hybride, inclusif et favorisant le collaboratif.

A propos du processus de recrutement

Vous serez contacté par l’un de nos recruteurs avant de rencontrer nos experts métier (manager, membre de l’équipe ou de la filière métier).


Profil et compétences requises


De formation supérieure en finance, vous avez une expérience d’au moins 7 ans en gestion d'actifs ou en banque d’investissement.
Vous maîtrisez :
  • la réglementation des produits financiers
  • les fonctions Legal/Product
  • la gestion de projets est également requise pour mener à bien les différentes missions.
  • une spécialisation en asset management et la connaissance des produits FIA et OPCVM constitueront des atouts majeurs.
Vous avez un excellent relationnel, une très bonne capacité d’écoute, vous êtes :
  • Doté d'un leadership naturel, vous savez coordonner des équipes, vous affirmer avec tact auprès d'interlocuteurs variés et piloter avec rigueur des projets transverses complexes dans le respect des délais.
  • Rigoureux, doté de fortes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse
Vous maîtrisez l'anglais avec un niveau C1

title: Designer | Paris
description:

title: Senior Product Manager - Carpool Experience
description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


The role

Carpool Experience covers everything between two members once they have found each other: agreeing on the trip, talking, meeting up, and building trust.

Vision: a carpool experience that feels easy and safe for passengers and drivers, from the first hello to the final goodbye.

Mission: make it simple for members to talk, negotiate, meet up and trust each other.

You own six product areas, used by millions of members every month:

  • Negotiation. Before booking, passengers can ask the driver for a detour, a lower price or another special request, and add a tip. Drivers accept, decline or make a counter-offer. It launched in France in 2025 and went worldwide in 2026. It is still a new product: what it should become, and how far it can go, is yours to figure out.

  • Messaging. The chat between drivers and passengers. Next up: Group Chat, and catching up with market standards.

  • GPS Tracking: both the technical capability as well as features it enables (including sharing ETA on the map, ESC bonus in Spain among others)

  • Post-Carpool ride XP (claims, ratings etc.). How members build trust in each other. This includes AI Ratings Summary, BlaBlaCar's first consumer-facing GenAI feature.

  • Communication Service and contact preferences. The platform that sends every push notification, email, SMS and WhatsApp message across the company, plus the settings members use to choose what they receive.

  • Marketing tools. Braze and deeplinks, used by the CRM and marketing teams.

This is a key scope, and you own its strategy. That comes with high exposure: you present to the Executive Committee every two weeks. You get a direct say in company decisions, and you are expected to bring clear thinking and solid arguments to the table.

Your Responsibilities

  • Set the direction. Build the vision and strategy for your scope, turn it into ambitious OKRs, and get leadership behind them.
  • Own the numbers. Know your business metrics, reliability targets and costs in detail. Review them every month and act on what they tell you, without being asked.
  • Shape the future of Negotiation. Work out where its real value is for members and for BlaBlaCar, decide how it should evolve (new use cases such as negotiation after booking, conversion, usage), and prove the impact on passengers (PAX) and GMV.
  • Ship the next member interactions: Group Chat, live location for both drivers and passengers, and the next version of the Communication Service.
  • Run experiments and rollouts with discipline. Run A/B tests and country-by-country launches with decision rules set in advance, together with Legal, Privacy and country leads.
  • Hold your own with the ExCo. Every two weeks, present progress, decisions and trade-offs to the Executive Committee. Take a clear position, defend it, and change it when the evidence calls for it.
  • Raise the bar of the product team. Share your methods, coach other PMs, and challenge how we work.

Your Qualifications

  • You take full ownership of your product's outcomes. You go to the data with a question, spot what changed before anyone flags it, and act on it. You don't wait for direction: you come with a clear proposal, build it with your team and stakeholders, and follow through.

  • You turn many signals into one clear strategy. You combine data, user research, market moves and tech constraints into one view of where the product should go, not a list of projects. You can explain it in two minutes, it holds from one conversation to the next, and you cut complexity to get more done with less.

  • You understand the business, not just the product. You know how BlaBlaCar makes money and where your scope fits in. You can give your key metrics, their current level and what moves them without opening a dashboard. You talk about impact on PAX, GMV and costs as naturally as about features.

  • You have strong opinions and an open mind. You take a clear position without waiting for leadership to take theirs, back it with evidence, and change your view openly when a better argument comes along.

  • You communicate at a leadership level. You have already owned discussions with C-level or ExCo on strategy and trade-offs, and come out with decisions. You adapt your message to each audience and resolve conflicts constructively.

  • Baseline:

    • You have 5+ years of product management, ideally on consumer apps, including at least one scope you owned end to end over several quarters with measurable business impact.

    • You use AI tools in your daily work.

    • You are fluent in English.

If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!

What we have to offer

  • 2 to 3 days at the office per week
  • 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
  • 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
  • Financial support for home office equipment
  • Minimum 25 days holiday per year
  • Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
  • 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
  • Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like.

  • Talent Acquisition Screening (45 min)
  • Interview with Shahil HIRIDJEE (Head of Product - 45 min)
  • Case study presented to a cross-functional panel (45 min)
  • Interview with Julien GOUDEAUX, Carpool XP’s Engineering Manager (45 min)
BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Credit Risk Management Director
description:
24 Sept 2026
Paris, FR, 75008

Who we are

United by a sense of purpose towards our customers – to be a trusted partner for the long-term – and our universal banking platform in EMEA, SMBC Group has an international growth agenda and award-winning products, meaning we provide exciting opportunities to work on a diverse range of projects and initiatives. We deliver a full suite of corporate finance products and solutions to our customers as well as investment banking and advisory services, and a range of innovative solutions in global capital markets. Read on to find out how you could enhance your skills and gain valuable experience, by joining us to support our clients transition to a sustainable future.

Role Summary

Is the next step in your career at SMBC Group EMEA? We’re looking for a Credit Analyst - Director (f/m/d) for our Credit Department to join our team.


The Job Holder is responsible for assessing, monitoring, and managing credit exposure for transactions booked by the bank.
  • Analyzing the credit risk associated with transactions originated by the front office departments (covering both lending and derivatives transactions among others)
  • Elaborating and presenting a recommendation to the Executive Board (under the Bank’s governance) for decision.
  • Organizing and planning credit reviews of credit exposure extended by the bank in compliance with the Bank’s processes, policies, and procedures
  • Monitoring performance of loans and other products in line with policies and procedures
  • Preparation of reports as per internal policies and procedures to Line Manager and Management
  • Liaising with Front Offices, other Credit Departments, and departments (Treasury, F&C, Planning Depts)
  • Contributing to the overall credit risk management framework and processes in particular in relation to strategy and risk appetite setting as well as capital management.
  • Participating and contributing internal, external audits and regulatory interactions.

The anticipated salary range for this role is €92,000-€138,000 with the final offer determined based on the candidate’s skills, experience, role scope, location, and relevant market factors. In addition to base salary, the role may be eligible for a discretionary incentive award and a competitive benefits package, including core benefits such as pension provision.

Business Area

The Job Holder is appointed as a senior Credit Analyst within the Credit Department at SMBC Bank EU AG, reporting to the Head of Credit in order to comply with the German Banking Act and MaRisk requirements as well as SMBC global PPMs in relation to transactions with the bank’s customers.

Position Description


  • Critically and independently analyze credit applications and their contents submitted by Front Offices in accordance with the application and approval policies and procedures of the bank
  • Prepare written, precise summaries including reasoned recommendations in a standardized format for presentation to the Executive Board or delegated authority
  • Timely management of credit applications, policies and procedures, and other reporting matters.

Assist the Head of Credit in all its duties and responsibilities
  • Report material matters identified to the appropriate governance structures (for example, Special Credit Review, Credit and Prudential Risk Committees)
  • Assist in the preparation and review of internal policies and procedures related to credit matters and under the responsibility of CD
  • Assist Front Office and other departments in ensuring compliance with procedures and systems of the Bank.

Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Qualifications


  • Solid experience in credit analysis (5-10 years) in the field of corporate banking and corporate banking products.
  • Good knowledge of credit risk management requirements and regulations both at European and German level (EBA, ECB, MaRisk KWG).
  • Good understanding and knowledge of SMBC group credit risk management requirements and rules.
  • Strong numerical and financial analysis skills across products offered by the bank.
  • Good understanding of global economics and sectors in order to identify opportunities and threats to existing and potential transactions.
  • Inquisitive nature and a desire to gain knowledge and experience across product and sector types and the bank’s various systems.
  • Degree level education and Fluency in written English and German (if possible).
  • Strong communications skills and culture awareness.


Competencies

Customer Focus
Driving Change
Driving Results
Embraces Diversity
Enterprise Leadership
Judgement and Decision Making
Risk Management
Strategic and Visionary
Trust and Integrity

What we offer

For all the expertise and experience you bring to help us make a difference, it’s only sustainable if we support you to build your career and be your best self so we offer competitive company benefits, centred around promoting positive well-bring and work-life balance. We also believe in fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment, where all team members perspectives and contributions are valued. Initiatives in place which promote a diverse and inclusive culture and healthy work life balance include hybrid working, Sport & Social Clubs and Diversity and Inclusion networks.

As an employee of SMBC you have access to a host of both useful and exciting benefit offerings. See below some of the benefits on offer to you:

  • Hybrid and flexible working
  • Competitive paid leave days
  • Benefits to support your physical wellbeing, including private medical insurance and life and invalidity insurance
  • Various policies to support your mental wellbeing, including a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
  • Access a wide range of learning and development opportunities and career progression opportunities
  • Ambitious remuneration package

So, if you like a challenge and want to continuously grow and develop in a role where you will be supported along the way by a dynamic and diverse team, apply today!!

About SMBC

A trusted partner for the long term
United by a sense of purpose towards our customers - to be a trusted partner for the long-term - and our universal banking platform in EMEA, we deliver a full suite of corporate finance products and solutions to our customers, including corporate, structured and trade finance, leveraged finance, loan market and treasury products. We can also provide investment banking and advisory services and a range of innovative solutions in global capital markets.

title: Head of Fraud Operations M/F/Mx
description:
Trustpair stops vendor fraud before it happens. We're the automated vendor validation platform protecting 550+ enterprise companies worldwide. Since 2017, finance and procurement teams have used Trustpair to eliminate vendor fraud while reclaiming 90% of the time they once spent on manual checks.

As vendor fraud grows more sophisticated, we stay ahead by combining deep expertise in financial crime with cutting-edge technology. Our core product focuses on secure, reliable vendor account validation to wipe out fraud and boost efficiency.

Internally, teams across Trustpair use AI tools in their day-to-day work to automate repetitive tasks and unlock strategic insights that help us build and operate better. From day one, you’ll be encouraged and trained to integrate these tools into your workflow in a practical, hands-on way.

With offices in New York, Paris, London, and Milan, we're a diverse team united by a bias for action. We ship fast, learn from experiments, and tackle problems that matter: protecting billions in payments for companies worldwide. If you want to see your work make an immediate impact in financial security, Trustpair is built for you.

Learn more about how we use AI in our everyday work.

About the role

Trustpair is hiring a Head of Fraud Operations to lead our Complementary Checks Operations department as it evolves into Fraud Operations. This is a global leadership role reporting to Cyrille, Chief Operating Officer.

You will lead approximately 30 teammates. This hands-on strategic role calls for rigorous execution, data-driven decision-making, empathetic people leadership, and deep curiosity about fraud. You will help Trustpair’s human expertise scale alongside its digital and AI-based capabilities.

This position is based in Paris and is onsite.

Main Mission

  • Lead and scale Trustpair’s global Fraud Operations function while maintaining excellent service quality, security, processing speed, and cost efficiency.

  • Transform frontline fraud knowledge, proprietary data, and industry insight into stronger fraud-detection expertise and inputs for Trustpair’s ML and AI models.

  • Build a high-performing, transparent, and continuously improving team that strengthens both client trust and Trustpair’s product advantage.

What you'll do

Lead and scale global Fraud Operations

  • Lead teams through three direct-report team leads, with accountability for internal employees and BPO colleagues.

  • Set, cascade, track, and own the team’s objectives and operating metrics.

  • Recruit, onboard, coach, and assess team leads, helping them strengthen day-to-day organization, process ownership, documentation, tool adoption, and delivery of strategic initiatives.

  • Create a culture that combines high standards, subject-matter expertise, transparency, data awareness, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.

Own operational excellence, data, and automation

  • Define, validate, and communicate the Fraud Operations roadmap, ensuring that priorities and resources align with Trustpair’s company strategy.

  • Design scalable processes, documentation, controls, and quality-assurance practices that anticipate operational risks rather than reacting to them.

  • Use quantitative models and other analytics tools to monitor performance, identify root causes, and turn data into practical actions.

  • Deploy thoughtful automation and agentic AI use cases to improve quality, speed, scalability, and cost control.

Strengthen Trustpair’s fraud expertise

  • Build best-in-class vendor-payment-fraud expertise by combining Trustpair’s proprietary data, real-world cases, industry practices, and emerging AI capabilities.

  • Ensure that the techniques, patterns, and trends observed by frontline teams are structured, shared, and used across Trustpair to reinforce fraud-detection IP and product capabilities.

  • Act as a subject-matter expert in occasional high-stakes client situations, explaining fraud attempts clearly and helping clients implement corrective measures.

Lead external and cross-functional partnerships

  • Own the relationship with our BPO provider, including performance management, operating cadence, quality standards, contractual follow-up, and scalable capacity planning.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success and Care on client needs, Product on anti-fraud and evaluation operations, Engineering on team tooling, and Sales on strategic POCs.

  • Translate operational and fraud insights into clear recommendations for adjacent teams, contributing to both client acquisition and retention.

What’s in it for you

  • At Trustpair, we see AI as a tool to save time, sharpen focus, and boost impact - whether you're already hands-on with AI or eager to learn, you’ll join a team that values and encourages AI-driven ways of working

  • Lead and scale people, processes, tools, and AI-driven fraud detection.

  • Embed frontline fraud expertise into Trustpair’s product and detection models.

  • Guide a mature, high-performing team through its next growth phase.

  • Apply AI and automation to operational and detection challenges.

  • Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Customer Care, and Sales.

Why join Trustpair? A list of our perks here!

Must-Haves

  • A Master’s degree from an engineering or business school.

  • At least 7 years of operations experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments, including successful experience managing an operations team.

  • Empathetic, transparent, and performance-focused people leadership.

  • Data-driven, translating metrics into priorities and improvement plans.

  • Strong project management, from scoping through delivery and follow-up.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling and BI/KPI tracking.

  • Excellent organization, prioritization, judgment, autonomy, and escalation awareness.

  • Practical, detail-oriented problem-solving with proactive risk management.

  • Clear, influential communication across all audiences.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Curiosity about practical AI applications that improve business outcomes.

  • Collaborative, adaptable, low-ego, and receptive to feedback.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Managed BPO/outsourced operations, including SLAs, performance, capacity, quality, and contracts.

  • KYC/AML, financial crime, or fraud experience in fintech or banking.

  • Background in consulting, finance, analytics, or complex program management.

  • Commercial acumen and confidence in high-stakes client discussions.

Recruitment Process

  • Screening call with Céline, Chief People Officer — 30 minutes, virtual

  • Experience interview with Cyrille, COO — 60 minutes, virtual

  • Case study with Cyrille and Léa, Head of CC Ops — 60-minute on-site session

  • Coffee fit with two future teammates — 30-minute conversation, on-site or virtual

  • Cofounders interview with Alexandre — 45-minute interview, on-site or virtual.


Equal Opportunity Statement
Trustpair's policy is to provide equal employment opportunity in all of our employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category.
Applicants for all positions in Trustpair must be legally authorized to work in the country which they are applying for or be a citizen from Schengen / EU zone. The verification of employment eligibility will be required as a condition of hire.

title: Director, Chief Operating Office Banking Continental Europe (f/m/d), CIB Banking
description:

title: Head of, Financial Systems Engineering
description:
Location

Paris; London

Full time

Location Type

Department

Finance


About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Head of Financial Systems, you will shape the future of Mistral’s Finance technology ecosystem.

The role exists to build a modern data, systems and AI-driven finance department that bridges finance, data, and business operations to drive financial performance and strategic decision-making.

You’ll collaborate closely with our CFO, our internal Applied AI resources, and teams like, HR, IT, Legal, and Security to assess current systems, identify gaps, and design a target architecture that supports Mistral’s growth.

Your impact will be felt across the organization, from improving profitability to automating accounting and ensuring reliable financial outputs.


What You Will Do

  • Lead the assessment of Mistral’s current Finance technology landscape, including tools, processes, data flows and pain points.

  • Define and prioritize business, functional, and technical requirements for Finance systems in collaboration with stakeholders.

  • Design a target Finance tech architecture, outlining system roles, integrations, and data flows and architectures

  • Deliver a clear recommendation on the future Finance tech setup, including costs, risks, and a transition roadmap.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong project management skills, from defining vision, strategy, and roadmaps, to stelar execution

  • Engineering academic background, ideally from a tier-1 engineering school

  • Deep data architecture knowledge, including mastery of data sources, pipelines, storage, transformation, and metadata management, with hands-on experience designing and implementing architectures (e.g., APIs, workflows, BigQuery, DBT).

  • GenAI power user with Vibe coding skills, automation expertise, and experience building scalable, impactful products in a professional context. Basic coding skills and software development experience are a strong plus.

  • Experience in Finance technology assessment, system selection, and knowledge of tools such as SAP S4H, Kyriba, Lago, Payflows, etc

  • Solid financial knowledge, including experience working alongside finance teams, understanding FP&A, accounting, cash management, and procurement, and a strong interest in driving value through process automation and efficiency.

  • Builder and scaler with experience structuring IT systems (preferably in finance), building and scaling IT teams or departments from the ground up, and operating in multicountry environments.

  • Proven ability to build tools and processes from scratch to support company growth.

  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate data quality, consistency, and relevance.

title: Logistics Manager
description:
About us

Implicity is a digital MedTech, that brings outstanding innovations to cardiologists, thanks to Big Data and Artificial Intelligence.

Thanks to our leading cardiac remote monitoring platform, it’s way easier to manage data and predict patient issues, so that cardiologists can bring the best care at the best time.

To put it simply, when you join Implicity, you’ll contribute to save lives with us

Dr Arnaud Rosier (cardiologist and AI researcher) & David Perlmutter (engineer and entrepreneur), co-founded Implicity in 2016.

  • 10+ years later, a French Start-Up / Scale-Up is a real game changer in the healthcare market, literally shaping the future of cardiology.

  • 250+ hospitals / medical centers are already using our solutions, covering 100 000+ patients.

At Implicity, you will find the greatest experts in data science, engineering, clinical, regulatory, IT, sales, customers success, etc. working together.

This amazing team already managed to make Implicity a clear European leader, and we will very soon do the same in the US market.

In a nutshell, thanks to Implicity:

Patients get a far better care

Doctors’ life is far easier, they can have a far better focus on prevention/treatment, and not admin/data burden

Healthcare payers (Social Security in France) eventually pays a far lower price (preventing/monitoring instead of treating/hospitalizing)

It can start as soon as you can!

Job and recruitment context

️ Opening line ️

Implicity keeps growing: more centers, more patients monitored, more challenges to take on and we are growing the team that makes it happen.

The logistics chain between our connected medical devices and the patients and medical centers who rely on them holds a key place in that: it is what turns remote monitoring into reality, every day.

Reporting Structure

Direct Report: Anne (Head of Customer Success EU).

Collaboration: You work daily with Customer Success, Sales, Finance and the Tech/Product teams.

Your missions

As Logistics Manager, your core mission will be to run the end-to-end operational chain behind remote monitoring, from device logistics to telemonitoring billing and to structure it so it scales: clear processes, clear priorities, and a team that runs them autonomously.

You will:

In the operations, with your team:

  • Operate and drive device logistics end to end: orders, deliveries, returns and stock management of the connected devices used to remotely monitor heart failure patients, in close collaboration with Customer Success and Sales.

  • Process and coordinate the telemonitoring billing cycle: from patient billing through to handling rejections from the French authorities, monthly, using our internal tools and working hand in hand with Finance and Tech.

  • Guarantee billing data quality: make sure the data required for billing on the Implicity platform is complete and up to date - including the administrative and insurance information that conditions reimbursement - and put the right controls in place to secure reimbursement.

On the organization, one step back:

  • Structure the scope: build the target vision, break it down into an operational roadmap, prioritize, document and drive process change (including tooling and automation).

  • Improve the logistics chain: raise the standard on how devices are handled and reconditioned: turnaround time, traceability, quality of what goes back into circulation and drive those improvements as projects, with Customer Success and Tech.

Your Profile and Mindset

Experience Profile

  • Seniority & Experience: You have already held a logistics / supply chain / operations role

  • Education: Higher education in logistics, supply chain, operations or business.

  • Languages: Confortable speaking both French and English.

  • Sector Experience (Bonus): MedTech, healthcare or medical devices, any environment involving reimbursement or third-party payer billing, startup or scale-up experience.

Mindset and Soft Skills

  • Structured and rigorous: You organize, prioritize and document — you are the person who turns an implicit process into an explicit one.

  • Project management: You run several workstreams in parallel, with deadlines, stakeholders and real follow-through.

  • Comfortable with change: You pick up a new tool quickly and treat change as part of the job, not as an obstacle.

  • Clear communication and step-back mentality: You make your scope legible to Customer Success, Sales, Finance and Tech, and you can zoom out to build the target picture then zoom back in to make it happen operationally.

A Note on Applying: We are looking for an experienced Logistics Manager, but we know the perfect candidate doesn't exist. If you believe you possess the core required experience and strongly align with this mindset, we highly encourage you to apply.

Recruitment process

  • 1st HR Contact with Astrid (Talent Acquisition) – 30-45 min - G-meet

  • Job / Manager Interview with Anne (your future manager) – 60 min - G-meet

  • Meet the Team – 30-60 min - On-site or Remote

  • Fit Interview with Lucie (COO) - 45 min - On-site

  • Reference Check & Offer (usually follows within 72 hours )

Depending on your availability, the recruitment process should last less than 3-4 weeks.

General information

Salary

  • For this job (full-time), you have a base salary depending on your experience between 45k to 48k€ per year

  • Eligible for stock option (BSPCEs) according to the company's existing rules

Good to know

  • Health care plan: Alan (50% employer)

  • Luncheon voucher: 9€ (50% employer)

  • Transport: 50% of your pass OR sustainable mobility pass

Remote work & Location

  • 3 days per week (progressively)

  • Location: 2 rue du Colonel Driant, 75001, PARIS

title: Head of Sales (F/H)
description:
JOSHUA RH est un cabinet de recrutement de cadres et cadres dirigeants, animé par la conviction que l’alignement des valeurs et des réussites peut transformer une entreprise autant qu’une carrière.

Nous accompagnons un acteur de la tech (éditeur Saas + app, +300 collaborateurs) autofinancé et en forte croissance.

Le groupe possède aujourd’hui une base conséquente d'utilisateurs freemium, et plus de 1.000 nouveaux freemium s’enregistrent chaque semaine. Ainsi se dégagent des enjeux de croissance, autour des notions d’activation, de conversion, d’engagement, de rétention et d’expansion.

Leader de la performance commerciale, vous déployez avec les équipes une stratégie qui combine une approche ‘produit’ et une approche de proximité incarnée par un conseiller, visant à convertir les utilisateurs freemium vers un modèle payant en leur faisant découvrir toute la valeur des différentes solutions proposées (en direct ou via les partenaires de l’écosystème).

Vous prenez le leadership du service comprenant :

- des chargés d’affaires capables d’agir sur l’ensemble du parcours, de conseiller et upseller

- l’équipe product marketing/crm, qui déploie des actions in app via une stratégie PLG

// Profil Recherché

Vous possédez une expérience réussie de la construction d’une organisation commerciale scalable, une véritable mécanique de croissance, acquise dans un environnement SaaS à fort volume, avec une culture service, data et expérimentation.

Doté d’une appétence marquée pour la tech, vous avez mis en place un funnel performant à l’aide des outils CRM, avec une forte orientation conversion et performance.

Vous faites preuve d’un fort leadership et vous êtes capable de structurer, développer, accompagner les équipes.

Rémunération : 90 000,00€ à 130 000,00€ par an

Avantages :

  • Horaires flexibles

Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (Paris (75))

title: CPO / Chief Product Officer (H/F) — CDI Paris
description:
À propos

Chez Club Employés, on accompagne au quotidien les entreprises et leurs salariés, quelle que soit leur taille (CSE, TPE/PME, …). Notre mission est simple : favoriser le bien-être de chaque collaborateur au quotidien grâce à notre plateforme d’avantages et de réductions dédiée aux salariés.

Concrètement, nous rejoindre c’est contribuer à améliorer le pouvoir d’achat de nos clients. Avec notre plateforme, on leur propose de la billetterie à tarif réduit (cinéma, concerts ou événements sportifs), des voyages plus accessibles, des sorties en famille dans les parcs d’attractions nationaux ou locaux, des économies dans les enseignes du quotidien (Decathlon, Carrefour, Ikéa, Fnac…) et bien d’autres…

La Tech et le Produit ne sont pas de simples supports : ils sont le cœur battant de notre stratégie. Nous éditions et commercialisons des plateformes digitales B2B/B2C à fort impact, façonnées pour transformer l'expérience collaborateur et répondre aux enjeux de milliers d'entreprises.

Dans le cadre de notre forte croissance, nous recherchons notre futur CPO / Lead Product Owner (H/F) pour porter la vision produit, orchestrer son exécution et manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire talentueuse.

Descriptif du poste

Rattaché(e) directement au CTO, vous occupez une position clé et hautement stratégique. Vous êtes le bras droit du CTO sur toute la dimension opérationnelle et stratégique de nos plateformes, garantissant à la fois l'alignement business et une exécution sans faille.

Votre rôle s'articule autour de deux piliers majeurs : la vision & l'exécution produit, et le management de talents.

Vos missions principales :

  • Vision & Stratégie Produit :

    • Porter et incarner la vision globale de l'ensemble de notre écosystème de plateformes (7 marques, 7 plateformes)
    • Piloter l'élaboration de la roadmap produit globale en alignement étroit avec la direction et les priorités stratégiques du groupe.

  • Pilotage de l'Exécution & Garant de la Roadmap (duo avec le CTO) :

    • Être le garant absolu de l'exécution et du respect des délais de la roadmap auprès des équipes projets.
    • Suivre l'intégralité du cycle de vie des produits (de l'idéation au post-lancement).
    • Prioriser les arbitrages de développement en vous basant systématiquement sur le ROI et la valeur apportée.
    • Définir les KPIs clés en amont de chaque projet et mesurer l'impact réel des livraisons.
    • Superviser la formalisation des besoins (User Stories, critères d'acceptation) et maintenir un standard d'exigence élevé.

  • Management & Leadership (Axe prioritaire) :

    • Encadrer, animer et faire grandir une équipe de 5 Product Owners Seniors répartis dans 5 Scrum Teams et 3 UX Designers.
    • Structurer les méthodologies de travail, diffuser les bonnes pratiques Agile et favoriser une culture d'ownership au sein de l'équipe Produit.
    • Inculquer une culture centrée sur l'utilisateur, la performance et le delivery.

  • Collaboration Transverse :

    • Travailler main dans la main avec l'ensemble des départements (Tech/Dev, Design, Communication, Marketing, Sales, Support Client) pour garantir la cohérence et l'excellence opérationnelle des plateformes.

Profil recherché

  • Expérience : Vous justifiez d'au moins 6 à 8 ans d'expérience en Product Management, dont une expérience probante sur un poste à forte dimension managériale (Lead PO, Head of Product ou CPO) dans l'univers SaaS / Editeur de logiciels.

  • Compétences Managériales : Vous êtes un leader inspirant, capable de piloter des profils seniors, de fédérer des équipes multi-disciplinaires (PO, UX) et de faire monter en compétences vos collaborateurs.

  • Culture de l'Exécution : Vous n'êtes pas seulement un visionnaire : vous êtes orienté delivery, pragmatique et garant du bon déroulement de la roadmap aux côtés de la direction technique.

  • Orientation Data & ROI : Vous prenez vos décisions sur des données chiffrées, définissez des KPIs clairs et savez démontrer le ROI de vos arbitrages.

  • Communication & Collaboration : Excellent communicant, vous savez vulgariser les sujets complexes, négocier les priorités et créer du liant entre la vision Tech/Produit et les enjeux Business

  • Anglais courant obligatoire

Process de recrutement

  • Premier échange téléphonique de qualification (30 min)

  • Entretien approfondi avec le CTO (parcours, vision produit & management)

  • Rencontre avec l'équipe.

  • Entretien final avec les fondateurs / équipe de direction

Informations complémentaires

  • Type de contrat : CDI
  • Date de début : 01 décembre 2026
  • Lieu : Paris
  • Niveau d'études : Bac +5 / Master
  • Expérience : > 7 ans
  • Télétravail partiel possible

title: Product Operations Manager (DesignOps)
description:
Location

Paris

Employment Type

Full time

Department

Product


About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Product Operations Manager (Design), you will sit within Mistral's Product Operations function, with a focus on streamlining the operations of the design team. You will own how the Design team operates as a system — its cadences, its rituals, its coordination, and the connective tissue that lets designers focus on design. This role exists because a design org at our scale needs someone whose full-time job is the operating system itself: defining it, holding it, and continuously tuning it so the team runs with a heartbeat rather than on ad-hoc heroics.

You will own the team's weekly and quarterly cadences — from leadership syncs to planning, retros, and share-outs — and establish how we track work, surface it outward, and make decisions. You'll design the forums where decisions get made and recorded, keep the rituals that create alignment, and aggressively cut the ones that are just overhead.

Equally, you are the bridge across the org. You will coordinate the interlocks between Brand and Marketing for upcoming launches, and between Product and Product Design for the build pipeline — so interdependencies are understood and planned for, not discovered at the last minute. You will partner closely with marketing, PMs, engineering, GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping before it ships.

This is a team-of-one role with a founding design-ops mentality. You will build the discipline from scratch, automate repetitive coordination with AI where it helps, and coordinate people where it matters. You report to the Head of Product Operations, working day-to-day with the Head of Design and the design team.

What You Will Do

  • Define the operating system of the design team — the cadences, forums, rituals, and source-of-truth that keep the team aligned and moving forward.

  • Own the weekly and quarterly cadences, from leadership syncs and critiques to planning, retros, and headcount-cycle inputs.

  • Coordinate the Brand × Marketing and Product × Product Design interlocks so design work is surfaced with enough lead time and dependencies are planned, not discovered late.

  • Establish how the team tracks and shares out work — a single source of truth for status, and the forums where design is made legible to the rest of the org.

  • Design and hold decision-making forums so decisions get made, recorded, and not relitigated.

  • Separate ritual from overhead — keep the cadences that create alignment and cut the ones that are just tax.

  • Automate repetitive coordination, reporting, and tracking with AI so the team spends time on design, not admin.

  • Bring the wider Product Operations toolkit to the design team — data and analytics for transparent reporting, structured feedback loops and early-access programmes, and launch coordination that aligns design work with product release cycles and go-to-market timing.

  • Partner with marketing, PMs, engineering and GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping.

What We're Looking For

  • 6–10 years of experience in design operations, product operations, program management, or a chief-of-staff role within a creative or product organization.

  • A founding design-ops mindset — you've built operational disciplines from scratch, not just maintained inherited ones.

  • Comfortable automating with AI tools to remove repetitive overhead, while equally skilled at coordinating people and building coalitions without authority.

  • Strong systems thinking — you design repeatable rhythms and processes, not just run meetings.

  • Design literacy — enough background to have felt the pain designers feel and to be credible with the team.

  • A make-it-happen attitude: positive, bias to action, unblocks rather than escalates.

  • Excellent communication and synthesis skills — you turn scattered signals into a shared source of truth.

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity and define your own scope in a role with no playbook and no team to delegate to.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Product Owner M/F
description:

Akiem runs a comprehensive, certified Entity in Charge of Maintenance (ECM) industrial ecosystem built around a pan-European network of workshops and extensive inventories of spare parts for the maintenance of the rolling stock supplied to its customers.


To support the growth of its operational maintenance activity and the development of its information system, AKIEM Group is strengthening its IS Project Management team and hiring an IS Project Manager, reporting to the Head of IT Applications & Digital.

You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of business applications, with a strong focus on digital and data solutions (customer portal, IoT data, CRM, etc.). You will play a key role in coordinating, analyzing, developing, implementing, and supporting information systems across the Group, working closely with all AKIEM departments in France and Germany.

Main Responsibilities

1. Application Management & Development

  • Manage and optimize a set of digital business applications (customer portal, IoT data, CRM...).
  • Identify system enhancements to improve business efficiency and process control.
  • Define and develop interfaces between systems.
  • Ensure proper documentation, processes, training, and support within the business.

2. User Support & Business Partnering

  • Act as the main contact for Key Users and business processes (ERP, BI, CMMS, SOP, etc.).
  • Promote digital innovation and propose technical solutions to meet business needs.
  • Plan and implement functional changes, configurations, or minor developments.
  • Act as the Group’s Data Expert / Data Champion.

3. IT Project Management

  • Coordinate planning, organization, and execution of project activities.
  • Manage project budgets, costs, suppliers, and integrators.
  • Oversee testing (UAT), deployment, and change management.
  • Ensure process compliance, sign-offs, and project stage gates.

4. Communication & Coordination

  • Communicate project progress and process changes to business stakeholders.
  • Prioritize incoming requests within your application perimeter.
  • Act as an internal consultant, providing value-added tools and solutions.

Profile and experience

  • Master’s degree or equivalent
  • Experience in the management of IT projects (ITIL, SCRUM, etc.)

Does this description resonate with you? This position, within a highly stimulating environment, is made for you!
Don’t hesitate - join a motivated and dynamic team within an inspiring group that values genuine, human-centered relationships :)

TalentPool Notice: Even if this position does not perfectly match your profile, we would be delighted to include you in our TalentPool and contact you for future opportunities.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
About Freedom

Freedom Digital Bank France will form part of Freedom Holding Corp., a diversified international financial services group publicly listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker FRHC. The Group operates across Europe, the United States and Central Asia, with activities spanning banking, brokerage, investment services, insurance, payments and digital consumer services.

About the role

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Operating Officer to establish, lead and scale the operations of Freedom Digital Bank France.

The COO will develop the bank’s operating model and ensure operational excellence across Operations, Customer Service, Risk, Technology, Product and Business. The role will focus on scalable processes, automation, service quality, operational resilience and a seamless digital customer experience.

As a member of the founding executive team, the COO will contribute to the bank’s regulatory authorisation, establishment and launch in France. The successful candidate will ensure that the operating model meets applicable French and EU requirements and the expectations of the relevant supervisory authorities.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the operational strategy for Freedom Digital Bank France.
  • Design and implement the bank’s target operating model.
  • Build scalable, efficient and customer-focused banking processes.
  • Oversee day-to-day banking operations and customer-service delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and establish effective decision-making and escalation processes.
  • Improve operational efficiency, service quality and digital customer experience.
  • Establish operational KPIs, service levels and performance-reporting frameworks.
  • Support the launch and scaling of digital banking products and services.
  • Develop operational controls, procedures and governance arrangements.
  • Establish compliant processes for customer onboarding, complaints handling, payments, customer servicing and operational incident management.
  • Oversee business continuity, crisis management and operational resilience arrangements.
  • Manage outsourcing arrangements and operational relationships with critical third-party providers.
  • Work closely with Risk, Compliance, Product and Technology.
  • Lead operational transformation, automation and continuous process improvement.
  • Support the preparation of operational documentation required for the regulatory authorisation process.

Requirements
  • 10+ years of operations experience within digital banking, banking, fintech or another regulated financial institution.
  • Previous experience as a COO, Head of Operations or in an equivalent senior leadership position.
  • Proven experience establishing, transforming or scaling regulated operations.
  • Strong understanding of French and EU operational requirements applicable to banks and digital financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of applicable ACPR and EBA expectations, including requirements covering governance, outsourcing, complaints handling, customer protection and business continuity.
  • Understanding of DORA, ICT incident management, operational resilience and third-party risk requirements.
  • Experience implementing digital onboarding, customer servicing and operational automation.
  • Experience managing outsourced services and critical third-party providers in a regulated environment.
  • Experience supporting a banking authorisation, market entry, bank launch or major transformation in France or another EU jurisdiction is strongly preferred.
  • Strong stakeholder management and people leadership skills.
  • Excellent strategic, analytical and execution capabilities.
  • Full professional fluency in French and English is mandatory.

Benefits
  • Employment contract in accordance with French labor law;
  • Relocation package for the employee and family members;
  • 50% coverage of the annual health insurance cost for the employee and eligible family members;
  • 25 days of annual leave, public holidays, and all statutory leave entitlements;
  • On-site work in a modern, well-located office.

title: Legal Product Operations & Coordination Manager (F/H) - NIMI
description:
Description de l’entreprise



Classée parmi les principaux gestionnaires d'actifs au monde avec plus de 1 300 milliards d’euros d'actifs sous gestion, Natixis Investment Managers (Natixis IM) propose une gamme de solutions diversifiées couvrant différents types de classes d'actifs, de styles de gestion et de véhicules, y compris des stratégies et des produits innovants répondant aux critères environnementaux, sociaux et de gouvernance (ESG) dédiés au développement de la finance durable.

Les équipes de Natixis IM travaillent en partenariat avec leurs clients - investisseurs institutionnels, fonds d’investissement, entreprises et particuliers - afin de comprendre leurs besoins spécifiques et de leur fournir des informations et des solutions d'investissement adaptées à leurs objectifs à long terme.

Grâce à l’approche multi-boutique de Natixis IM, les clients peuvent ainsi bénéficier de la réflexion et de l’expertise d’une vingtaine de sociétés de gestion active.

Natixis Investment Managers International (Natixis IMI) est la principale société de gestion de Natixis IM en Europe. Elle réunit 2 activités :

  • Les activités de distribution en Europe et dans d'autres zones géographiques comme l'APAC, le Moyen Orient, et l'Amérique latine, de l’offre en gestion d’actifs de Natixis IM ;
  • Une plateforme de centres d’expertises (fonctions support) au service des activités de distribution et des affiliés.

Natixis IMI poursuit son développement et renforce sa présence en France et à l’international, en s’appuyant sur l’expertise de ses équipes et sur le modèle multi-affiliés de Natixis IM.




Poste et missions



Vous rejoignez la Direction juridique de NIMI en tant que Legal Product Operations & coordination manager.

La Direction Juridique de Natixis Investment Managers International, composée de 26 collaborateurs, assure la sécurité juridique des structures et des opérations en matière de gestion et de commercialisation (produits, services, expertises).

Elle assure un rôle de conseil et intervient en coordination avec les différentes fonctions opérationnelles et support pour le compte de l’entreprise et d’autres sociétés du groupe.

En tant que Legal Product Operations & coordination manager vous accompagnez le Head of Legal NIMI dans la gestion des activités juridiques liées au développement, au lancement, à la commercialisation et à la vie juridique des produits de NIMI.

#TransformativeFinance

Ce poste est basé à Paris avec la possibilité de télétravailler.

title: Industry Engagement Consultant – Oil & Gas Methane Partnership 2.0 (OGMP 2.0)
description:
Result of Service
The The Industry Engagement Consultant – Oil & Gas Methane Partnership 2.0 (OGMP 2.0)] consultant will develop and deliver outputs to advance the growth and external positioning of IMEO´s industry engagement initiatives, with a focus on OGMP 2.0, which involves designing and implementing stakeholder engagement approaches, recruiting oil and gas companies to join the initiative, strengthening investor and civil society engagement, promoting related MRV work, and producing materials to support these objectives.
Work Location
Remote
Expected duration
6 months
Duties and Responsibilities
The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is the leading global environmental authority setting the global environmental agenda and advocating for environmental action across the UN system. UNEP’s International Methane Emissions Observatory (IMEO) is a data-driven initiative accelerating reductions in methane emissions, a major contributor to climate change. IMEO provides open, reliable and actionable data to support emissions reductions aligned with the Paris Agreement. To do this, IMEO is harnessing a methane data revolution under way thanks to rapidly advancing technology and momentum for methane action. IMEO collects, integrates, and reconciles data from methane-detecting satellites, scientific measurement studies, rigorous industry reporting through the Oil and Gas Methane Partnership 2.0 (OGMP 2.0), and national emissions inventories. These initiatives are game-changers for climate action – and as a core implementing partner of the Global Methane Pledge, IMEO is shaping the future of methane mitigation. IMEO’s focus on transparency has been most successful with the Oil and Gas Methane Programme OGMP 2.0. Now in its 6th year, with over 160 member companies, IMEO seeks to deepen engagement with existing industry members and grow the partnership with the recruitment of new members. The consultant will support OGMP’s external engagement, market development, and communications work. Expected tasks and responsibilities include : Develop and support implementation of IMEO engagement strategies, with a focus on OGMP 2.0. Map, prioritize, and maintain a working overview of key stakeholders across the industry, investor, government, NGO, and technical expert landscape. Outreach to oil and gas companies and help build the recruitment pipeline for OGMP 2.0 participation. Engage with investors and financial institutions on methane transparency, stewardship Prepare and deliver webinars, briefings, workshops, presentations, and outreach activities. Draft and refine stakeholder-facing materials, including briefing notes, slide inputs, speaking points, FAQs, and external communication inputs. Track stakeholder feedback, risks, opportunities, and market developments relevant to OGMP 2.0. Support collaboration with external partners, including industry, investors, governments, scientific institutions, NGOs, and technical experts. Provide strategic advice to the OGMP 2.0 team on engagement sequencing, stakeholder positioning, and market opportunities. Support other IMEO engagement and communications tasks as required. The consultant will report to Head of IMEO.
Qualifications/special skills
Required: Masters or Equivalent in energy, environment, climate policy, business, finance, international relations or related field. A first university degree in combination with 10 years of experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree Minimum 8 years of experience in stakeholder engagement, market development, partnership building or industry experience in climate, energy, extractives, heavy industry, finance, or related sectors. Strong understanding of the oil and gas sector, methane, industrial decarbonisation, and/or investor sectors Track record of engaging companies, investors, governments, industry associations, NGOs, or international organizations Strong engagement expertise with an existing network of stakeholders
Languages
Fluency in oral and written English. English is the working language of UNEP's IMEO. Knowledge of additional languages is an asset.
Additional Information
EXPECTED OUTPUTS: Develop and deliver a stakeholder mapping and prioritization for key OGMP 2.0 markets (including but not limited to US, India, Middle East, Central Asia, Latin America). Produce sector-specific engagement and supply-chain awareness outputs (e.g. reports, presentations, company stories or similar materials). Contribute to investor engagement and stewardship-related products, such as briefings, advisory notes, action plans, etc. Produce promotional materials for OGMP 2.0 and related methane transparency objectives. Manage the mentoring programme and event plan for technical experience sharing sessions Develop and deliver user needs assessment and improvement plans for digital products in collaboration with data and development teams. Develop and deliver webinars, briefings, meetings, and presentations for outreach activities. Provide OGMP 2.0-related insights for IMEO communications and events. Support the implementation of the IMEO Methane Training Series in partnership with the Government Relations team.
No Fee
THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS’ BANK ACCOUNTS.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Updated in September 2026

About Upflow


Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow


As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.


2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.


3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!


4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it


5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check


7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.


*****


Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

title: Head of Growth Marketing & GTM
description:
We are seeking a Head of Marketing & GTM to supercharge Treatwell’s B2B and B2C growth in Europe. Reporting directly to the CMO, you will lead a core team of +10 marketers, combining analytical rigor and cross-functional leadership to drive business impact across 14 countries.

This role carries a dual responsibility:

  • Global channel expansion: Drive global adoption and revenue generation by scaling new marketing channels, high-impact growth projects, and product launches across all markets.
  • GTM execution: Own and lead the end-to-end Go-To-Market strategy, ensuring flawless, high-converting execution across Treatwell’s 13 local operating countries.

Hi, we’re Treatwell. Nice to meet you.

We’re a team of 700 passionate and brilliantly talented people across Europe. We’re the industry’s smartest salon management software, all connected to Europe’s leading bookings platform, working with over 95,000 salon partners across 14 countries, processing over 8 million bookings every month. And….breathe.

But we’re not done yet. We’re on an exciting journey to digitally revolutionise the hair and beauty community.

Benefits
