  • ️ Equal Opportunities

Treatwell is an 'Open to All' employer and warmly welcomes everybody to the team. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process as required. Please add any adjustment requests to your application.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About us

Greenly was founded in 2019 by Alexis, Matthieu and Arnaud with one mission: make carbon management as essential as financial management.

Today, we are a global leader in carbon accounting, proudly B-Corp certified and part of the French Tech 120. Our climate suite combines smart data collection with intuitive automation, helping companies measure, reduce, and report their emissions with ease — supported at every step by our in-house climate experts.

More than 3,500 companies in 20+ countries use Greenly to manage their climate strategy: from carbon assessments and life-cycle analyses to SBTi trajectories and compliance with CSRD and CBAM.

We are now a team of 200+ people from 40+ nationalities, based in Paris, London, Barcelona, and New York.

To date, we’ve tracked over 200 million tons of CO₂ through our platform. Our next milestone: 10,000 clients and one billion tons of CO2 under management.

Our Values

  • Ambition for climate: Minimize GHG emissions, maximize climate impact

  • Deliver with agility: Work in small increments: fail fast, learn fast, win fast

  • Own your opportunities: Achieve outstanding results by showing initiative and accountability

  • Feedback paves the way: Succeed as a team by helping others progress

Curious to know more ? Check out our Culture Book, blog , and youtube channel

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team and take ownership across three fronts at once: vertical positioning, sales enablement, and product launch messaging. You'll work at the intersection of Product, Sales, and GTM — turning complex regulatory and technical subject matter into messaging that converts, and into enablement that unblocks pipeline. This is a senior, high-autonomy role for someone who thinks like an operator, not just a marketer: you'll be expected to diagnose where messaging clarity is costing us deals, and fix it.

What you will own

Vertical positioning & messaging

  • Own and evolve positioning across Greenly's strategic verticals (Automotive, Packaging, F&B, Construction/BTP, Fashion/Textile, Pharma/Chemicals, Electronics), anchoring messaging in the regulation that creates urgency for each (CBAM, CSRD/ESRS E1, PPWR, SBTi, EU Battery Regulation) rather than generic ESG framing.

  • Partner with GTM and Sales to translate vertical positioning into ABM campaign briefs, outbound talk tracks, and content that speaks the language of each buyer.

  • Keep messaging synchronized with the regulatory calendar — CBAM is the sharpest wedge we have; your job is to make sure every vertical has an equivalent.

Sales enablement ️

  • Build and maintain battlecards, objection-handling guides, and enablement material that Sales actually uses — no shelfware.

  • Run regular enablement sessions with AEs and SDRs; treat Sales feedback as a primary input to the roadmap, not an afterthought.

  • Build Storylane demos and guided, self-serve product tours that showcase Greenly's product in action — for prospects, partners, and Sales to use throughout the funnel.

Product launches & messaging

  • Lead go-to-market messaging for new product releases, in particular EcoPilot's AI agents (e.g. the Environmental Engineer agent) and LCA/ACV capabilities — ensuring product pages and campaigns only claim what's actually shipped.

  • Act as the guardrail between Product and content: no page gets rewritten around a feature that isn't live yet.

  • Define launch tiering, sequencing, and success metrics in partnership with Product Management.

Analyst & industry benchmark relations

  • Own Greenly's presence in third-party industry reports and benchmarks (Verdantix, Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Sia Partners, and other analyst/consulting studies) — this is how buyers validate vendors before they ever talk to Sales.

  • Manage the participation calendar across all tracked firms: decide which benchmarks to enter, own the relationship with analysts, and drive the RFI/questionnaire response process end to end.

  • Build and maintain a reusable answer library so responses to recurring analyst questions don't get rebuilt from scratch every cycle.

  • Turn analyst recognition (rankings, "leader" placements, quotes) into GTM assets — sales one-pagers, website proof points, PR.

Skills to succeed

  • 3+ to 5 years in Product Marketing in B2B SaaS, ideally in a technical, regulated, or compliance-driven space.

  • Proven track record turning complex/regulatory subject matter into messaging that a buyer (and a sales rep) can act on.

  • ️ Direct experience building sales enablement material that field teams actually use, not just producing collateral.

  • Strong cross-functional operating style — you'll work daily with Sales, GTM, RevOps, and Product.

  • / Fluent in French and English; comfortable producing final deliverables in English for international teams.

  • Bonus: prior exposure to carbon accounting, ESG, sustainability reporting, or another compliance-driven vertical (fintech/insurtech regs, cybersecurity compliance, etc.).

Perks & benefits

  • Salary of 50k€ per year (total package)

  • Beautiful offices in the heart of Paris (9ᵉ arrondissement)

  • Flexible remote work options

  • ️ Top-notch tools to help you do your best work

  • Private medical insurance with Alan (including mental health support), 100% covered

  • 50% Navigo reimbursement for public transport

  • Sustainable lunch vouchers via Ekip

  • Partial coverage of your Gymlib subscription

  • A culture of autonomy, transparency, and collaboration — with a team of highly talented, committed people

The recruitment process

  • Meet Dana for a first call

  • Join Laurent, Head of Growth, for a second interview

  • Prepare and present a case study exercise

  • Meet Arnaud, co-founder and CMO

  • Meet Alexis, CEO

  • Provide us with 2 references to complete the recruitment process

  • We welcome you during our onboarding week!

We’re a team shaped by diverse experiences and ideas. If you’re excited about the role but don’t match every requirement, we still encourage you to apply — you may be the right person for the team.

️ For practical reasons, we request candidates to communicate as much as possible via the Teamtailor platform (rather than on LinkedIn, or other channels)

title: Customer Marketing Manager
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The Customer Marketing Manager is a storyteller and relationship-builder, at the heart of Pigment's Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Community & Customer Marketing. You will turn real customer outcomes into the case studies, speakers, and proof points that celebrate what our customers have achieved with Pigment, working closely with our Customer Community efforts to bring those relationships to life — built on genuine partnership and mutual trust, never on transactional asks.

What You will do:

This is an individual-contributor role at the center of a small, fast-moving team — high in ownership and cross-functional influence.
  • Customer Storytelling & Evidence: Partner with Pigment's customers and internal teams to identify, create, guide through approvals, and share high-fidelity case studies, testimonials, and video stories — a core way we celebrate and showcase our customers' success across Sales and Marketing.

  • Flagship Partnerships: Nurture relationships with strategically important customers, building the trust and internal alignment it takes to earn the honor of telling their story publicly


  • Public Speaking Alignment: Identify and invite customer speakers for events and webinars, matching the right customer voice to the right stage


  • External Visibility: Connect enthusiastic customers with opportunities for PR and social amplification, analyst surveys, and peer review sites (e.g. G2) — and, where relevant, help cultivate Pigment's presence within extended communities (finance professionals, AI/data practitioners) beyond our customer base, surfacing new stories and voices along the way


  • Systems of Record: Keep a thoughtful, living record of who we've worked with and how — so customers aren't over-approached twice for the same ask, and every relationship is handled with the care and memory it deserves — including managing the internal AI tools that help surface the right customer story to our sales teams just when they need it most


  • Metrics & Reporting: Support customer marketing metrics and reporting, translating story output into a clear read on reach and impact for internal stakeholders


  • Customer Recognition: Make sure every customer who shares their story is properly thanked and celebrated — through visibility for their own brand and team, invitations to exclusive Pigment moments, and public recognition that reflects genuinely well on them


  • Sales Reference Ownership**: Help drive the sales reference process — fulfilling requests thoughtfully, keeping Salesforce and other tools running smoothly for self-service, and making sure every customer who says yes is matched to the right opportunity, recognized for their time, and not over-asked

Who You Are:

  • Experience in customer marketing, case studies, or advocacy content within B2B tech — or comparable storytelling experience in PR, comms, or content marketing — with a track record of turning genuine relationships into public celebrations of success


  • Incredible relationship skills — a natural connector of people and details, equally comfortable in a CSM's inbox, a VP's calendar, and a customer's legal/comms review


  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the judgment to hold a conversation at any level, from end users to C-suite


  • Tool-savvy and genuinely interested in scaling your own workflow with AI-assisted tools (Claude, Notion, Deeto, Salesforce, and similar)


  • Patient and strategic — able to nurture a meaningful relationship with an important customer over time, and know when to pause and protect that relationship above all else


  • A focused storyteller with a strong point of view on what makes a story land, and the discipline to prioritize the few stories that matter most


  • A great team member who brings energy to a small, fast-moving function and treats every customer interaction as a chance to build trust and celebrate what they've accomplished

How You'll Work Across The Org:

  • Partner with Sales: Align existing customers with the opportunities teams are working through via 1:1 and 1:many reference discussions, while supplying the public stories, internal-only proof points, and customer voice they need at the right stage of a sales conversation. Flag when it's time to nurture new advocates.


  • Partner with CX: Work with Customer Success as trusted partners and scouts — building a warm relationship with the right advocate before any conversation about sharing their story

  • Partner with Customer Community: You'll sit alongside the Community team, so customer stories and community moments naturally reinforce each other, giving customers more ways to connect with Pigment and with each other.

  • Partner with Corporate Comms, PR & Analyst Relations: Nurture a community of customers ready for media moments, analyst surveys, and peer review campaigns, so we're never relying on a single personal contact


  • Partner with Product: Feed customer story themes and roadmap-relevant feedback back to Product, and cultivate advocate relationships aligned to where the roadmap is heading

What we offer:

  • Competitive package
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions

How we work:

  • Thrive Together: We can only win as a team—act like founders and do right by our peers, customers, partners, and planet.

  • Never Settle: We aim to be the best by delivering with rigor and ambition every day.

  • Go For It: We’re biased toward action—every step fuels learning and brings us closer to our mission.

  • Be Real, Be Humble: We value feedback, empathy, and openness as we grow and solve complex challenges.

  • Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy, simplify complexity, and make customers heroes in their organizations.

We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Vice President, Group Corporate Finance
description:
Join BIC World, a community of brands dedicated to creating ingeniously simple and joyful products that have been part of hearts and homes for over 75 years. We are committed to growing our iconic and innovative brands by reimagining everyday essentials in new, sustainable, and responsible ways.

Our culture encourages a "roll up your sleeves and get the job done" mindset, ensuring self-starters, problem solvers, and innovative thinkers can truly thrive. At BIC World, you are empowered to take ownership of your career and use your unique perspective to make a meaningful, global impact on our mission.


As BIC continues to strengthen governance, improve ways of working and support sustainable growth, we are evolving our Finance organization toward a more integrated and globally connected model. Finance plays a central role in this evolution by enabling informed decision-making, supporting business performance and upholding high standards of financial stewardship.

Reporting directly to the Group Chief Financial & Digital Officer and serving as a member of the Global Finance Leadership Team, the Group Corporate Finance Head will lead the transformation and future direction of BIC's global Corporate Finance organization.

This role brings together strategic leadership, operational excellence and deep financial expertise across Consolidation & Technical Accounting, Accounting Operations, Tax, Insurance and Treasury, while continuing to develop a scalable global organization capable of supporting BIC's next phase of growth.

The role will initially lead approximately 30-35 professionals at Group level and, over time, assume broader responsibility for a global organization of roughly 150 Finance professionals as Finance activities transition into a more centralized operating model.

This is a meaningful opportunity to build on the strengths of Corporate Finance at BIC while shaping its future operating model and contributing to governance, operating effectiveness and long-term value creation.



What You'll Do
Drive Financial Governance & Reporting Excellence
  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy and timeliness of BIC's consolidated financial statements and external reporting under IFRS as well as countries’ statutory reporting.
  • Own and continuously evolve Group accounting policies, providing leadership on technical accounting matters, complex transactions and strategic projects.
  • Lead the preparation of high-quality financial reporting and governance materials for the Executive Committee, Board of Directors and Audit Committee.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the Group CFO on accounting, governance, treasury, tax and financial risk matters.
  • Maintain a strong internal control environment and foster trusted relationships with external auditors, regulators and key stakeholders.
Lead the Transformation of Corporate Finance
  • Design and execute the future vision for BIC's global Corporate Finance organization.
  • Drive harmonization, simplification and automation across Record-to-Report, consolidation, statutory reporting and related finance processes.
  • Partner closely with Group Transformation and IT teams to support ERP deployment and broader Finance transformation initiatives.
  • Help define and optimize interactions between Corporate Finance, regional organizations and Global Business Services.
  • Establish scalable governance frameworks, operating models and ways of working across geographies.
Build a World-Class Global Organization
  • Develop and lead a high-performing international leadership team across Accounting, Consolidation, Tax, Insurance and Treasury.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Drive talent development, succession planning and leadership capability building.
  • Build OneBIC ways of working across regions and functions.
Partner Across the Business
  • Act as a strategic partner to the CFO and Finance Leadership Team in supporting business performance and decision making.
  • Foster continued collaboration with Controlling, FP&A, Procurement, Legal, Internal Audit, HR and regional Finance teams.
  • Enable a timely, reliable and fact-based view of business performance through strong Record-to-Report governance.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager – France
description:
At Assessio, our mission is Zero Talent Waste. Through our assessment solutions and TalentSuite platform, we help organisations make better decisions across recruitment, talent management and employee development. Today, more than 2,000 organisations use Assessio, and we are continuing to grow across Europe.


We are now looking for an experienced Senior Customer Success Manager to join our French Customer Success team.


The role

As Senior Customer Success Manager, you will own and develop some of our largest and most complex customer accounts in France, managing the journey from onboarding and deployment through adoption, expansion and renewal.

Our product environment is technically complex, with deployments typically spanning 8–12 weeks and potentially involving several modules and stakeholders. You will lead technical onboarding and training, work closely with customers to drive adoption and help them get the most value from our solutions, both today and as their needs evolve.

This is also a commercially oriented role. You will be responsible for protecting and growing your portfolio through strong adoption, proactive renewal management, upsell and expansion.


What you will do

  • Own and develop a portfolio of large and strategically important customers

  • Manage the customer journey across onboarding, adoption, expansion and renewal

  • Lead technical onboarding and training and support successful product adoption

  • Build trusted relationships across multiple stakeholders, including decision-makers, HR, Legal, Procurement and IT

  • Understand customer objectives and translate them into concrete value and success plans

  • Own NRR for your portfolio, proactively managing renewal risks and identifying opportunities for upsell and expansion

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product and Support


Your team

You will join our French Customer Success team, consisting of five CSMs and one Support colleague, led by our Head of Customer Success France. You will also collaborate with colleagues across markets and functions as we continue to develop our products and Customer Success practices across Europe.


Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with a strong background in Customer Success, Customer Experience or another commercially oriented B2B SaaS environment.


You do not need previous experience within HR or Talent Management. More important is your ability to understand a complex product, connect it to customer needs and build long-term commercial partnerships.


We think you will succeed if you have:

  • Solid experience from Customer Success, Customer Experience or a similar commercial customer-facing role within B2B SaaS

  • Experience owning larger or complex customer accounts, including renewals, upsell and expansion

  • Experience onboarding and supporting customers with technical SaaS solutions, ideally involving multiple products or modules

  • Strong commercial and consultative skills, with the ability to turn customer objectives into both immediate and long-term value

  • Confidence navigating multiple stakeholders and different levels of seniority

  • Fluency in French and strong professional English, as several of our customers operate in international environments

Location

Our preferred location is Paris, where you will work closely with the local team.

For the right candidate, a remote setup elsewhere in France may also be discussed. Regardless of setup, you should be comfortable travelling to our Paris office regularly and meeting customers when needed.


Why Assessio?

At Assessio, you will join an international SaaS company with ambitious plans for the future and a clear purpose behind what we do.

You will work with strategically important customers and a sophisticated product where Customer Success goes beyond relationship management. You will be close to customers throughout implementation, adoption and development, while carrying clear commercial responsibility for retention and growth.

We are continuously developing our products and how we work across Europe, giving you the opportunity to influence how we create even greater value for our customers.

And most importantly, you will contribute to our mission of Zero Talent Waste, helping organisations make fairer and better people decisions.


Compensation & Benefits

The annual OTE for this role is approximately €56,000–€60,000 gross, including base salary and a fixed performance-based bonus.

The package also includes benefits such as 25 days of paid leave, additional RTT days for eligible employees, meal vouchers, complementary health insurance and 50% reimbursement of public transport.

We strongly value in-person collaboration and would ideally like you to work from our Paris office up to three days per week.


Our recruitment process

Our recruitment process is designed to look beyond the CV. We start by understanding your experience and then explore your potential through three Assessio assessments covering personality, problem-solving ability and values & motivation.

Our interviews and case focus on how you work and apply your experience in practice, followed by a reference check before moving to an offer.

We look forward to getting to know you!

title: KERING HR Group Cost Controller
description:
Summary

Kering is a global, family-led luxury group, home to people whose passion and expertise nurture creative Houses across couture and ready-to-wear, leather goods, jewelry, eyewear and beauty: Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga, McQueen, Brioni, Boucheron, Pomellato, Dodo, Qeelin, Ginori 1735, as well as Kering Eyewear. Inspired by their creative heritage, Kering Houses design and craft exceptional products and experiences that reflect the Group’s commitment to excellence, sustainability and culture. This vision is expressed in our signature: Creativity is our Legacy. In 2025, Kering employed 44,000 people and generated revenue of €14.7 billion.

Job Description

We are seeking an HR Group Cost Controller to join our Group HR Controlling team as soon as possible.

Your opportunity

You will contribute to the management and transformation of Group HR Cost Controlling. Alongside recurring actuals, forecast and budget cycles, you will play an active role in reviewing and improving HRCC processes and in developing reliable, decision-oriented Group reporting.

The role reports to the Head of Group HR Controlling and works closely with Brand HR Controllers, Group Finance, HR Shared Services, HRIS and Kering Tech.

How you will contribute

HRCC process review and Target Operating Model

Contribute to the review and implementation of the HR Cost Controlling Target Operating Model.

Document and challenge current processes, identify gaps and support the design of simplified and standardized target processes.

Contribute to the definition of roles and responsibilities, governance principles, controls, service standards and process documentation.

Support the harmonization of Actuals, Forecast and Budget practices across the Group and its Houses.

Coordinate with HR, Finance, HR Shared Services and Technology stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable process improvements.

Support change management, communication, training and adoption within the HRCC community.

Group reporting and analytics

Create, enhance and maintain standard Group reporting on headcount, FTE and personnel costs.

Produce recurring dashboards, variance analyses, bridges and executive-ready commentary for Group stakeholders.

Consolidate Brand submissions and ensure consistency of definitions, indicators and reporting outputs.

Develop analytical views that explain workforce and personnel-cost trends and support management decision-making.

Partner with Finance and HR stakeholders to align reporting requirements and reduce ad hoc, manual reporting.

Actuals, Forecast and Budget cycles

Coordinate the monthly HR Controlling closing process and monitor the completeness and quality of workforce and personnel-cost data.

Support Forecast and Budget cycles, including guidelines, calendars, assumptions, consolidation, analysis and communication.

Perform reconciliations between HR and Finance data and investigate material discrepancies.

Provide functional support to Brand HR Controllers and respond to Group and Brand analysis requests.

Data quality, tools and continuous improvement

Secure data quality and consistency across Workday, payroll data, SAP Analytics Cloud and related reporting solutions.

Contribute to HRCC tool and Data Platform evolutions by defining business requirements, supporting prioritization and coordinating functional testing.

Help standardize master data, controls, mappings, documentation and user guidance.

Identify opportunities for automation and more efficient ways of working, while maintaining appropriate control and auditability.

Who you are

Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Management, Economics or a related field.

3 to 5 years of experience in HR controlling, financial analysis, audit, finance transformation or a similar analytical role, ideally in an international and complex organization.

Strong understanding of controlling principles, data reconciliation, reporting and variance analysis; knowledge of HR cost controlling is an advantage.

Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Workday or similar planning and reporting tools is an advantage.

Fluent in English, with the ability to lead meetings and produce clear documentation and executive-ready analyses; French is an advantage.

Comfortable working across HR, Finance and Technology teams in a multicultural environment.

Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, organization and deadline ownership.

Proactive, collaborative and improvement-oriented, with the ability to challenge existing practices constructively.

Why work with us?

Joining the team means becoming part of the ongoing transformation of Group HR Cost Controlling. You will help shape future HRCC processes and reporting standards, support the development of Group-wide workforce and personnel cost analytics, and build expertise across HR, Finance, data governance, process improvement and digital solutions in a highly international environment.

Kering is committed to diversity and inclusion and to providing equal opportunities in employment. We believe diversity in all its forms – disability, age, color, ancestry, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, gender identity, religion – enriches the workplace. It opens opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to adapt to a changing world. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their background.

Regular

2027-01-04

Schedule

Full time

title: Marketing & Partnerships Manager France, Portugal & Spain
description:
We are looking for a Marketing & Partnerships Manager to join the Primary Markets Marketing team in Paris. You will report to the Head of Marketing & Partnerships for Primary Markets and act as the key marketing partner for the French, Portuguese and Spanish Listing team.


You will translate business priorities into impactful marketing initiatives supporting companies throughout their equity financing journey—from initial consideration of capital markets and pre-IPO preparation to listing and post-IPO visibility.


You will contribute to positioning Euronext as the leading venue for equity financing in Europe, promoting the benefits of an IPO among entrepreneurs and decision-makers, strengthening the visibility of newly listed companies, and engaging the wider financial and entrepreneurial ecosystem.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Strategic Marketing Planning and Execution: Define and implement the Primary Markets marketing plan in France, Portugal & Spain, in line with local business objectives and Euronext’s broader pan-European strategy. Work closely with the Listing sales team to translate commercial priorities into targeted marketing initiatives designed to raise awareness of equity financing, identify prospective issuers, generate qualified leads and support companies throughout the IPO decision-making process.
  • Events and Business Development Initiatives: Design and deliver high-impact events and business-development initiatives targeting private companies and listed companies. Take ownership of project management, programme development, speaker and partner coordination, budgets, timelines, promotion and post-event follow-up. Develop relevant formats addressing topics such as access to equity financing, IPO preparation, market conditions, investor expectations and the experience of recently listed companies.
  • Pre-IPO Programmes Management: Lead the end-to-end management and promotion of Euronext’s pre-IPO and educational programmes in France, Portugal & Spain, including initiatives designed for executives and shareholders of private companies considering capital-markets financing.
  • Content and Digital Marketing: Define and implement a content and digital marketing strategy promoting Euronext’s equity financing solutions, new listings and listed-company success stories. Develop compelling and accessible content to make complex capital-markets topics relevant to entrepreneurs and business leaders. Activate the most effective channels, including CRM, social media, web content, newsletters and targeted acquisition campaigns.
  • New Listings Visibility: Develop communication and marketing initiatives around IPOs and new listings, in close coordination with issuers, internal teams and external stakeholders. Maximise the visibility of newly listed companies at key stages of their journey, from the announcement and first trading day to subsequent corporate milestones, while showcasing the diversity and attractiveness of Euronext’s issuer community.
  • External Partnerships Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with Euronext’s capital-markets ecosystem, including investment banks, advisers, professional associations, public institutions and entrepreneurial networks. Define joint action plans, develop co-branded content and events, coordinate partner contributions and ensure long-term engagement and value creation for all parties.
  • Sponsorships and Strategic Initiatives: Manage Euronext’s participation in relevant external events, sponsorships and market initiatives. Assess opportunities according to their strategic relevance, and contribution to Euronext’s positioning, negotiate partnerships, optimise visibility and deliverables.
  • Budget and Team Management: Allocate and monitor the marketing and partnerships budget, ensuring that investments are aligned with strategic and commercial priorities. Manage and develop a team of three, setting clear objectives, coordinating workloads and supporting individual growth.

Skills required:

  • At least seven years’ experience in marketing, business development or communications, ideally within financial services, capital markets, professional services or the entrepreneurial ecosystem, and in an international environment.
  • Team Management: Previous experience in managing a team, with the ability to set priorities, delegate effectively and support individual development.
  • Strong proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms, including CRM systems, social media management, campaign performance tools and AI-powered marketing solutions.
  • Experience in developing integrated campaigns, executive-level events, thought-leadership content and external partnerships.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, writing and presentation skills.
  • Creativity combined with strong project-management capabilities and attention to detail.
  • Fluent English and French, with the ability to work effectively in a pan-European environment. Knowledge of Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a strong team spirit, with the ability to collaborate with sales teams, senior executives and external stakeholders.
    • Autonomous, proactive and comfortable suggesting and implementing new ideas in a fast-paced environment.

The Primary Markets team’s mission is to connect ambitious companies with the capital they need to grow. We work closely with businesses considering an initial public offering (IPO) and support listed companies throughout their journey on our markets. Our team champions the advantages of listing, guiding business leaders through every step and ensuring they make the most of public markets. We drive innovation by developing new services and financing instruments, helping companies access diverse funding opportunities. By nurturing relationships with a broad pool of investors, we contribute to the vibrancy and growth of our markets. We also play a key role in promoting transparency and trust, working with financial industry stakeholders and public authorities to uphold the highest standards. Join our team and help promote Euronext markets across business leaders, empowering companies to unlock the full potential of financial markets.


Join Euronext – Shape capital markets for future generations Euronext is the leading European capital market covering the entire capital markets value chain, from listing, trading, clearing, settlement and custody, to solutions for issuers and investors. We operate seven national stock exchanges, handling 25% of European lit equity trading. Our products include equities, FX, ETFs, bonds, derivatives, commodities and indices. Euronext also provides clearing and settlement services through Euronext Clearing and our network of Euronext Securities CSDs. In addition, Euronext runs MTS, one of Europe’s leading electronic fixed income trading markets, and Nord Pool, the European power market. The company has a diverse domestic and international client base.

title: Senior Director, Marketing Mgmt
description:

title: Retail Manager - Travel Retail, Northern Europe
description:
Retail Manager - Travel Retail, Northern Europe

12 Month FTC

About Charlotte Tilbury Beauty

Founded by British makeup artist and beauty entrepreneur Charlotte Tilbury CBE in 2013, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has revolutionised the face of the global beauty industry by de-coding makeup applications for everyone, everywhere, with an easy-to-use, easy-to-choose, easy-to-gift range. Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty continues to break records across countries, channels, and categories and to scale at pace.

Over the last 10 years, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has experienced exceptional growth and is one of the most talked about brands in the beauty industry and beyond. It has become a global sensation across 50 markets (and growing), with over 2,300 employees globally who are part of the Dream Team making the magic happen.

Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty is a truly global business, delivering market-leading growth, innovative retail and product launches fuelled by industry-leading tech — all with an internal culture of embracing challenges, disruptive thinking, winning together, and sharing the magic. The energy behind the brand is infectious, and as we grow, we are always looking for extraordinary talent who want to be part of this our success and help drive our limitless ambitions.

About the role

We’re looking for an ambitious and experienced Retail Manager to join our fabulous, newly appointed Travel Retail team, focusing on the Northern Europe region.

Responsibilities include building retailer relationships, identifying commercial opportunities, leading a field team comprising of store-based business managers and retail artists and managing corresponding budgets, showcasing strong budget management capability and being confident in retail sales forecasting, reporting and data analysis.

KPIs are retail sales achievement, market share gains, mystery shopping score and team turnover.

As a Retail Manager you will

Sales Objectives and Market Share Gains

  • Define development and growth strategies with the Head of Travel Retail, Europe for the designated accounts and implement them successfully in stores.
  • Deliver sell-out in line with forecast commitments.
  • Identify and capitalise on opportunities to drive brand awareness, performance, and market share across the region.

Account Management

  • Build strong relationships with retailer contacts to optimise brand presence, maximize share of voice, and negotiate industry-leading joint trading plans.
  • Deliver regular business/sales updates and critical market insights, acting as the connection between our stores and the Magic Office.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews and half-year external strategy meetings, producing strong insights and action-driven 360 plans.

High Performance Teams

  • With the people partner, recruit high performing Retail teams for each store launch.
  • Set ambitious and achievable sales targets to the field teams.
  • Lead and inspire your team of business managers and retail artists.
  • When needed, address performance and engagement needs identified, building an environment of inclusion and motivation within your defined area.
  • Work alongside the field training manager to ensure commercial and development training needs are met within the region.

Brand Image Building and Launch of New Campaigns

  • Work in close collaboration with Travel Retail Marketing & VM teams to develop trade plans and on-counter activities.
  • Successfully launch and sustain new products and campaigns as per the global Travel Retail Marketing strategy.

Effective Commercial & Budget Management

  • With the Head of Travel Retail, Europe, monthly retail forecasting by store.
  • In alignment with finance and retailer partners, forecast and manage all retail staffing costs, including recommended FTEs, commissions and incentives management.
  • Manage T&E budget, staying within approved monthly expenditure.

Operational Excellence

  • Set standards for executional excellence, support new processes, and work cross-functionally to enhance brand presentation and in-store execution, including but not limited to assortment, stock availability on counter, price updates.

Requirements
  • Must be able to travel within region and to Magic Office regularly. Roughly a 40/60 split
  • Wide experience in Retail or Sales Management, with direct experience in Travel Retail desirable but not mandatory
  • Strong people focus, team spirited and passionate about developing teams.
  • Proven track record of successful negotiations & ability to influence others.
  • Target-focused and results-driven.

title: Customer Success Team Leader
description:
Key Highlights:

  • Job Title: Customer Success Team Leader

  • Location: Paris, hybrid working

  • Reporting to: Head of Customer Experience

  • Salary: €40,000-€50,000 DOE

About Us
SaleCycle is redefining how brands convert, engage, and retain customers through AI-driven experiences across the entire customer journey.
SaleCycle combines real-time onsite personalisation and intent scoring with offsite activation across email, SMS, and paid channels, enabling brands to identify, engage, convert, and re-engage customers with precision.

What we do

  • We provide a full-funnel Agentic Marketing Platform, combining:

  • Real-time behavioural analytics and intent scoring

  • AI-powered search, recommendations, and agentic decisioning

  • Onsite personalisation and A/B testing

  • Cross-channel activation (email, SMS, paid media)

  • CRM/CDP integrations and first-party data orchestration

  • Retail media and monetisation capabilities

Who we are
We are a global team of 80+ people across the UK, France, Spain, Italy, and Eastern Europe.
We are profitable, growing, and operating with a clear mindset:

  • We build, not maintain

  • We prioritise outcomes over activity

  • We operate with low ego and high accountability

  • We challenge ourselves to step outside our comfort zone

Our Values
At SaleCycle, we care about people; it’s our top priority. We prioritise well-being, growth, and innovation, continuously pushing boundaries as a team and a company.

  • Continuous Innovation: Collaborate, innovate, and celebrate!

  • Premium Execution: Excellence Delivered Every Time!

  • High Curiosity: Embrace your inner child - ask why and listen!

  • Proactive Collaboration: United, we work together and lead the way!

  • Ultimate Passion: Infuse passion into every action!

Job Summary
We are seeking a motivated and capable Customer Success Team Leader to combine hands-on account management with team leadership responsibilities, with a dedicated focus on our Italian client base. This role is ideal for an experienced Customer Success professional, fluent in Italian, ready to take the next step in leadership while remaining close to clients and commercial outcomes in one of our key growth markets.

The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of Italian customer accounts while supporting the wider Customer Success function through mentoring, onboarding, training, operational excellence, and day-to-day guidance for the team members handling the Italian book of business. They will act as the internal reference point for the Italian market- ensuring client relationships, communications and processes are properly adapted to local expectations- while helping the team hit retention, growth, service quality and satisfaction targets for Italy specifically.
This is a highly visible role that bridges individual contribution with leadership impact, positioning the successful candidate as the go-to expert on the Italian market within Customer Success.

Key Responsibilities:
Team Support & Leadership

  • Provide day-to-day guidance and support to the Customer Success Managers handling the Italian client portfolio

  • Support the onboarding and ramp-up of new starters joining the Italian desk, helping them become effective quickly

  • Deliver regular mentoring and skill development sessions, including guidance on Italian business etiquette and relationship-building norms

  • Share best practices, success stories and continuous improvement ideas across the team

Client Management

Operational Excellence

  • Assist with onboarding delivery for new customers to ensure a smooth launch experience

Performance & KPI Delivery

  • Monitor customer health indicators and escalate concerns where needed

  • Use data and reporting to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Product, Design, Marketing, and Support teams to deliver strong customer outcomes

  • Help coordinate training needs with internal departments

  • Act as a voice of the customer, sharing feedback and insights internally

Projects & Wider Contribution

  • Lead or support operational projects within your tier that benefit the wider Customer Success function

  • Contribute ideas that improve scalability, service quality, reporting, or commercial outcomes

  • Support change initiatives and new ways of working as the business evolves

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong leadership potential with the ability to influence and motivate others

  • Customer-first mindset with a passion for delivering value

  • Commercial awareness and understanding of retention/growth drivers

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with genuine cultural fluency for the Italian market

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise effectively

  • Coaching mindset with patience and a desire to help others improve

  • Problem-solving ability and confidence handling challenges

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience managing customer relationships and delivering commercial outcomes, ideally with Italian or Italian-speaking clients

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Graneet propose un SaaS qui a pour objectif d'aider les PME du BTP à protéger leur rentabilité en leur permettant de piloter leur business par la marge, en temps réel, du bureau au chantier. Pour venir en aide aux dirigeants confrontés à des logiciels existants trop complexes, nous avons développé une solution intuitive et robuste avec un service client ultra-réactif. Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plus de 1000 entreprises et elles en sont ravies.

Nous poursuivons notre expansion sur le marché français pour devenir l'Operating System des PME du BTP, en France puis en Europe.

L'équipe Marketing

Tu rejoins une équipe Marketing resserrée (un Growth Manager et le Head of Marketing), sous la responsabilité du Head of Marketing, avec des liens étroits et quotidiens avec l'équipe Produit (les Product Builders).

Notre conviction : chez Graneet, une release n'existe vraiment que quand elle est comprise, adoptée et valorisée. C'est exactement le terrain de jeu de ce poste. Tu es à l'intersection du Produit, du Sales, du Customer Success et du Marketing produit, et tu transformes ce que la Tech shippe en valeur perçue et en pipe business.

Notre particularité, c'est que tu es owner de l'impact business de tes actions. Tu ne te contentes pas de communiquer : tu crées des opportunités, tu mesures les résultats concrets. Tu priorises en fonction de l’impact business, tu produis les assets, tu embarques les équipes et tu itères.

L'IA fait déjà partie de notre façon de travailler, à chaque étape. Elle nous permet de produire vite, à l'échelle et sans casser la cohérence de marque (contenu, visuels, vidéo), et d'automatiser ce qui doit l'être pour qu'on se concentre sur ce qui crée vraiment de la valeur.

Tes missions

Ce poste est fait pour toi si... tu as une fibre business marquée, la curiosité de creuser des sujets produit complexes et le goût de la production de contenu. Tu sais gérer des projets complexes et coordonner les équipes. L'IA est déjà ancrée dans ton quotidien pour gagner en efficacité.

Concrètement :

1. Communication sur les releases produit

  • Construire et exécuter le plan de communication de chaque nouvelle feature, en étroite collaboration avec les Product Builders, avec qui tu es impliqué.e dès la conception de la feature.

  • Qualifier l'impact business de chaque feature et calibrer le bon niveau de communication (du simple changelog au lancement d'ampleur).

  • Piloter le calendrier de communication des releases et le diffuser en interne aux différentes équipes concernées.

2. Génération de pipe pour l'upsell

  • Identifier les add-ons avec le plus de potentiel business pour prioriser les actions

  • Construire des segments et campagnes ciblées (in-app, emailing, webinars) pour générer des opportunités d’upsell

  • Transmettre les opportunités qualifiées à l'Account Manager et suivre la conversion des opportunités générées pour ajuster le plan d’actions en conséquence.

  • Gérer le reporting sur l’impact business des releases

3. Adoption produit des modules-clés

  • Définir la stratégie d’adoption produit

  • Identifier les modules et features stratégiques au regard de nos enjeux business.

  • Exécuter la stratégie de communication pour développer la connaissance et l'adoption de ces modules / features-clés, en collaboration avec les équipes Customer Success

  • Mesurer l'adoption réelle et itérer.

4. Création des assets marketing

  • Concevoir les supports de promotion des features : page web, visuels, vidéos, bannières in-app, séquences email, webinars, témoignages clients…

  • Produire vite et à l'échelle grâce à l'IA (contenu, visuels, vidéo), tout en garantissant la cohérence de ton, de charte graphique et de message avec l'identité de marque Graneet.

5. Coordination interne

  • Être le point de contact entre Produit, Customer Success, Sales et Marketing pour toute la communication des nouvelles features.

  • Organiser / Intégrer les rituels de coordination (réunion de lancement, brief CS/Sales avant release).

  • S’assurer que chaque équipe est bien outillée pour relayer l'information auprès des clients ou en interne.

  • Centraliser et diffuser le calendrier de communication produit à l'ensemble des équipes concernées.

Profil recherché

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en Product Marketing, Growth ou marketing, idéalement en SaaS B2B.

  • Tu as déjà été owner de lancements produit de A à Z en autonomie : stratégie, production des assets, embarquement des équipes, mesure de l'impact.

  • Tu as une vraie appétence business : tu sais lire l'usage produit et la donnée CRM (Hubspot chez nous), construire un ciblage, générer du pipe et mesurer le ROI de tes actions.

  • Tu n’as pas peur des problématiques produit complexes, tu aimes creuser les sujets en profondeur et tu as une forte capacité d’apprentissage.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec la production de contenu (copywriting, visuels, vidéo) et tu sais tenir une cohérence de marque sur l'ensemble.

  • Tu es data-friendly : tu sais te débrouiller dans un CRM, définir des métriques et suivre tes résultats.

  • Tu utilises l’IA au quotidien : tu as déjà un usage concret de l'IA sur la production de contenu et de visuels, la vidéo, l'automatisation de process et l'analyse de données.

  • Tu es autonome, assertif·ve et pragmatique, aussi à l'aise pour imaginer que pour concrétiser, avec une communication claire.

  • Tu parles un français courant pour échanger au quotidien avec nos clients et nos équipes, et tu sais évoluer en anglais également (utile à mesure que Graneet se développe à l'international).

️ Processus de recrutement ️

Tu portes de l'importance à la culture d'entreprise dans le choix de ta prochaine aventure professionnelle ? Nous aussi ! Nous avons préparé un questionnaire pour que tu te fasses une idée du « fit » Graneet avant même d'échanger avec nous, 10 minutes top chrono. Ce n'est ni obligatoire, ni analysé.

Voici les étapes du processus de recrutement :

  • Screening avec le Head of Marketing (15 min)

  • Entretien manager avec le Head of Marketing

  • Business Case — un plan de lancement / GTM d'une feature que tu viens présenter devant le Head of Marketing et le CPO (ou un Product Builder)

  • Final round avec 2 membres de l'ExCo, suivi d'un échange informel avec l'équipe

  • 2 prises de référence sur tes précédentes expériences

Pour t'accompagner pendant le parcours, tu peux retrouver notre Guide Candidat.

Ce qui t'attend si tu nous rejoins

  • Industrie : ose découvrir le monde du BTP pour aider les PME du secteur à assurer leur pérennité.

  • Produit terre à terre : une entreprise avec une forte culture produit, qui simplifie le quotidien de milliers de personnes, du bureau au chantier.

  • Croissance raisonnée : une croissance ambitieuse et maîtrisée, dans un environnement sain.

  • Vie d'équipe : une équipe passionnée et stimulante qui aime travailler ensemble. Pour de vrai !

Nos collaborateurs sont satisfaits de leur expérience chez Graneet. Glassdoor présente bien notre environnement de travail

L'onboarding

À ton arrivée, tu accèdes via Notion à un parcours personnalisé de 2 semaines qui te donne une vision très complète de l'entreprise, du secteur et des problématiques de nos clients.

Évolutions et politique salariale

  • Chaque métier a une grille de salaire par niveau de poste. Les grilles sont revues une fois par an via un benchmark marché Figures : on s'assure de mieux payer que 60 % des entreprises du marché !

  • Notre engagement : garantir que tu sois dans la grille de ton métier et de ton niveau.

  • La rémunération pour ce poste se situe entre 50 000 € et 60 000 €.

  • C'est la revue de ta performance annuelle qui impacte directement ta revalorisation salariale.

  • Des BSPCE : attribution au mérite d'une année à l'autre pour les tracks IC.

La vie d'équipe

  • L'exigence, la transparence, la bienveillance et le dynamisme sont ancrés dans nos process quotidiens. Le feedback est très présent dans notre culture.

  • Télétravail flexible : hybride (2 jours par semaine). Nous avons de super bureaux au cœur de Paris (Métro Poissonnière) !

  • Un offsite entreprise par an (3 jours) et un offsite équipe (2 jours).

title: Global Head of Sensory and Technical Insights
description:
Want to join a fast-moving company, work among convivial teams, and take part in the global growth strategy of one of the most prestigious and comprehensive portfolios in the wine & spirits industry? We are looking for a Global Head of Sensory and Technical Insights! You will be based at The Island, our office in central Paris.

Your key missions:

Reporting to the Global Research, Sensory and Analytical Sciences Director, you will lead the development and application of sensory science, technical product understanding and consumer-relevant insights to support innovation, product quality, reformulations and strategic decision-making across our spirits portfolio. As the bridge between consumer understanding, sensory perception, analytical data, product development, quality and brand strategy, you will make sure product decisions are grounded in robust science and translated into meaningful business outcomes – building the capabilities, best practices, expert teams and panels that unlock growth.

Sensory strategy & leadership

  • Define and own the global sensory and technical insights strategy, driving capability development, scientific excellence and business impact across innovation, renovation and quality

  • Shape portfolio decisions by identifying sensory whitespace opportunities, product superiority drivers and emerging consumer preferences

  • Monitor emerging scientific developments and translate them into competitive advantage

  • Drive the development of novel sensory methodologies, predictive approaches and insight-generation techniques

  • Build external scientific networks with universities, research institutes and industry bodies

  • Establish sensory science as a core capability supporting product innovation, quality improvement and competitive benchmarking

  • Ensure sensory methodologies are fit-for-purpose, scientifically robust and relevant to business decision-making

  • Build a clear vision for how sensory and technical insights contribute to consumer preference, product superiority, premiumisation and brand differentiation

  • Contribute to long-term product and technology roadmaps across categories

Product & technical insights

  • Lead the generation of technical product insights across spirits categories – whisky, gin, vodka, rum, tequila, liqueurs, aperitifs and low/no alcohol products

  • Translate sensory and analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for R&D, marketing, quality, operations and brand teams

  • Support the identification of key product drivers, sensory attributes, flavour profiles and technical levers influencing consumer perception and product performance

  • Connect sensory data with analytical chemistry, processing, maturation, packaging and consumer research to build a holistic understanding of product experience

  • Provide sensory and technical guidance throughout the innovation process, from early concept screening to final product validation

  • Ensure product changes are assessed with appropriate sensory and technical risk evaluation

  • Help protect brand consistency and consumer trust by ensuring sensory-critical attributes are understood, monitored and controlled

Sensory data

  • Drive the adoption of a digital sensory platform, advanced analytics, AI-enabled insight generation and predictive modelling approaches

  • Ensure data quality, governance, accessibility and knowledge management across sensory activities globally

  • Drive the integration of sensory, analytical, consumer, quality and product data to generate deeper technical understanding

  • Define and oversee the development of sensory data models, product landscapes and insight platforms

  • Champion the use of digital tools, sensory software, databases and data visualisation to improve knowledge management and decision-making

  • Translate complex scientific and sensory information into clear narratives for technical and non-technical stakeholders

Capability building

  • Build and lead a global sensory and technical insights community of practice, aligning methodologies, capability development and knowledge sharing across sites, brands and business units

  • Lead the development, training, calibration and performance management of sensory panels, including expert, descriptive, discrimination and quality panels

  • Define standards for sensory panel governance, panel reliability, data quality and continuous improvement

  • Ensure consistent application of sensory methodologies across sites, markets and categories

  • Build internal capability through training, coaching, tools and best-practice sharing

Collaboration

  • Partner with R&D, brand, marketing, consumer insights and quality teams to support new product development and reformulation projects

  • Act as the company’s leading expert in sensory and technical insights, influencing strategic decisions at senior leadership level

  • Represent sensory and technical insights in executive reviews, innovation governance forums and strategic portfolio discussions

  • Define and govern global sensory standards for product quality and brand consistency

  • Provide sensory expertise for quality investigations, product changes, supplier transitions, process modifications and market complaints

  • Work closely with blenders and liquid R&D teams

  • Represent the company at industry forums, scientific conferences and external collaborations

Team leadership & development

  • Lead, develop and inspire a team of sensory scientists, technical insight specialists, panel leaders and product researchers

  • Set clear priorities, objectives and performance expectations aligned with business needs

  • Develop and manage the sensory and technical insights budget, prioritising resources, external partnerships, technologies and capability investments

  • Build a culture of scientific excellence, curiosity, collaboration, impact and continuous improvement

  • Coach team members to strengthen their technical expertise, influencing skills and business-partnering capabilities

If you recognize yourself in the description below, don’t wait to apply!

You have:

  • an MSc or PhD in Sensory Science, Chemistry, Flavour Science, Consumer Science or a related scientific discipline (training in sensory statistics, consumer research, flavour chemistry, data science or spirits production is a plus)

  • Significant experience in sensory science, product research, consumer science, technical insights, R&D or product development – ideally within spirits, alcoholic beverages, food, flavour or FMCG

  • Proven experience building and leading global scientific capabilities or centres of excellence

  • a track record of influencing senior leadership and shaping strategic business decisions

  • experience leading organisational change, capability transformation or digital initiatives

  • a strong external network within sensory science, flavour science, consumer science or related disciplines

  • a strong command of sensory methodologies, including descriptive analysis, discrimination testing, preference mapping, quality sensory testing and product benchmarking

  • experience working with technical product data, analytical results, consumer insights and product development processes

  • experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing senior stakeholders

  • previous people management or team leadership experience

  • familiarity with sensory software and data visualisation tools

You are:

  • able to translate scientific understanding into commercial and brand value

  • a confident scientific writer, storyteller and presenter, at ease turning complex data into clear narratives for technical and non-technical audiences

  • curious, collaborative and impact-driven, with a passion for scientific excellence and continuous improvement

Nice to have:

  • hands-on experience with spirits, flavour chemistry, maturation, distillation, blending, low/no alcohol or liquid development (highly advantageous)

  • experience writing scientific papers, posters and presentations

  • experience with predictive modelling and advanced statistics

Wait, there’s more…

We offer you an outstanding and collaborative workplace that embodies our sharing & conviviality culture, the possibility to work remotely (up to 2 days a week), a very complete mutual insurance, an attractive compensation including profit-sharing, the possibility to train daily, employee events…

Pernod Ricard is committed to offering equal opportunities to all talents. Our recruitment methods focus on skills and competencies.

title: Senior product designer for CRM internal platform
description:

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.

Have a fluent French and English, both spoken and written (international teams)


We love working with each other because we have built a culture that suits us well:

  • Achieve great things and to support each other

  • Curious: It is essential that you have a passion for learning. Technology changes daily, and life has a way of constantly raising the bar

Apply now and Vibe with Us!

title: Account Executive - Financial & Banking Markets
description:
OUR STORY:
Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow !
Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies.
Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector.
With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.
Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.
Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.

WHY WE NEED YOU ?
Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Sales team to support the expansion of our enterprise client portfolio in Financial Services sector.
Your mission will be to lead strategic account acquisition in France, focusing on large enterprises within Financial Services ecosystem, in order to accelerate revenue growth, boost our presence in key industries, and support our ambition to become the European leader in sovereign cloud solutions.

YOUR FUTURE TEAM
We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.
You will be part of a 15-person team of Account Executives, organized by verticals and industry sectors.
The team is embedded in cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Marketing, and Product departments.
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
  • Open, manage and grow enterprise accounts in Financial Services vertical.
  • Develop and execute account and territory strategies, driving both new business and expansion opportunities.
  • Be the first point of contact for enterprise clients, building trusted relationships at all levels of the organization.
  • Provide regular reporting to management on account activity, pipeline maturity, strategic Sales & Marketing initiatives and quarterly numbers reviews.
  • Capacity to find solutions in order to contractualize complex business agreements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure customer needs are met and to coordinate Sales delivery (capacity to find alternatives).
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of our products and services.

ABOUT YOU
Soft Skills
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills
  • Strong ability to build relationships with multiple stakeholders, including C-level executives and partners
  • Curious, adaptable
Hard Skills
  • Proven experience and network in Financial Services vertical
  • Proven track record in enterprise sales and strategic account development
  • Ability to open, manage and grow multiple enterprise accounts
  • Understanding of Cloud & AI ecosystem and how they solve business challenges
  • Ability to translate technical solutions into business outcomes for executive-level stakeholders
  • Experience with digital transformation initiatives, industrial automation, or AI-driven optimization projects
  • Experience using sales tools and platforms relevant to enterprise cloud sales (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)
  • Fluent in English and French
WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++
  • Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.
  • Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.
  • Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.
